```{r, "temp",eval=FALSE}
#Making sure the first column will always be the patient

patient_idx <- match(patient_col, colnames(count_mat))

  stop("Patient column not found in colnames(count_mat). Check your naming!")
}


# If the patient isn't already col 1, swap
if (patient_idx != 1) {

  count_mat <- count_mat[, c(patient_idx, setdiff(1:ncol(count_mat), patient_idx)), drop=FALSE]

# Now col 1 is the patient, col 2 is the control

  sample = c(sampleA, sampleB),
  condition = c("patient", "control"),
  row.names = c(sampleA, sampleB)
)

# Ensure 'condition' is factor
coldata$condition <- factor(coldata$condition, levels=c("control","patient"))


dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat,
  colData   = coldata,
  design    = ~ condition
)

dds <- DESeq(dds)

{

# Combine the filtered tables into a single array for averaging
# This assumes all tables are filtered to have the same genes and structure
combined_data <- abind::abind(filtered_tables, along = 3)

# Compute the average across the 3rd dimension (iterations) for each gene and each column

{
```
```{r "manually adding the mevorach controls", eval=FALSE}
  seu_patient <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/seu_cd59_nk.qs")

patient_type="CD59-Def"
control_type="Healthy"
patient_orig_ident ="Mevorach"
control_sample <- unique(seu_control$sample)[1]
  
list_seu <- list(
  "seu_try" = seu_try)

seu_control <- list_seu[[1]]

sample_output_list <- list()

seu_control <- subset(seu_control,subset= condition == control_type)
seu_patient <- subset(seu_patient,subset= condition == patient_type)

control_sample <- "Healthy"

#For each "healthy" sample in seu_control 
for (control_sample in unique(seu_control$condition)) {
  
  #Subset to the that one healthy sample
  seu_control_sample <- subset(seu_control,subset= condition == control_sample)
  
de_markers_list <- list()

#Run downsample + SCT + FindMarkers 3 times
#(Because in each downsample iteration, the count matrix changes up a little bit)
for (i in 1:3) {

    #call the downsample function
seurats_post_downsample <-  tryCatch({
downsample_by_porp (seu_control_sample, seu_patient)
    }, error = function(e) {
        stop("The function one_on_one failed because the function downsample_by_porp encountered an error: ", e$message)
    })




# creating and manipulating seu_merge
seu_merge <- merge(seurats_post_downsample$seu_control_sample
,seurats_post_downsample$seu_patient)


seu_merge@active.assay <- "RNA"
seu_merge[["SCT"]] <- NULL

seu_merge[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu_merge[["RNA"]])

seu_merge <- SCTransform(seu_merge, vars.to.regress = "percent_mito", verbose = TRUE, conserve.memory = TRUE)

Idents(seu_merge) <- "orig.ident"

#maybe we should remove the "matching_item"
patient_group <-   matching_item <- unique(seu_merge@active.ident)[grep(patient_orig_ident, unique(seu_merge@active.ident))]


patient_group <- "CD59-Def"
de_markers <- FindMarkers(seu_merge, ident.1 = patient_group, group.by = 'condition',logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0,min.cells.feature = 0)
head(de_markers)

  # Save the result of this iteration into the list
  de_markers_list[[i]] <- de_markers
  gc()

  }


# Find the intersection of genes across all 3 tables
{
  reoccuring_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(de_markers_list, rownames))

# Filter each table to retain only the common genes
filtered_tables <- lapply(de_markers_list, function(tbl) tbl[reoccuring_genes, ])

# Combine the filtered tables into a single array for averaging
# This assumes all tables are filtered to have the same genes and structure
combined_data <- abind::abind(filtered_tables, along = 3)

# Compute the average across the 3rd dimension (iterations) for each gene and each column
averaged_table <- apply(combined_data, c(1, 2), mean)

# Convert the resulting matrix into a data frame for easier handling
final_table <- as.data.frame(averaged_table)

# Set row names to the gene names
rownames(final_table) <- reoccuring_genes

}

#Filter out housekeeping, ribosomal, mitochondrial and hemoglobin genes
{
  #Read housekeeping genes names

joshi_hk_genes <- read_excel("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/joshi_low_gini_coefficients_genes.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)

  levanon_hk_genes <- read_excel("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/levanon_housekeeping_genes.xlsx", col_names = TRUE)
  
original_table <- final_table  
  # Add a temporary column with rownames
final_table$temp_rownames <- rownames(final_table)

# Combine all housekeeping genes from both files into a single vector
all_hk_genes <- c(joshi_hk_genes[[2]], levanon_hk_genes[[1]])

# Store the initial number of rows in final_table
initial_row_count <- nrow(final_table)

# Filter out rows whose names are in the housekeeping genes
final_table <- final_table[!final_table$temp_rownames %in% all_hk_genes, ]



# Calculate and print the number of rows removed
rows_removed <- initial_row_count - nrow(final_table)
print(paste("Number of housekeeping genes removed:", rows_removed))

initial_row_count <- nrow(final_table)

final_table <- final_table[!grepl("^MT-|^RP[SL]|^HB[^(P|E|S)]|^AC[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$", final_table$temp_rownames), ]

final_table$temp_rownames <- NULL

rows_removed <- initial_row_count - nrow(final_table)
print(paste("Number of additonal ribosomal, mitochondrial and hemoglobin genes and some lncRNAs removed:", rows_removed))

  
}

    )
)

}

)
```

```{r, "getting meta-tables for each of CD55",eval=FALSE}
seu_patient <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/seu_cd55_nk.qs")
  output_list <- list()

  options(future.globals.maxSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)  # 10 GB
  



for (seu in list_seu) {
  
  # Run one-on-one function and get output
  output <- one_on_one(seu_patient, seu, patient_type="CD55-Def", control_type="Healthy", patient_orig_ident="Mevorach")
  
  
# browser()
 
  # Extract orig.ident value
  orig_ident_value <- as.character(unique(seu$orig.ident)[1])

  # Check if the orig.ident value already exists in output_list
  if (orig_ident_value %in% names(output_list)) {
    # If it exists, append to the existing list under that identifier
    output_list[[orig_ident_value]] <- append(output_list[[orig_ident_value]], output[[orig_ident_value]])} else {
    # If it does not exist, create a new entry in the list
        output_list[[orig_ident_value]] <- output[[orig_ident_value]]

  }
}
```

```{r, "integrating all ms samples and all healthy controls, getting heatmap outof it",eval=FALSE}
rm(seu_degagne,seu_smith_em,seu_smith_NRHV193_NRHV187,seu_witkowski_h6,seu_witkowski_h8,seu_witkowski_h21_h18_h2,seu_zhang,seu_yang,seu_hong,seu_kang,seu_ramesh_5, seu_cd55, seu_cd59,seu_degagne_healthy_pNK_pre_infusion,seu_smith_healthy_em,seu_witkowski_healthy_H6,seu_witkowski_healthy_H8,seu_zhang_healthy_D0_10_Crl, seu_schafflick, seu_esaulova)



gc()
  }

  
  patient_condition <- "MS"
  

 {
  
  seu_patient <- healthy_list_for_integration$seu_degagne
  seu_patient <- get_slim_seu(seu_patient)
  
  healthy_list_for_integration$seu_degagne <- NULL
  
  #merging loop
  for (seu_healthy in healthy_list_for_integration) {
    
    seu_healthy <- get_slim_seu(seu_healthy)
    seu_patient <- merge(seu_patient,seu_healthy)
    
  }
  
  seu_patient[["ADT"]] <- NULL
  
  #change datasets names        
  seu_patient@meta.data$orig.ident <- case_when(
    seu_patient@meta.data$sample == "EM_HD1_NK_scRNAseq" ~ "Smith_em",
    seu_patient@meta.data$sample %in% c("NRHV187_unstim", "NRHV193_unstim")  ~ "Smith_unstim",
    seu_patient@meta.data$sample == "H6" ~ "Witkowski_H6",
    seu_patient@meta.data$sample == "H8" ~ "Witkowski_H8",
    seu_patient@meta.data$sample %in% c("H21", "H18", "H2")  ~ "Witkowski_H21_H18_H2",  
    TRUE ~ seu_patient@meta.data$orig.ident
  ) 
  
  seu_patient <- SCTransform(seu_patient, vars.to.regress = c("percent_mito", "S.Score", "G2M.Score"), verbose = F,   conserve.memory = FALSE)
  gc()
  seu_patient <- RunPCA(seu_patient, npcs = 50, verbose = F)
  
  qsave(seu_patient,"/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/seu_try.qs")

  seu_patient <- IntegrateLayers(object = seu_patient, method = HarmonyIntegration,
                                 orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = 'harmony',
                                 assay = "SCT", verbose = F)

  qsave(seu_patient,"/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/seu_try.qs")

  seu_patient <- RunUMAP(seu_patient, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)
  seu_patient <- FindNeighbors(seu_patient, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony" )
  seu_patient <- FindClusters (seu_patient)
  
    qsave(seu_patient,"/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/seu_try.qs")

  
  integration_4_umap <- get_four_integration_plots(seu_patient)
  
  seu_patient <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(object = seu_patient)
  
  
  de_markers <- FindMarkers(seu_patient, ident.1 = patient_condition, group.by = 'condition')
  
  return_list= list(
    "integrated_seu" = seu_patient,
    "integration_4_umap" = integration_4_umap,
    "de_table" = de_markers
  )   
  
  qsave(return_list,"/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/seu_try.qs")
}

  return_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/seu_try.qs")
  
# print(return_list$integration_4_umap)

integrated_seu <- return_list$integrated_seu

  options(future.globals.maxSize = 1600 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)  # 160 GB


DefaultAssay(integrated_seu) <- "SCT"           # or "RNA" – whatever you used
future::plan(multisession, workers = 6)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1)  Identify the groups ------------------------------------------------------
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ms_samples      <- unique(integrated_seu$sample[integrated_seu$condition == "MS"])
healthy_cells   <- WhichCells(integrated_seu, expression = condition == "Healthy")

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2)  One FindMarkers per MS sample  →  named results_list ---------------------
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
results_list <- future_lapply(
  ms_samples,
  function(smpl) {
    cells_ms <- WhichCells(integrated_seu, expression = sample == smpl)

    res <- FindMarkers(
      integrated_seu,
      ident.1         = cells_ms,      # ← use ident.1 / ident.2
      ident.2         = healthy_cells,
      logfc.threshold = 0,
      min.pct         = 0
    )

    res$gene <- rownames(res)
    res
  },
  future.seed = TRUE
)
names(results_list) <- ms_samples
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3)  Build and save the heat-map (integrated pipeline side only) -------------
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ht_int <- get_gene_heatmap(
  results_list     = results_list,
  metric_col       = "avg_log2FC",
  method_type      = "integrated",
  metric_name      = "avg_log2FC",
  condition        = "Multiple Sclerosis",
  min_abs_metric   = 0,          # let draw_gene_heatmap decide what to keep
  genes_to_display = NULL        # or pass a character vector of favourites
)


pdf("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/NKs/ms_all_integrated_at_once_gene_heatmaps.pdf", width = 26, height = 20)
draw(ht_int$heat_map, annotation_legend_list = attr(ht_int$heat_map, "extra_legends"))
dev.off()
```

# Old functions:

```{r, "old get_spearman  function",eval=FALSE}
get_spearman <- function(
    meta_table, 
    de_table, 
    join_column = "gene",
    meta_main_rank_column,
    meta_tie_breaker_column = NULL,
    int_main_rank_column,
    int_tie_breaker_column = NULL
){
  # browser()
  # Ensure join_column exist
  if (!(join_column %in% colnames(meta_table)) || !(join_column %in% colnames(de_table))) {
    stop_message <- paste("Both meta_table and de_results must contain a", join_column, "column..")
    stop(stop_message)
  }
  

  # 1) Merge with suffixes so identical column names become e.g., 'GeneRatio.meta' and 'GeneRatio.int'
  merged <- merge(meta_table, de_table, by = join_column, suffixes = c(".meta", ".int"))
  
  # 2) Identify the meta vs. integrated columns for ranking
  #    in case they share the same column name
  if (meta_main_rank_column == int_main_rank_column) {
    meta_col <- paste0(meta_main_rank_column, ".meta")
    int_col  <- paste0(int_main_rank_column,  ".int")
  } else {
    meta_col <- meta_main_rank_column
    int_col  <- int_main_rank_column
  }
  
  # 3) Handle tie-breaker
  if (!is.null(meta_tie_breaker_column)) {
    if (meta_tie_breaker_column == int_tie_breaker_column) {
      meta_tie_breaker_col <- paste0(meta_tie_breaker_column, ".meta")
      int_tie_breaker_col <- paste0(int_tie_breaker_column, ".int")
    } else {
      meta_tie_breaker_col <- meta_tie_breaker_column
      int_tie_breaker_col <- int_tie_breaker_column
    }
  }
  

  
  # 5) Check that all needed columns actually exist
  needed_cols <- c(meta_col, int_col)
  if (!is.null(meta_tie_breaker_col)) {
    needed_cols <- c(needed_cols, meta_tie_breaker_col)
  }
  if (!is.null(int_tie_breaker_col)) {
    needed_cols <- c(needed_cols, int_tie_breaker_col)
  }
  
  missing_cols <- needed_cols[!(needed_cols %in% colnames(merged))]
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing required columns in merged data:\n",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  # 6) Convert meta_col to numeric (if needed)
  #    e.g., if it's a stored character expression, parse+eval or just as.numeric
  merged[[meta_col]] <- sapply(merged[[meta_col]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
  
  # 7) Rank in descending order based on meta_col
  merged$meta_rank <- rank(-merged[[meta_col]], ties.method = "average")
  
  # 8) Apply meta tie-breaker if provided
  if (!is.null(meta_tie_breaker_col)) {
    # convert tie breaker to numeric if necessary
    merged[[meta_tie_breaker_col]] <- sapply(merged[[meta_tie_breaker_col]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
    
    merged$meta_rank <- rank(
      merged$meta_rank + rank(-merged[[meta_tie_breaker_col]], ties.method = "average"),
      ties.method = "average"
    )
  }
  
  # 9) Convert int_col to numeric (if needed)
  merged[[int_col]] <- sapply(merged[[int_col]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
  
  # 10) Rank integrated column in descending order
  merged$de_rank <- rank(-merged[[int_col]], ties.method = "average")
  
  # 11) Apply integrated tie-breaker if provided
  if (!is.null(int_tie_breaker_col)) {
    # convert tie breaker to numeric if necessary
    merged[[int_tie_breaker_col]] <- sapply(merged[[int_tie_breaker_col]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
    
    merged$de_rank <- rank(
      merged$de_rank + rank(-merged[[int_tie_breaker_col]], ties.method = "average"),
      ties.method = "average"
    )
  }
  
  # 12) Compute Spearman correlation
  spearman_result <- cor(merged$meta_rank, merged$de_rank, method = "spearman")
  
  # Return a convenient list (add anything else you want)
  return(list(spearman_correlation = spearman_result))
}
```

```{r, "old create_meta_table function",eval=FALSE}

#This version has alot of commented columns that used to be there

create_meta_table <- function(output_list) {
  # Collect all unique genes
  all_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(output_list, function(dataset) {
    unlist(lapply(dataset, function(sample) {
      rownames(sample$original_table)
    }))
  })))

  # Initialize meta_table and required storage
  meta_table <- data.frame(row.names = all_genes)

  # Variables we actually need
  gene_count <- numeric(length(all_genes))       # how many times each gene appears
  fisher_scores <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  avg_log2FC_sums <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  median_log2FC_values <- vector("list", length(all_genes))
  dsi_scores <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)

  # Track the number of valid comparisons for each gene (for Fisher's DF)
  valid_comparisons <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)

  # Commenting out the other variables (but keeping them for future reference)
  # avg_pct_dif_sums <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  # log2FC_values <- vector("list", length(all_genes))
  # significant_counts_q3_1_5_iqr <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  # significant_control_counts_q3_1_5_iqr <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  # count_volcano_patient <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  # count_volcano_control <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  # count_direction_control <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  # count_direction_patient <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)

  # Precompute Q3 and IQR (Comment out if not needed, but keep here for future use)
  for (dataset in output_list) {
    for (sample in dataset) {
      final_table <- sample$final_table
      # final_table$pct_dif <- final_table$pct.1 - final_table$pct.2
      # final_table$pct_dif_control <- final_table$pct.2 - final_table$pct.1

      # q3 <- quantile(final_table$pct_dif, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      # iqr <- IQR(final_table$pct_dif, na.rm = TRUE)
      # q3_1_5_iqr <- q3 + 1.5 * iqr

      # q3_control <- quantile(final_table$pct_dif_control, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      # iqr_control <- IQR(final_table$pct_dif_control, na.rm = TRUE)
      # q3_1_5_iqr_control <- q3_control + 1.5 * iqr_control

      # Iterate over genes in the table
      for (gene in rownames(final_table)) {
        gene_idx <- match(gene, all_genes)

        # Update gene count
        gene_count[gene_idx] <- gene_count[gene_idx] + 1

        # Update Fisher scores with raw p-values
        p_val <- final_table[gene, "p_val"]  # Use raw p-values
        if (!is.na(p_val)) {
          fisher_scores[gene] <- fisher_scores[gene] + (-2 * log(p_val))
          valid_comparisons[gene] <- valid_comparisons[gene] + 1
        }

        # Update avg_log2FC
        avg_log2FC <- final_table[gene, "avg_log2FC"]
        if (!is.na(avg_log2FC)) {
          avg_log2FC_sums[gene] <- avg_log2FC_sums[gene] + avg_log2FC
          median_log2FC_values[[gene_idx]] <- c(median_log2FC_values[[gene_idx]], avg_log2FC)
          # log2FC_values[[gene_idx]] <- c(log2FC_values[[gene_idx]], avg_log2FC)
        }
        
        # Update dsi_scores (using p_val_adj from Seurat’s default approach)
        if (!is.na(avg_log2FC) && avg_log2FC >= 1 &&
            !is.na(final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"]) && final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"] <= 0.05) {
          dsi_scores[gene] <- dsi_scores[gene] + 1
        }
        if (!is.na(avg_log2FC) && avg_log2FC <= -1 &&
            !is.na(final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"]) && final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"] <= 0.05) {
          dsi_scores[gene] <- dsi_scores[gene] - 1
        }

        # The following blocks are commented out, but kept for future reference
        # pct_dif <- final_table[gene, "pct_dif"]
        # if (!is.na(pct_dif)) {
        #   avg_pct_dif_sums[gene] <- avg_pct_dif_sums[gene] + pct_dif
        # }

        # pct1 <- final_table[gene, "pct.1"]
        # if (!is.na(pct1) && !is.na(pct_dif)) {
        #   if (pct1 >= 0.5 && pct_dif > q3_1_5_iqr) significant_counts_q3_1_5_iqr[gene] <- significant_counts_q3_1_5_iqr[gene] + 1
        # }
        # pct2 <- final_table[gene, "pct.2"]
        # if (!is.na(pct2) && !is.na(final_table[gene, "pct_dif_control"])) {
        #   pct_dif_control <- final_table[gene, "pct_dif_control"]
        #   if (pct2 >= 0.5 && pct_dif_control > q3_1_5_iqr_control) significant_control_counts_q3_1_5_iqr[gene] <- significant_control_counts_q3_1_5_iqr[gene] + 1
        # }

        # if (!is.na(avg_log2FC) && avg_log2FC >= 0.5) {
        #   count_direction_control[gene] <- count_direction_control[gene] + 1
        # }
        # if (!is.na(avg_log2FC) && avg_log2FC <= -0.5) {
        #   count_direction_patient[gene] <- count_direction_patient[gene] + 1
        # }
      }
    }
  }

  # Combine partial results into the meta_table
  meta_table$dsi <- dsi_scores
  meta_table$avg_log2FC <- round((avg_log2FC_sums / gene_count), 2)
  meta_table$median_log2FC <- sapply(median_log2FC_values, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  meta_table$fisher <- round(fisher_scores, 2)

  # Now compute Fisher's combined p-values per gene
  # Degrees of freedom = 2 * number_of_valid_comparisons
  # If valid_comparisons[gene] == 0, that gene never had a raw p-value, so skip
  fisher_pvals <- mapply(function(score, k) {
    if (k == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    } else {
      return(1 - pchisq(score, df = 2 * k))
    }
  }, fisher_scores, valid_comparisons)

  # Apply FDR across all genes
  fisher_qvals <- p.adjust(fisher_pvals, method = "BH")

  # Add columns for Fisher's meta-analysis p-value and FDR
  meta_table$p_val_fisher <- fisher_pvals
  meta_table$q_val_fisher <- fisher_qvals

  # Store how many valid p-values contributed to each gene (optional but informative)
  meta_table$valid_comparisons <- valid_comparisons

  # You can reorder columns as you like
  meta_table <- cbind(
    comparisons_num = gene_count,
    meta_table
  )

  # Subset the final columns to only the ones needed
  # (Adjust the column order or names as you see fit)
  meta_table <- meta_table[, c(
    "comparisons_num", "dsi", "avg_log2FC", 
    "median_log2FC", "fisher", "valid_comparisons",
    "p_val_fisher", "q_val_fisher"
  )]

  return(meta_table)
}
```

```{r, "inefficent create_meta_table function",eval=FALSE}
inefficent_create_meta_table <- function(output_list) {
  # Collect all unique genes
  all_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(output_list, function(dataset) {
    unlist(lapply(dataset, function(sample) {
      rownames(sample$original_table)
    }))
  })))
  
  
  # Initialize meta_table and required storage
  meta_table <- data.frame(row.names = all_genes)
  
  # Variables we actually need
  gene_count <- numeric(length(all_genes))       # how many times each gene appears
  fisher_scores <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  avg_log2FC_sums <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  median_log2FC_values <- vector("list", length(all_genes))
  dsi_scores <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  num_upregulated <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  num_downregulated <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  
  
  # Track the number of valid comparisons for each gene (for Fisher's DF)
  valid_comparisons <- setNames(numeric(length(all_genes)), all_genes)
  
  
  
  # Precompute Q3 and IQR (Comment out if not needed, but keep here for future use)
  for (dataset in output_list) {
    for (sample in dataset) {
      final_table <- sample$original_table
      
      
      # Iterate over genes in the table
      for (gene in rownames(final_table)) {
        gene_idx <- match(gene, all_genes)
        
        # Update gene count
        gene_count[gene_idx] <- gene_count[gene_idx] + 1
        
        # Update Fisher scores with raw p-values
        p_val <- final_table[gene, "p_val"]  # Use raw p-values
        if (!is.na(p_val)) {
          fisher_scores[gene] <- fisher_scores[gene] + (-2 * log(p_val))
          valid_comparisons[gene] <- valid_comparisons[gene] + 1
        }
        
        # Update avg_log2FC
        avg_log2FC <- final_table[gene, "avg_log2FC"]
        if (!is.na(avg_log2FC)) {
          avg_log2FC_sums[gene] <- avg_log2FC_sums[gene] + avg_log2FC
          median_log2FC_values[[gene_idx]] <- c(median_log2FC_values[[gene_idx]], avg_log2FC)
          
        }
        
        # Update dsi_scores (using p_val_adj from Seurat’s default approach)
        if (!is.na(avg_log2FC) && avg_log2FC >= 1 &&
            !is.na(final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"]) && final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"] <= 0.05) {
          dsi_scores[gene] <- dsi_scores[gene] + 1
          num_upregulated[gene] <- num_upregulated[gene] + 1
        }
        if (!is.na(avg_log2FC) && avg_log2FC <= -1 &&
            !is.na(final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"]) && final_table[gene, "p_val_adj"] <= 0.05) {
          dsi_scores[gene] <- dsi_scores[gene] - 1
          num_downregulated[gene] <- num_downregulated[gene] + 1
          
        }
        
        
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine partial results into the meta_table
  meta_table$dsi <- dsi_scores
  meta_table$num_upregulated <- num_upregulated
  meta_table$num_downregulated <- num_downregulated
  
  meta_table$avg_log2FC <- round((avg_log2FC_sums / gene_count), 2)
  meta_table$median_log2FC <- sapply(median_log2FC_values, median, na.rm = TRUE)
  meta_table$fisher <- round(fisher_scores, 2)
  
  # Now compute Fisher's combined p-values per gene
  # Degrees of freedom = 2 * number_of_valid_comparisons
  # If valid_comparisons[gene] == 0, that gene never had a raw p-value, so skip
  fisher_pvals <- mapply(function(score, k) {
    if (k == 0) {
      return(NA_real_)
    } else {
      return(1 - pchisq(score, df = 2 * k))
    }
  }, fisher_scores, valid_comparisons)
  
  # Apply FDR across all genes
  fisher_qvals <- p.adjust(fisher_pvals, method = "BH")
  
  # Add columns for Fisher's meta-analysis p-value and FDR
  meta_table$p_val_fisher <- fisher_pvals
  meta_table$q_val_fisher <- fisher_qvals
  
  # Store how many valid p-values contributed to each gene (optional but informative)
  meta_table$valid_comparisons <- valid_comparisons
  
  # You can reorder columns as you like
  meta_table <- cbind(
    comparisons_num = gene_count,
    meta_table
  )
  
  # Subset the final columns to only the ones needed
  # (Adjust the column order or names as you see fit)
  meta_table <- meta_table[, c(
    "comparisons_num", "dsi", "num_upregulated", "num_downregulated","avg_log2FC", 
    "median_log2FC", "fisher", "valid_comparisons",
    "p_val_fisher", "q_val_fisher"
  )]
  

  
  # meta_table <- meta_table[meta_table$comparisons_num > 0, ]
  
  return(meta_table)
}
```

``` {r, "pct_boxplot function "}

pct_boxplot <- function(output_list, gene_name, patient_label = "Patient") {
  
  # Initialize variables
  pct1_value <- NULL  # To store pct.1 (single value)
  pct2_values <- numeric()  # To store all pct.2 values
  p_val_adj_values <- numeric()
  log2FC_values <- numeric()
  dataset <- c()
  sample <- c()
  pct1_extracted <- FALSE  # Flag to indicate if pct.1 has been extracted
  
  # Iterate over datasets and samples in the output list
  for (dataset_name in names(output_list)) {
    for (sample_name in names(output_list[[dataset_name]])) {
      # Get the final_table for the sample
      final_table <- output_list[[dataset_name]][[sample_name]]$final_table
      
      # Check if the gene is in the final_table
      if (gene_name %in% rownames(final_table)) {
        # Extract the row corresponding to the gene
        gene_row <- final_table[rownames(final_table) == gene_name, ]
        
        # Extract pct.1 only once
        if (!pct1_extracted) {
          pct1_value <- gene_row$pct.1
          pct1_extracted <- TRUE
        }
        
        # Extract pct.2, p_val_adj, and log2FC
        pct2_values <- c(pct2_values, gene_row$pct.2)
        p_val_adj_values <- c(p_val_adj_values, -log10(gene_row$p_val_adj + 1e-300))
        log2FC_values <- c(log2FC_values, gene_row$avg_log2FC)
        dataset <- c(dataset, dataset_name)
        sample <- c(sample, sample_name)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Boxplot
  {
    
     boxplot_data <- data.frame(
    pct_value = c(pct1_value, pct2_values),
    source = factor(c(patient_label, rep("Control", length(pct2_values))),
                    levels = c(patient_label, "Control")),  # Explicit order
    color = c("red", rep("black", length(pct2_values))),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  boxplot <- ggplot(boxplot_data, aes(x = source, y = pct_value)) +
    geom_point(data = subset(boxplot_data, source == patient_label),
               aes(color = color), size = 3) +
    geom_boxplot(data = subset(boxplot_data, source == "Control"),
                 aes(group = source),
                 outlier.shape = NA,
                 fill = "gray90",
                 color = "black") +
    geom_jitter(data = subset(boxplot_data, source == "Control"),
                aes(color = color), width = 0.2, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("red" = "red", "black" = "black"),
      labels = c("red" = patient_label, "black" = "Control")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("PCT Boxplot for Gene:", gene_name),
      x = "Group",
      y = "Percentage Value",
      color = "Legend"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
    
  }
  
  
  
  # Scatter Plot
  
  {
      scatter_data <- data.frame(
    sample = sample,
    dataset = dataset,
    neg_log10q = p_val_adj_values,
    log2FC = log2FC_values
  )
  
    title <- paste("Scatter Plot of -log10(q) vs log2(FC) of",gene_name)
    
  scatter_plot <- ggplot(scatter_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10q, color = dataset)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "-log10(q)") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "log2(FC)") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      color = "Dataset"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray80"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  }

  
  # Return the plots as a list
  return(list(boxplot = boxplot, scatter_plot = scatter_plot))
}
```

``` {r, "functions form earlier stages of the project (adaptive NK phase) "}
  pred_fine <- as.SingleCellExperiment(seu) %>%
    SingleR(ref = monaco, labels = monaco$label.fine)
    
    
    seu$SingleR_sub_labels <- pred_fine$labels
    cat(paste0("\033[31m","\nSummarize of SingleR annotation table\n"))
    # print(table(seu$SingleR_sub_labels))    
    return(seu)
    
 
  }
  
get_four_umap_basic <- function(seu,size) {
  p_clusters <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "seurat_clusters", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Seurat Clusters")
  
  p_sample <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "sample", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by sample")
  
  p_singler <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "SingleR.labels", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by SingleR Labels")
  
  p_condition <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "condition", reduction.use = "umap", size = size, opacity = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(label = "UMAP by Sample")
  
  # Combine plots into one
  p_final <- ((p_clusters + p_condition) / (p_singler + p_sample))
  
  # Return the combined plot invisibly to avoid printing in the function
  invisible(p_final)
}
  

  
get_p_avg_expr_log2_same_seurat_object <- function(seu) {
  Idents(seu) <- "orig.ident"
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "SCT"

  avg_exp <- AverageExpression(seu, assays = "SCT", group.by = "orig.ident")
  avg_exp <- as.data.frame(avg_exp)
  
  column_names <- colnames(avg_exp)

#Creating new, eazy to work with columns
{
  {if (!(length(column_names) == 2)) {
    stop("Error in the function 'get_p_avg_expr_log2': The number of unique original idents in the merged Seurat object isn't 2 as expected. Please change it accordingly")
} else if (any(grepl("Healthy", column_names[1]))) {
    avg_exp$SCT.patient <- avg_exp[[column_names[2]]]
    avg_exp$SCT.control <- avg_exp[[column_names[1]]]
} else if (any(grepl("Healthy", column_names[2]))) {
    avg_exp$SCT.patient <- avg_exp[[column_names[1]]]
    avg_exp$SCT.control <- avg_exp[[column_names[2]]]
}
  else {
    # If patient identifier is not found in either column name
    stop("Error in the function 'get_p_avg_expr_log2': patient_orig_ident was not found in any of the original idents. Please make sure to call the function with the correct patient_orig_ident.")
}
}

#Remove the original columns
avg_exp[[column_names[1]]] <- NULL
avg_exp[[column_names[2]]] <- NULL
  
}

  # Making sure the columns are numeric and making it ready for log
  avg_exp$SCT.control <- as.numeric(as.character(avg_exp$SCT.control))
  avg_exp$SCT.patient <- as.numeric(as.character(avg_exp$SCT.patient))

  avg_exp$SCT.control <- avg_exp$SCT.control + 1
  avg_exp$SCT.patient <- avg_exp$SCT.patient + 1

  line_data <- data.frame(x = range(avg_exp$SCT.control, avg_exp$SCT.patient, na.rm = TRUE))
  line_data$y <- line_data$x  # displaying the line y = x
  avg_exp <- avg_exp %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene")

gene_to_be_displayed <- avg_exp %>%
    filter(SCT.patient >= 1.5,
           SCT.patient >= SCT.control,
           SCT.patient > 2,
           SCT.control > 2) %>% pull(gene)
  
  
weird_genes <- avg_exp %>%
    filter(SCT.patient >= SCT.control,
          SCT.control <1.1,
          SCT.patient > 1.35
           ) %>% pull(gene)


housekeeping_genes <- c("B2M", "H3F3A", "MALAT1", "YBX1", "UBA52", 
                        "PSMB9", "ATP5E", "ATP5L", "UQCR11", "TOMM7")
    
# Filter genes for labeling

label_genes <- avg_exp %>%
    filter(gene %in% gene_to_be_displayed,
            !(gene %in% housekeeping_genes),
           !grepl("^MT", gene),
           !grepl("^RP", gene),
          (SCT.patient - SCT.control) >= 0.5)

  mt_genes <- (length(grep("^MT", gene_to_be_displayed)) / length(gene_to_be_displayed)) * 100
  ribo_genes <- (length(grep("^RP", gene_to_be_displayed)) / length(gene_to_be_displayed)) * 100

condition_name <- sub("-Mevorach$", "", unique(seu@meta.data$orig.ident))

plot_title <- paste0("Healthy Control (from ",unique(seu@meta.data$orig.ident),") vs ",condition_name," Patient Averaged Expression Levels")


p_avg_mon <- ggplot(avg_exp, aes(x = SCT.control, y = SCT.patient)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = ifelse(gene %in% gene_to_be_displayed, "significant", "non-significant"))) +
    geom_line(data = line_data, aes(x = x, y = y), color = "blue") +
    scale_x_continuous(trans = scales::log2_trans()) +  # Log2 scale for x-axis
    scale_y_continuous(trans = scales::log2_trans()) +  # Log2 scale for y-axis
    scale_color_manual(values = c("significant" = "red", "non-significant" = "black")) +
    labs(x = "Log2(Control)", y = "Log2(Patient)",
         title = plot_title) +
    theme_minimal() +
    guides(color = guide_legend(title = NULL)) +  # Remove legend title
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Percent of ribo_genes: %.2f%%", ribo_genes), 
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 2.1, size = 5, color = "blue") +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = Inf, label = sprintf("Percent of mt_genes: %.2f%%", mt_genes), 
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = 4.1, size = 5, color = "blue") +
    geom_text_repel(data = label_genes, aes(x = SCT.control, y = SCT.patient, label = gene),
                    size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf)  # Adding gene labels without overlap

  
print(p_avg_mon)
  
output_list <- list()
output_list$plot <- p_avg_mon
output_list$de_genes <- gene_to_be_displayed
output_list$artificat <- weird_genes
output_list$plot_title <- plot_title

  # Return the plot invisibly to avoid printing
  return(output_list)
}


    
convert_to_msigdbr_format <- function(pathway_name,db) {
  paste0(db,"_", gsub(" ", "_", toupper(pathway_name)))
}

    # filter(abs(avg_log2FC) > threshold) %>%

#And finally, print it

#Creating the other regular 3 umaps and printing them all togther

get_scpa <- function(seu, fgroup1, fgroup1_population, gene = NULL){
    #kegg
  {
    
      pathways_kegg <- msigdbr("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:KEGG") %>%
    format_pathways()
  
  results_kegg <- compare_seurat(seu,
                               assay = "SCT",
                               group1 = fgroup1, 
                               group1_population = fgroup1_population,
                               pathways = pathways_kegg,
                               parallel = TRUE,
                               cores = 4)   %>%
    mutate(Pathway = gsub("^KEGG_", "", Pathway),    # remove "KEGG_MEDICUS" 
           Pathway = tolower(Pathway),               # convert to lower case
           Pathway = gsub("_", " ", Pathway),        # replace "_" with ""
           Pathway = str_to_title(Pathway))          # Convert to title case
  

    
  results_kegg <- results_kegg %>%
    filter(FC > -0.3) %>%
    arrange(desc(qval)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  if (!is.null(gene)) {
  title <- paste("Pathway Analysis by KEGG Without", gene)
} else {
  title <- "Pathway Analysis by KEGG"
}
  
    p_pathways_kegg <- ggdotchart(results_kegg, x = "Pathway", y = "FC",  title = title,
                               color = "adjPval",
                               sorting = "descending",
                               add = "segments",
                               rotate = TRUE,
                               dot.size = 10,
                               gradient.cols = c("darkgreen", "grey"),
                               font.label = list(color = "white", size = 9, vjust = 0.5),              
                               ggtheme = theme_pubr(),
                               ylab = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
    
  }
  
  #reactom
  {
        pathways_reactom <- msigdbr("Homo sapiens", "C2", "CP:REACTOME") %>%
    format_pathways()
  
  results_reactom <- compare_seurat(seu,
                               assay = "SCT",
                               group1 = fgroup1, 
                               group1_population = fgroup1_population,
                               pathways = pathways_reactom,
                               parallel = TRUE,
                               cores = 4)   %>%
    mutate(Pathway = gsub("^REACTOME_", "", Pathway),    # remove "REACTOME_" 
           Pathway = tolower(Pathway),               # convert to lower case
           Pathway = gsub("_", " ", Pathway),        # replace "_" with ""
           Pathway = str_to_title(Pathway))          # convert to title case
  
  
  
  
  results_reactom <- results_reactom %>%
    filter(FC > -0.3) %>%
    arrange(desc(qval)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
  
  if (!is.null(gene)) {
  title <- paste("Pathway Analysis by REACTOME Without", gene)
} else {
  title <- "Pathway Analysis by REACTOME"
}  
    p_pathways_reactom <- ggdotchart(results_reactom, x = "Pathway", y = "FC", title = title,
                               color = "adjPval",
                               sorting = "descending",
                               add = "segments",
                               rotate = TRUE,
                               dot.size = 10,
                               gradient.cols = c("darkblue", "grey"),
                               font.label = list(color = "white", size = 9, vjust = 0.5),              
                               ggtheme = theme_pubr(),
                               ylab = FALSE) +
    theme(legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.key.width = unit(1, "cm"),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
          plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))
  }


  print("These are the kegg results:")
  print(results_kegg)
  print("These are the reactom results:")
  print(results_reactom)

    # Return a list with the two plots
  result_list <- list(p_pathways_kegg = p_pathways_kegg,
                      p_pathways_reactom = p_pathways_reactom,
                      results_kegg = results_kegg,
                      results_reactom = results_reactom)
  
  return(result_list)
  
  
}

get_percentage_barplot <- function(seu, groupby, data_name){
  
  title =paste("Distribution of NK cells subtypes across conditions in the",data_name,"data")
  color_palette <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73",  "#CC79A7")

  
  # Create the dittoBarPlot and extract the plot and data
plot_data <- dittoBarPlot(seu, "SingleR_NK_sub_labels", group.by = groupby, main = title,  color.panel = color_palette)

data <- plot_data$data %>%
  group_by(grouping) %>%
  arrange(label) %>%
  mutate(mid_y = case_when(
    row_number() == 1 ~ 1 - (percent / 2),
    row_number() == 2 ~ (1 - lag(percent)) - (percent / 2),
    row_number() == 3 ~ (1 - lag(percent, 2) - lag(percent, 1)) - (percent / 2),
    row_number() == 4 ~ (1 - lag(percent, 3) - lag(percent, 2)- lag(percent, 1)) - (percent / 2)    
  ))


# cumsum(percent) - 0.5 * percent
plot_data <- plot_data + geom_text(data = data, aes(x = grouping, y = mid_y, label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent * 100)), color = "white", size = 6, fontface = "bold")

return (plot_data)
  
}

get_update_nk_prcnt <- function(nk_prcnt,seu, sample, data) {
  
  
# Column existence checks
if (!(sample %in% unique(colnames(seu@meta.data)))) {
  print(paste("Column", sample, "does not exist in the data frame."))
  break
} else if (!("condition" %in% unique(colnames(seu@meta.data)))) {
  print("Column condition does not exist in the data frame.")
  break
} else {
  # Get unique conditions
  unique_samples <- unique(seu@meta.data[[sample]])
  seu$temp <- seu@meta.data[[sample]]

i=0
  for (current_sample in unique_samples) {
    # Filter seu_mevorach for the current condition
    condition_data <- subset(seu, temp == current_sample)

    # Get dataset and disease (which is the same as condition in this case)
    dataset <- unique(condition_data$orig.ident)
    disease <- unique(condition_data$condition)
    
    # Get the percentages from the 'data' table
    dim_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Dim" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)
    bright_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Bright" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)
    adaptive_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Adaptive" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)
    proliferating_prcnt <- data %>% filter(label == "Proliferating" & grouping == current_sample) %>% pull(percent)  
    
    # If no data is found, set percentages to 0
    if (length(dim_prcnt) == 0) dim_prcnt <- 0
    if (length(bright_prcnt) == 0) bright_prcnt <- 0
    if (length(adaptive_prcnt) == 0) adaptive_prcnt <- 0
    if (length(proliferating_prcnt) == 0) proliferating_prcnt <- 0
    
    # Create a new row
    new_row <- data.frame(
      sample = current_sample,
      dataset = dataset,
      disease = disease,
      dim_prcnt = dim_prcnt,
      bright_prcnt = bright_prcnt,
      adaptive_prcnt = adaptive_prcnt,
      proliferating_prcnt = proliferating_prcnt,  # Corrected spelling
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Append the new row to nk_prcnt
    nk_prcnt <- rbind(nk_prcnt, new_row)
    i=i+1
  }
      print(paste("nk_prcnt get updated",i,"times")) 

    return (nk_prcnt)

}
  


}

get_confusion_matrix <- function(seu_cd59, seu_cd55, method_column) {
  
#Checking that the method_column indeed exsists in each of the seurat objects
    if (!(method_column %in% unique(colnames(seu_cd59@meta.data)))) {
      print(paste("Column", method_column, "does not exist in the seu_cd59 data."))
      break }
      else if (!(method_column %in% unique(colnames(seu_cd55@meta.data)))) {
      print(paste("Column", method_column, "does not exist in the seu_cd55 data."))
      break } 
      
      
 else {
   
    # Create a temp column that will hold the method_column variables
    seu_cd59$temp <- seu_cd59@meta.data[[method_column]]
    seu_cd55$temp <- seu_cd55@meta.data[[method_column]]
    
    # Calculate True Positives (TP), False Positives (FP), False Negatives (FN), True Negatives (TN)
    tp <- sum(seu_cd59$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart == "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart == "NK cells")
    
    fp <- sum(seu_cd59$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart != "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp == "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart != "NK cells")
    
    fn <- sum(seu_cd59$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart == "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart == "NK cells")
    
    tn <- sum(seu_cd59$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd59$gold_standart != "NK cells") +
          sum(seu_cd55$temp != "NK cells" & seu_cd55$gold_standart != "NK cells")
    
    precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
    sensitivity <- tp / (tp + fn)
    f1_score <- 2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity)
    accuracy <- (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn)
    
    # Create a matrix for the confusion matrix
    confusion_matrix <- matrix(c(tp, fn, fp, tn), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                               dimnames = list(
                                 "Actual" = c("Actual Positive", "Actual Negative"),
                                 "Predicted" = c("Predicted Positive", "Predicted Negative")
                               ))
    
    # Create a data frame for the metrics
    metrics <- data.frame(
      Metric = c("Sensitivity", "Precision", "F1 Score", "Accuracy"),
      Value = c(sensitivity, precision, f1_score, accuracy)
    )
    
    # Combine the confusion matrix and metrics into a list
    output <- list(
      ConfusionMatrix = confusion_matrix,
      Metrics = metrics
    )
    
    # Return the output
    return(output)
      }

}

  get_four_umap_4_idenfication_methods <- function(seu_list,size = 0.8)
{
  
required_columns <- c("SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80", 
                      "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80", 
                      "nk_by_ucell", 
                      "is_nk")

# Initialize a list to collect missing column information
missing_info <- list()

# Iterate through the list of Seurat objects
for (seu_name in names(list_seu)) {
  # Get the Seurat object
  seu <- list_seu[[seu_name]]
  
  # Check for missing columns in the Seurat object's metadata
  missing_columns <- required_columns[!(required_columns %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))]
  
  # If any columns are missing, add this information to the missing_info list
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    missing_info[[seu_name]] <- missing_columns
  }
}

# After checking all Seurat objects, decide whether to continue or break
if (length(missing_info) > 0) {
  # If there are any missing columns, print the details and break
  for (seu_name in names(missing_info)) {
    print(paste("The following columns are missing in", seu_name, "data:", 
                paste(missing_info[[seu_name]], collapse = ", ")))
  }
  break
} else {

  plot_list = list()
for (seu_name in names(list_seu)) {
  # Get the Seurat object
  seu <- list_seu[[seu_name]]
  
  title <- paste(seu_name, "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")
  
  p_bleuprint <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80" , reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(label = title)

  title <- paste(seu_name, "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
  
p_monaco <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(label = title)

  title <- paste(seu_name, "Viver's positive signature")

p_ucell <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "nk_by_ucell", reduction.use = "umap", size = size) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(label = title)

  title <- paste(seu_name, "Final_confermation")

p_is_nk <- dittoDimPlot(seu, "is_nk", reduction.use = "umap", size = size, opacity = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle(label = title)

# Combine plots into one
p_final <- ((p_bleuprint +  p_monaco) / (p_ucell + p_is_nk))

plot_name <- paste0("plot_", seu_name)
plot_list[[plot_name]] <- p_final
}
}

return (plot_list)
  }
  
  
  get_confusion_matrix_solo <- function(seurat_object, method_column) {
  
  # Checking that the method_column indeed exists in the Seurat object
  if (!(method_column %in% unique(colnames(seurat_object@meta.data)))) {
    stop(paste("Column", method_column, "does not exist in the Seurat object."))
  }
  
  # Create a temp column that will hold the method_column variables
  seurat_object$temp <- seurat_object@meta.data[[method_column]]
  
  # Calculate True Positives (TP), False Positives (FP), False Negatives (FN), True Negatives (TN)
  tp <- sum(seurat_object$temp == "NK cells" & seurat_object$gold_standart == "NK cells")
  fp <- sum(seurat_object$temp == "NK cells" & seurat_object$gold_standart != "NK cells")
  fn <- sum(seurat_object$temp != "NK cells" & seurat_object$gold_standart == "NK cells")
  tn <- sum(seurat_object$temp != "NK cells" & seurat_object$gold_standart != "NK cells")
  
  # Calculate metrics
  precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
  sensitivity <- tp / (tp + fn)
  f1_score <- 2 * (precision * sensitivity) / (precision + sensitivity)
  accuracy <- (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn)
  
  # Create a matrix for the confusion matrix
  confusion_matrix <- matrix(c(tp, fn, fp, tn), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
                             dimnames = list(
                               "Actual" = c("Actual Positive", "Actual Negative"),
                               "Predicted" = c("Predicted Positive", "Predicted Negative")
                             ))
  
  # Create a data frame for the metrics
  metrics <- data.frame(
    Metric = c("Sensitivity", "Precision", "F1 Score", "Accuracy"),
    Value = c(sensitivity, precision, f1_score, accuracy)
  )
  
  # Combine the confusion matrix and metrics into a list
  output <- list(
    ConfusionMatrix = confusion_matrix,
    Metrics = metrics
  )
  
  # Return the output
  return(output)
  }
```

``` {r, "extraction functions from the neuroimmunulogical project "}
  # Download function with quite mode and 3 attempts to download each file (it assumes network problems etc)
  download_file <- function(url, output_file) {
    retries <- 3
    for(i in 1:retries) {
      command <- paste("wget -q --show-progress -O", shQuote(output_file), shQuote(url))
      exit_status <- system(command)
      if (exit_status == 0) {
        break
      }
    }
  } 
  
  is_tar_gz <- function(file_name) {
    grepl("\\.tar\\.gz$", file_name)
  }
  
  one_verified_cm <- function(dir_name) {

    list_sample <- list.files(path = dir_name, recursive = FALSE)
    list_sample <- list_sample[!file.info(list_sample)$isdir]  # Filter out directories
    list_sample <- sort(list_sample[grepl("_cm.qs", list_sample)])# Keep only files with "_cm.qs" in their names
    
    
    # Load all the count matrixes to my environment 
    for (i in seq_along(list_sample)) {
      variable_name <- gsub(".qs", "", list_sample[i]) # Remove ".qs" from the filename
      assign(variable_name, qread(list_sample[i]))
    } 
    
    #Let's change list_sample so it will have the current names of the count matrixes loaded in the enviorment
    for (i in seq_along(list_sample)) {
      list_sample[i] <- gsub(".qs", "", list_sample[i]) # Remove ".qs" from the filename
    }
    #User verification and confermation  
    cat(paste0("\033[31m", "\nThese are all ", length(list_sample), " count matrices I'm going to inspect before merging:\n", paste(list_sample, collapse=", "), "\033[39m"))
    flush.console()
    response <- readline(prompt = paste0("\033[31m", "Do you wish to continue? (enter 'y' for yes or 'n' for no):\n"))
    
    if(tolower(response) != "y") {
      cat("Operation aborted.\n")
      return(invisible())
    }
    
  
    # Checking that all the rows (genes) are the same in all the count matrixes
    {
      cat("\nChecking that all the rows (genes) are the same in all the count matrixes\n")
      
      # Initialize a list to store pairs of matrices with different rownames
      mismatched_pairs <- list()
      
      # Nested loop to compare each matrix with every other matrix
      for (i in 1:(length(list_sample) - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):length(list_sample)) {
          matrix1_name <- list_sample[i]
          matrix2_name <- list_sample[j]
          matrix1 <- get(matrix1_name)
          matrix2 <- get(matrix2_name)
          
          if (!all(rownames(matrix1) == rownames(matrix2))) {
            mismatched_pairs <- c(mismatched_pairs, paste(matrix1_name, matrix2_name, sep = " and "))
          }
        }
      }
      
      # Check if any mismatches were found
      if (length(mismatched_pairs) > 0) {
        cat("Mismatched rownames found between the following pairs of count matrices:\n")
        print(mismatched_pairs)
        return(invisible())} 
      else {
        cat("All count matrices have matching rownames.")
      }
    }
    
    # Creating a list of all the sample ids
    sample_ids <- gsub("_cm$", "", list_sample)
    
    # Making every column (cell) in each sample unique using the sample name
    # And printing the first 5 colnames of each sample to check that it worked
    {
      cat("\nMaking every column (cell) in each sample unique using the sample name\n")
      for (i in seq_along(list_sample)) {
        matrix1_name <- list_sample[i]
        matrix1 <- get(matrix1_name)
        
        # Prepend the unique ID to the column names
        colnames(matrix1) <- paste(sample_ids[i], colnames(matrix1), sep = "_")
        
        # Assign the modified matrix back to its original name in the environment
        assign(matrix1_name, matrix1)
        
        # Print the first five column names for verification
        if (ncol(matrix1) >= 5) {
          first_five_colnames <- colnames(matrix1)[1:5]
        } else {
          first_five_colnames <- colnames(matrix1)
        }
        cat("For sample",i,",here are the first five colnames\n",first_five_colnames,"\n")
      }
      
    }
    
    # Checking that each column in unique comparing to the rest of the data set
    # (So we will have no BALAGAN upon binding the count matrixes together)
    {
      cat("\nChecking that each column in unique comparing to the rest of the data set\n")
      
      # Initialize a list to keep track of all column names
      all_col_names <- vector("list", length(list_sample))
      names(all_col_names) <- list_sample
      
      # Loop to store column names of each matrix
      for (i in 1:length(list_sample)) {
        matrix_name <- list_sample[i]
        matrix <- get(matrix_name)
        all_col_names[[matrix_name]] <- colnames(matrix)
      }
      
      # Check for duplicate column names across matrices
      duplicate_found <- FALSE
      for (i in 1:(length(list_sample) - 1)) {
        for (j in (i + 1):length(list_sample)) {
          intersect_cols <- intersect(all_col_names[[list_sample[i]]], all_col_names[[list_sample[j]]])
          if (length(intersect_cols) > 0) {
            cat("Duplicate column names found between", list_sample[i], "and", list_sample[j], ":\n", paste(intersect_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
            duplicate_found <- TRUE
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (!duplicate_found) {
        cat("No duplicate column names found across matrices.")
      } else{
        cat("Operation aborted since duplicates were found.\n")
        return(invisible())
      }
      
      
    }
    
    #Finally, let's merge all these count matrixes into one big count matrix
    {

      cat(paste0("\033[31m","\nFinally, let's merge all these count matrixes into one big count matrix.\nPlease wait as it may take some time.\n"))
      
      # Assuming the first matrix in the list has the correct number of rows
      num_rows <- as.integer(nrow(get(list_sample[1])))
      
      # Initialize an empty sparse matrix with the correct dimensions
      combined_matrix <- Matrix(0, nrow = num_rows, ncol = 0, sparse = TRUE)
      
      # Iterate over each matrix name and bind them
      for (matrix_name in list_sample) {
        matrix <- get(matrix_name)
        combined_matrix <- cbind(combined_matrix, matrix)
      }
      
      # combined_matrix now contains all the matrices combined, let's save it!
      
      cat(paste0("\033[31m","\nReady to save the count matrix\n"))
      flush.console()
      response <- readline(prompt = "Please enter the name of the Seurat object to be saved:\n")
      cat(paste0("\033[31m", "\nCreating the cm\n"))
      
      # Check if a response was provided
      if (!is.na(response) && nzchar(response)) {
        qsave(combined_matrix, paste0("cm_", response, ".qs"))
        cat(paste0("\033[31m","\n",response,"_cm.qs"," waits for you at ",dir_name))
      } else {
        cat(paste0("\033[31m","\nNo valid name was entered. Saving aborted.\n"))
        return(invisible())
      }
      


    }


  }
```

``` {r, "wrong get_all_cell_types function"}
get_all_cell_types <- function(seu, n_cores = 8){
  
  
  plan(multicore, workers = n_cores)
  
  seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 80)
  
  #SingleR with Blueprint
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main,
                               clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
    )
    
    x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")
   
    seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 <-
      gsub("-", " ", seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80, fixed = TRUE)
    

  }
  
  #SingleR with Monaco
  
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main,
                               clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
                               
    )
    
    x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
  }
  
  #Ucell with Viver's NK Signature doi: 10.1016/j.immuni.2018.09.009
  
  {
    
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_nk_signature = positive_nk_signature)
    
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    seu$nk_by_ucell <- ifelse(seu$positive_nk_signature >= 0.4, "NK cells", "other")
    
  }
  
  
  #Ucell with Robinson's monocytes Signature DOI: 10.1016/j.it.2020.12.001 
  
  {
    
    
    positive_monocytes_signature <-   c(
      "CD14+",
      "CD163+",
      "FPR1+",
      "S100A9+",
      "S100A8+",
      "CLEC9A-"
    )
    
    
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_monocytes_signature = positive_monocytes_signature)
    
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    seu$monocyte_by_ucell <- ifelse(seu$positive_monocytes_signature >= 0.4, "Monocytes", "other")
    
  }
  
  #Ucell with monocytes_signature
  
  {
    
    
    positive_b_cells_signature <-   c(
      "CD19+",
      "MS4A1+",
      "CD79A+",
      "CD79B+",
      "CD22+",
      "CD24+"
    )
    
    
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_b_cells_signature = positive_b_cells_signature)
    
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    seu$b_cells_by_ucell <- ifelse(seu$positive_b_cells_signature >= 0.4, "B cells", "other")
    
  }
  
  # Final idetification
  
  seu$is_nk <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$nk_by_ucell == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "NK cells") |
      (seu$nk_by_ucell == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "NK cells") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "NK cells") ~ "NK cells",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  
  seu$is_monocyte <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$monocyte_by_ucell == "Monocytes" & seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "Monocytes") |
      (seu$monocyte_by_ucell == "Monocytes" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "Monocytes") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "Monocytes" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "Monocytes") ~ "Monocytes",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  

  
  # Final idetification
  
  seu$is_B_cell <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$b_cells_by_ucell == "B cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "B cells") |
      (seu$b_cells_by_ucell == "B cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "B cells") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "B cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "B cells") ~ "B cells",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  
  
  
  #SingleR with Blueprint clusters
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main
                               # ,clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
    )
    
    # x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    # 
    # seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(
      seu,
      metadata = setNames(singler_results$labels, rownames(singler_results)),
      col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint"
    )
    
    seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint <-
      gsub("-", " ", seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint, fixed = TRUE)
    
    bp_levels <- unique(gsub("-", " ", singler_ref$label.main))
    bp_levels <- bp_levels[order(bp_levels)]   # optional: alphabetical
    
  }
  
  #SingleR with Monaco clusters
  
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main
                               # ,clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
                               
    )
    
    # x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    # 
    # seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(
      seu,
      metadata = setNames(singler_results$labels, rownames(singler_results)),
      col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco"
    )
    
    
    mo_levels <- unique(gsub("-", " ", singler_ref$label.main))
    mo_levels <- mo_levels[order(mo_levels)]   # optional: alphabetical
  }
  
  #Ucell For CD4
  
  {
    

    positive_cd_4_signature <- c(
      "CD4+",
      "IL7R+",
      "TRAC+",
      "CD3D+",
      "CD3E+",
      "CD2+",
      # "CD40LG",
      # "IL4I1"
      # ,"FOXP3",
      "CXCR4+",
      "LTB+"    # re-introduce one homing marker to boost naïve recall
    )
    
    
    # non_classical_positive_cd_4_signature <- c(
    #    "CD4+",
    #    "CD40LG+",
    #    "IL4I1+",
    #    "FOXP3+",
    #    "CCL20+"
    #  )
    
    
    # positive_cd8_signature <- c(
    #   "CD8A+","CD8B+","CD8B2+","GZMB+","NKG7+","GNLY+","PRF1+","CD248+"
    # )
    
    positive_cd8_burden_signature <- c(
      "CD8A+","CD8B+","CD8B2+"
      # ,"GZMB+","CD248+","KLRC2","KLRC3",#  "NKG7-","GNLY-","PRF1-"
      
    )
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_cd_4_signature = positive_cd_4_signature,
      positive_cd8_burden_signature = positive_cd8_burden_signature
    )
    
    
    # This appends a column named  'positive_cd_4_signature_UCell'
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
      seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    # 3. Compute a composite score and threshold
    seu$CD4_score_primary     <- seu$positive_cd_4_signature - seu$positive_cd8_burden_signature
    # seu$CD4_score_nonclassic  <- seu$non_classical_positive_cd_4_signature - seu$positive_cd8_signature
    
    seu$cd_4_signature_by_ucell <- ifelse(
      seu$CD4_score_primary    >= 0.3,
      "CD4+ T cells", "other"
    )
    
  }
  
  # Final idetification
  
  seu$is_CD4_T_cell <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$cd_4_signature_by_ucell == "CD4+ T cells" &
       seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint == "CD4+ T cells") |
      (seu$cd_4_signature_by_ucell == "CD4+ T cells" &
         seu$SingleR.labels.monaco    == "CD4+ T cells") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint   == "CD4+ T cells" &
         seu$SingleR.labels.monaco    == "CD4+ T cells") ~ "CD4+ T cells",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  
  
  positive_cd8_signature <- c("CD8A+","CD8B+","CD8B2+", "TRAC+","LCK+","RUNX3+"                              ,"CD3E+","EOMES+"
                              ,"CD3E+","EOMES+"
                              # ,"TRDC+", "IKZF2+"
  )
  
  
  positive_cd_4_burden_signature <- c("CD4+",
                                      "CCR7+", "IL7R")
  
  positive_nk_burden_signature <- c("NCR1", "FCGR3A", "TYROBP")
  
  signatures <- list(
    positive_cd8_signature = positive_cd8_signature,
    positive_cd_4_burden_signature = positive_cd_4_burden_signature,
    positive_nk_burden_signature = positive_nk_burden_signature
  )
  
  
  # This appends a column named  'positive_cd_4_signature_UCell'
  seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
    seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
  
  # 3. Compute a composite score and threshold
  seu$CD8_to_CD4_score_primary     <- seu$positive_cd8_signature - seu$positive_cd_4_burden_signature
  seu$CD8_to_NK_score_primary     <- seu$positive_cd8_signature - seu$positive_nk_burden_signature
  
  
  seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell <- ifelse(
    (seu$CD8_to_CD4_score_primary >= 0.3) |
      (seu$CD8_to_NK_score_primary >= 0.3),
    "CD8+ T cells",
    "other"
  )
  
  seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell <- ifelse((seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell == "CD8+ T cells" & 
                                           seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells"), "other",seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell)
  
  seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint_modified <- factor(
    case_when(
      seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint == "CD8+ T cells" &
        seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells" ~ "CD4+ T cells",
      TRUE ~ as.character(seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint)
    ),
    levels = bp_levels
  )
  
  seu$SingleR.labels.monaco_modified <- factor(
    case_when(
      seu$SingleR.labels.monaco == "CD8+ T cells" &
        seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells" ~ "CD4+ T cells",
      TRUE ~ as.character(seu$SingleR.labels.monaco)
    ),
    levels = mo_levels
  )


# Final idetification

seu$is_CD8_T_cell <- dplyr::case_when(
  (seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell == "CD8+ T cells" &
     seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint_modified == "CD8+ T cells") |
    (seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell == "CD8+ T cells" &
       seu$SingleR.labels.monaco_modified    == "CD8+ T cells") |
    (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint_modified   == "CD8+ T cells" &
       seu$SingleR.labels.monaco_modified    == "CD8+ T cells") ~ "CD8+ T cells",
  TRUE ~ "other"
)

  
    seu$final_cell_type <- dplyr::case_when(
      seu$is_nk == "NK cells" ~ "NK cells",
      seu$is_monocyte == "Monocytes" ~ "Monocytes",
      seu$is_B_cell == "B cells" ~ "B cells",
      seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells" ~ "CD4+ T cells",
      seu$is_CD8_T_cell == "CD8+ T cells" ~ "CD8+ T cells",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  
  return(seu)
}
```

``` {r, "CD59 NKs: finding far from the slope gene"}

#finding far from the slope genes
{
  
  
  meta_table <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/meta_tables/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_meta_table.qs")
  nk_integration_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/integrated_objects/neuroimmunulogical-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_integrated.qs")
  de_table <- nk_integration_list$de_table
  
  
  
  de_table$gene <- rownames(de_table)
  # try <- get_linear_regression(meta_table = nk_meta_table, de_table = de_table, highlight_genes = c("S100B", "JUNB", "CXCR4", "KLRC3", "LAT"),
  #                              title_suffix = "yo bro")
  
  meta_table$avg_log2FC <- NULL
  
  
  
  # Inner join on gene
  merged <- merge(meta_table, de_table, by = "gene")
  
  
  
  # Flag genes that start with "AC[digits]", "AL[digits]", "AP[digits]", "MT", or "RP"
  merged$special <- ifelse(
    grepl("^(AC[0-9]+|AL[0-9]+|AP[0-9]+|MT|RP)", merged$gene),
    "Non-Coding, Mitochondrial and Ribosomal Genes",
    "Other Genes"
  )
  
  
  lm_model <- lm(avg_log2FC ~ median_log2FC, data = merged)
  linear_regression_slope <- coef(lm_model)["median_log2FC"]
  lm_fit      <- lm(avg_log2FC ~ median_log2FC, data = merged)
  
  
  
  # Calculate correlation
  effect_size_correlation <- get_effect_size_correlation(
    meta_table             = meta_table,
    de_table               = de_table,
    meta_effect_size_column= "median_log2FC",
    int_effect_size_column = "avg_log2FC"
  )
  
  
  merged$yhat <- predict(lm_fit, newdata = merged)
  merged$res  <- merged$avg_log2FC - merged$yhat          # signed vertical distance
  merged$abs_res <- abs(merged$res)                       # magnitude
  
  distance_threshold <- 0.8      # “far from the line”; tweak later
  forced <- c("MAP3K8", "CXCR4", "JUNB", "S100B", "LAT")
  
  selected_genes <- merged %>%
    filter(
      # either meets your original criteria …
      (avg_log2FC    >  yhat &
         median_log2FC <= -3 &
         abs_res       >= distance_threshold)
      # … or is one of the forced genes
      | gene %in% forced
    ) %>%
    filter(
      # drop unwanted prefixes …
      !grepl("^(AC[0-9]+|AL[0-9]+|AP[0-9]+|MT|RP)", gene)
      # … but always keep the forced genes
      | gene %in% forced
    )
  
  
  # selected_genes <- merged %>%
  #   filter( gene %in% forced
  #   ) %>%
  #   filter(
  #     # drop unwanted prefixes …
  #     !grepl("^(AC[0-9]+|AL[0-9]+|AP[0-9]+|MT|RP)", gene)
  #     # … but always keep the forced genes
  #     | gene %in% forced
  #   )
  
  intercept <- coef(lm_fit)[1]
  slope     <- coef(lm_fit)[2]
  
  selected_genes_df <- selected_genes %>%
    dplyr::select(gene,
                  PDE_median_log2FC = median_log2FC,
                  DSI               = dsi,             # change if your column is named differently
                  Integration_log2FC = avg_log2FC) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(
      methods_diff         = PDE_median_log2FC - Integration_log2FC,
      distance_from_slope  = abs(
        Integration_log2FC 
        - (intercept + slope * PDE_median_log2FC)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(distance_from_slope))
  
  highlight_genes <- selected_genes_df$gene
  label_data      <- selected_genes
  
  label_data <- label_data %>%
    mutate(
      y_hat    = predict(lm_fit, newdata = .),
      nudge_y  = ifelse(avg_log2FC >= y_hat,   # point is above the line?
                        0.3,                  # → push label upward
                        -0.3)                  # → push label downward
    )
  
  
  
  
  
  p <- ggplot(merged, aes(x = median_log2FC, y = avg_log2FC, fill = special)) +
    geom_point(shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 3, stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
    
    ## —— highlight genes, now with per-point nudges ——
    geom_label_repel(
      data          = label_data,
      aes(label = gene, nudge_y = nudge_y),   # ← the key line
      colour        = "white",
      fontface      = "bold",
      size          = 5,
      box.padding   = 0.5,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      segment.color = "grey40",
      segment.size  = 0.4,
      max.overlaps  = Inf,
      show.legend   = FALSE
    ) +
    
    ## regression line (unchanged)
    geom_smooth(
      aes(group = 1),                 # ← guarantees a single fit
      method = "lm",
      se     = FALSE,
      colour = "black",
      size   = 0.8
    ) +
    
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "darkgrey", size = 0.8) +
    
    annotate(
      "text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1.1,
      label = paste0(
        "Linear Regression Slope: ",  round(coef(lm_fit)[2], 2),
        "\nEffect Size Correlation (Pearson): ",
        round(effect_size_correlation$effect_size_pearson_correlation, 2)
      ),
      size = 6, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Non-Coding, Mitochondrial and Ribosomal Genes" = "#56B4E9",
        "Other Genes"                                   = "#009E73"
      ),
      name = "Gene Group",
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(shape = 21, colour = "black",
                            stroke = 0.5, size = 5, linetype = 0)
      )
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = "PDE Median log2FC vs. Integration log2FC in CD59-Deficient NK Cells",
      x     = "PDE Median log2FC",
      y     = "Integration log2FC"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 24),
      axis.title   = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 16),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      plot.margin      = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)  # give labels a bit more air
    )
  
  
  
  pdf("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/tryp.pdf", width = 26, height = 20)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
}
```

``` {r, "CD59 NKs: Finding the best seu_merge"}
#Finding the best seu_merge
{
  one_on_one_return_seu_merge <- function(seu_patient,seu_control,patient_type="patient",control_type="Healthy",
                                          patient_orig_ident ="Mevorach") {
    # browser()
    #intial_check
    {
      
      #Checking that the method_column indeed exsists in each of the seurat objects
      if (!("condition" %in% unique(colnames(seu_patient@meta.data)))) {
        print(paste("The condition column does not exist in seu_patient"))
        break }
      else if (!("condition" %in% unique(colnames(seu_control@meta.data)))) {
        print(paste("The condition column does not exist in seu_control"))
        break }
      
      else if (!(control_type %in% unique(seu_control$condition))) {
        print(paste("The condition", control_type,"does not exist in the seu_control"))
        break }
      
      else if (!(patient_type %in% unique(seu_patient$condition))) {
        print(paste("The condition", patient_type,"does not exist in the seu_patient"))
        break }
      else if (!("sample" %in% unique(colnames(seu_control@meta.data)))) {
        print("The sample column does not exist in  seu_control")
        break }  
      else if (!("sample" %in% unique(colnames(seu_patient@meta.data)))) {
        print("The sample column does not exist in  seu_patient")
        break }  
      
    }  
    
    
    
    sample_output_list <- list()
    
    seu_control <- subset(seu_control,subset= condition == control_type)
    seu_patient <- subset(seu_patient,subset= condition == patient_type)
    
    #For each "healthy" sample in seu_control 
    for (control_sample in unique(seu_control$sample)) {
      
      #Subset to the that one healthy sample
      seu_control_sample <- subset(seu_control,subset= sample == control_sample)
      
      de_markers_list <- list()
      
      #Run downsample + SCT + FindMarkers 3 times
      #(Because in each downsample iteration, the count matrix changes up a little bit)
      for (i in 1:3) {
        
        #call the downsample function
        seurats_post_downsample <-  tryCatch({
          downsample_by_porp (seu_control_sample, seu_patient)
        }, error = function(e) {
          stop("The function one_on_one failed because the function downsample_by_porp encountered an error: ", e$message)
        })
        
        
        
        
        # creating and manipulating seu_merge
        seu_merge <- merge(seurats_post_downsample$seu_control_sample
                           ,seurats_post_downsample$seu_patient)
        
        
        seu_merge@active.assay <- "RNA"
        seu_merge[["SCT"]] <- NULL
        
        seu_merge[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(seu_merge[["RNA"]])
        
        seu_merge <- SCTransform(seu_merge, vars.to.regress = "percent_mito", verbose = TRUE, conserve.memory = TRUE)
        
        Idents(seu_merge) <- "condition"
        
        #maybe we should remove the "matching_item"
        patient_group <-   matching_item <- unique(seu_merge@active.ident)[grep(patient_orig_ident, unique(seu_merge@active.ident))]
        
        de_markers <- FindMarkers(seu_merge, ident.1 = patient_type, group.by = 'condition',logfc.threshold = 0, min.pct = 0,min.cells.feature = 0)
        head(de_markers)
        
        # Save the result of this iteration into the list
        de_markers_list[[i]] <- de_markers
        gc()
        
      }
      
      
      # Find the intersection of genes across all 3 tables
      {
        reoccuring_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(de_markers_list, rownames))
        
        # Filter each table to retain only the common genes
        filtered_tables <- lapply(de_markers_list, function(tbl) tbl[reoccuring_genes, ])
        
        # Combine the filtered tables into a single array for averaging
        # This assumes all tables are filtered to have the same genes and structure
        combined_data <- abind::abind(filtered_tables, along = 3)
        
        # Compute the average across the 3rd dimension (iterations) for each gene and each column
        averaged_table <- apply(combined_data, c(1, 2), mean)
        
        # Convert the resulting matrix into a data frame for easier handling
        final_table <- as.data.frame(averaged_table)
        
        # Set row names to the gene names
        rownames(final_table) <- reoccuring_genes
        
      }
      
      
      #Filter out housekeeping, ribosomal, mitochondrial and hemoglobin genes
      
      original_table <- final_table
      final_table <- filter_housekeeping_genes(original_table)
      #get the log2 expression scatter plot
      
      plot_and_data <- tryCatch({
        get_p_avg_expr_log2 (seu_merge , patient_type,control_type)
      }, error = function(e) {
        stop("The function one_on_one failed because the function get_p_avg_expr_log2 encountered an error: ", e$message)
      })
      
      #violin plot
      {
        plot <- VlnPlot(seu_merge, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mito","nCount_SCT","nFeature_SCT"), group.by = "condition" ,ncol = 5)
        
        violin_title <- sub(" Patient Averaged Expression Levels$", "", plot_and_data$plot_title)
        
        # Add centered overarching title and print the plot
        print(
          plot + plot_annotation(
            title = violin_title,
            theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))  # hjust = 0.5 centers the title
          )
        )
        
      }
      
      
      # saving plot_and_data in sample_output_list  
      sample_output_list[[control_sample]] <- c(
        plot_and_data, 
        list(final_table = final_table, original_table = original_table),
        seu_merge = seu_merge
      )
      
      
      
      
    }
    
    
    seurat_output_list <- list()
    
    seurat_output_list[[as.character(unique(seu_control$orig.ident)[1])]] <- sample_output_list
    
    
    
    
    return(seurat_output_list) 
    
  }

    below_y_line             = -1
```
