``` {r, "CD59 NKs: Finding the best seu_merge"}
    full_y_variable_name     = "Median log2 Fold Change"
    display_house_keeping_labels = TRUE
    # costume_de_genes         = c("S100B", "MAP3K8", "LAT")
    # costume_de_genes <- c("ATF3", "GADD45G", "GSTM1", "RGS16", "TMEM2", "WASHC1","S100B")
    costume_de_genes <- c("S1PR4", "ID3", "JUNB", "FOS")
    
    # needed changes for the meta_table
    {
      meta_table$gene_name <- rownames(meta_table)
      meta_table[[y_variable]] <- as.numeric(as.character(meta_table[[y_variable]]))
      meta_table[[x_variable]] <- as.numeric(as.character(meta_table[[x_variable]]))
    }
    
    joshi_hk_genes <- read_excel("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/joshi_low_gini_coefficients_genes.xlsx")
    levanon_hk_genes <- read_excel("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/levanon_housekeeping_genes.xlsx")
    hk_genes <- unique(c(joshi_hk_genes$hgnc_symbol, levanon_hk_genes$gene_name))
    meta_table$gene_type <- ifelse(meta_table$gene_name %in% hk_genes, "Housekeeping Gene", "Non-Housekeeping Gene")
    
    # Define axis values
    x_breaks <- seq(-24, 24, by = 8)
    y_breaks <- seq(-10, 10, by = 5)
    
    # Define y-axis limits (make sure they cover your range + margin)
    y_axis_limit <- max(abs(meta_table[[y_variable]]), na.rm = TRUE)
    y_axis_limit <- ceiling(max(y_axis_limit, 10))
    custom_y_breaks <- sort(unique(c(seq(-y_axis_limit, y_axis_limit, by = 5), below_y_line, upper_y_line)))
    
    # Define x-axis limit
    x_axis_limit <- max(meta_table$comparisons_num)
    
    # Calculate threshold for gene labeling
    computed_upper_threshold <- max(meta_table$comparisons_num) * upper_threshold
    computed_lower_threshold <- max(meta_table$comparisons_num) * below_threshold
    
    # Subset for labeling using vectorized operator '|'
    label_data <- meta_table %>%
      filter(.data[[x_variable]] >= computed_upper_threshold |
               .data[[x_variable]] <= computed_lower_threshold)
    
    if (!display_house_keeping_labels) {
      label_data <- label_data %>%
        filter(gene_type == "Non-Housekeeping Gene")
    }
    
    if (!is.null(costume_de_genes)) {
      label_data <- meta_table %>%
        filter(gene_name %in% costume_de_genes)
    }
    
    # Begin plot
    p_scatter_avg_log2fc <- ggplot(meta_table, aes_string(x = x_variable, y = y_variable)) + 
      # Points colored by gene type
      geom_point(aes(fill = gene_type),
                 shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Housekeeping Gene" = "black", 
                                   "Non-Housekeeping Gene" = "firebrick")) +
      
      # Label selected genes
      geom_label_repel(
        data = label_data,
        aes(label = gene_name, fill = gene_type),
        color = "white",
        fontface = "bold",
        size = 15,
        box.padding = 0.5,
        point.padding = 0.3,
        segment.color = "gray40",
        segment.size = 0.4,
        max.overlaps = Inf,
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      
      # Horizontal dashed lines at y = ±1
      geom_hline(yintercept = c(1, -1), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
      
      # Solid horizontal grid lines at -10, -5, 0, 5, 10
      geom_hline(yintercept = y_breaks, linetype = "solid", color = "gray85", size = 0.3) +
      
      # Solid vertical grid lines at x_breaks
      geom_vline(xintercept = x_breaks, linetype = "solid", color = "gray85", size = 0.3) +
      
      # Vertical line at x = 0 (stronger emphasis)
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgrey", size = 0.8) +
      
      # Axis settings
      scale_x_continuous(
        name = full_x_variable_name,
        limits = c(-x_axis_limit, x_axis_limit),
        breaks = x_breaks
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        name =  full_y_variable_name,
        limits = c(-y_axis_limit, y_axis_limit),
        breaks = custom_y_breaks
      ) +
      
      # Title and theme
      labs(
        title = "PDE Plot: DSI vs. Median Log2FC of CD59-Deficient B-cells",
        fill = "Gene type"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 40),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),  # Disable default grid
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom"           # <<< Moved legend to bottom
      )
    
    
    p_scatter_avg_log2fc <- (
      p_scatter_avg_log2fc +
        guides(                                   # enlarge legend dots
          colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 14)),
          fill   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 14)))
    ) &                                             # convert to patchwork *after*
      theme(
        legend.title     = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
        legend.key.size  = unit(1.6, "cm"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(0.6, "cm")
      )
    
    ggsave(
      "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/B_cells/scatter_plot_cd59_kang_big_labels.jpg",
      p_scatter_avg_log2fc,
      width  = 20, height = 13, units = "in", dpi = 600,
      device  = "jpeg", type = "cairo", quality = 100
    )    
    
  }
  
  
  
  #Creating forest plots with bigger titles and legeneds
  {

    
    output_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
    
    
    four_genes_vector <- c("S1PR4","ID3","JUNB","FOS")
    
    get_4_forest_plots_bigger_title_and_legends <- function(output_list,
                                                            four_genes_vector) {
      # ─────────── sanity check ─────────── #
      if (!is.vector(four_genes_vector) || length(four_genes_vector) != 4) {
        stop(sprintf(
          "four_genes_vector must contain exactly four genes – you supplied %d.",
          length(four_genes_vector)
        ))
      }
      
      # ─────────── helper sizes ─────────── #
      title_size   <- 30
      legend_ttl   <- 22
      legend_txt   <- 24
      legend_dot   <- 14
      
      # ─────────── build plots ──────────── #
      plot_list <- setNames(vector("list", 4), paste0("plot_", LETTERS[1:4]))
      
      for (i in seq_along(four_genes_vector)) {
        gene        <- four_genes_vector[i]
        forest_tbl  <- get_table_for_forest(output_list, gene)
        
        base_plot <- create_forest_plot(forest_tbl, gene)
        
        ## 1) enlarge dots in legend (ggplot layer) ----------
        base_plot <- base_plot +
          guides(
            colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = legend_dot)),
            fill   = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = legend_dot))
          )
        
        ## 2) enlarge title + legend (patchwork layer) -------
        forest_plot <- base_plot &                                # convert to patchwork
          theme(
            plot.title      = ggtext::element_markdown(           # same class as source
              size = title_size, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5
            ),
            legend.title    = element_text(size = legend_ttl, face = "bold"),
            legend.text     = element_text(size = legend_txt, face = "bold"),
            legend.key.size = grid::unit(1.6, "cm"),
            legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.6, "cm")
          )
        
        plot_list[[i]] <- forest_plot
      }
      
      # ─────────── tag panels (A-D) ────────── #
      tag_vec <- LETTERS[1:4]
      plot_list <- Map(
        function(p, tag) {
          p + ggplot2::annotate(
            "text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
            label = tag, hjust = -0.5, vjust = 1.5,
            size = 10, fontface = "bold"
          )
        },
        plot_list, tag_vec
      )
      names(plot_list) <- paste0("plot_", tag_vec)
      
      # ─────────── assemble 2×2 grid ───────── #
      (plot_list$plot_A + plot_list$plot_B) /
        (plot_list$plot_C + plot_list$plot_D)
    }
    
    
    four_forest_plots_bigger_title_and_legends <- get_4_forest_plots_bigger_title_and_legends(output_list, four_genes_vector)
    
    
    ggsave(
      "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/B_cells/forest_plot_bigger_title_and_legends.jpg",
      four_forest_plots_bigger_title_and_legends,
      width  = 30, height = 23, units = "in", dpi = 600,
      device  = "jpeg", type = "cairo", quality = 100
    )
  }
}
```

```{r, "old build_gene_presence_df function", eval=FALSE}

build_gene_presence_df <- function(pathway_list) {
  
  ## 1 ─ map list-element names → output columns -----------------------------
  cell_lookup <- c(
    NK          = "NK",
    monocytes   = "Monocytes",
    B_cells     = "B_cells",
    CD4_T_cells = "CD4_T_cells",
    CD8_T_cells = "CD8_T_cells"
  )
  
  ## 2 ─ collect Entrez IDs & convert via biomaRt ----------------------------
  entrez_pool <- unlist(lapply(pathway_list, function(df) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(!stringr::str_detect(dataset, stringr::regex("^hallmark$", TRUE))) %>%
      dplyr::pull(core_enrichment) %>%
      stringr::str_split("/") %>%
      unlist()
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  
  if (length(entrez_pool)) {
    mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl(
      biomart = "genes",
      dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl",
      mirror  = "useast"
    )
    map_tbl <- biomaRt::getBM(
      attributes = c("entrezgene_id", "hgnc_symbol"),
      filters    = "entrezgene_id",
      values     = unique(entrez_pool),
      mart       = mart
    )
    entrez2symbol <- setNames(map_tbl$hgnc_symbol,
                              as.character(map_tbl$entrezgene_id))
  } else {
    entrez2symbol <- setNames(character(0), character(0))
  }
  
  ## 3 ─ initialise result & group counters ---------------------------------
  output_df <- tibble::tibble(
    gene        = character(),
    NK          = logical(),
    Monocytes   = logical(),
    B_cells     = logical(),
    CD4_T_cells = logical(),
    CD8_T_cells = logical(),
    pathway_group       = character()
  )
  group_counts <- list()   # named integer vector per gene
  
  ## 4 ─ iterate through each data-frame ------------------------------------
  for (elt in names(pathway_list)) {
    message("➜ Processing ‘", elt, "’ …")
    df       <- pathway_list[[elt]]
    generic  <- sub("_gsea_clean_.*$", "", elt)
    colname  <- cell_lookup[[generic]]
    if (is.null(colname)) stop("Unknown list element: ", elt)
    
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(df))) {
      row        <- df[i, ]
      this_group <- row$group
      
      genes_raw <- stringr::str_split(row$core_enrichment, "/")[[1]]
      genes_sym <- if (stringr::str_detect(row$dataset,
                                           stringr::regex("^hallmark$", TRUE))) {
        genes_raw
      } else {
        unname(entrez2symbol[genes_raw])
      }
      genes_sym <- genes_sym[!is.na(genes_sym) & genes_sym != ""]
      
      for (g in genes_sym) {
        
        ## ---------- update group counter safely ----------
        if (!is.null(this_group) && nzchar(this_group)) {
          if (is.null(group_counts[[g]])) group_counts[[g]] <- integer()
          if (is.na(group_counts[[g]][this_group])) group_counts[[g]][this_group] <- 0L
          group_counts[[g]][this_group] <- group_counts[[g]][this_group] + 1L
        }
        
        ## ---------- update presence matrix ---------------
        if (g %in% output_df$gene) {
          output_df[[colname]][output_df$gene == g] <- TRUE
        } else {
          new_row <- tibble::tibble(
            gene        = g,
            NK          = FALSE,
            Monocytes   = FALSE,
            B_cells     = FALSE,
            CD4_T_cells = FALSE,
            CD8_T_cells = FALSE,
            pathway_group       = this_group
          )
          new_row[[colname]] <- TRUE
          output_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(output_df, new_row)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  ## 5 ─ majority-vote resolve of ambiguities --------------------------------
  for (g in names(group_counts)) {
    counts <- group_counts[[g]]
    counts[is.na(counts)] <- 0L          # ensure always numeric
    maj    <- names(counts)[which.max(counts)]
    output_df$group[output_df$gene == g] <- maj
  }
  
  output_df
}
```

```{r, "old get_core_enrichment_genes_violin_plot function", eval=FALSE}

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  get_core_enrichment_genes_violin_plot()
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  • Builds a long “gene × intersection” tibble from a list of meta-tables.
#  • Checks that every meta-table has `gene` and the chosen metric column.
#  • Computes mean(metric) for each intersection rule in `group_defs_inclusive`.
#  • Optionally labels user-supplied core-signature genes.
#  • Returns a ready-to-print ggplot object.
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

get_core_enrichment_genes_violin_plot <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    upset_output_df,
    metric,
    group_defs_inclusive,
    plot_title,
    legend_breaks   = NULL,
    core_signature  = NULL,
    recode_map      = NULL,                #  <── NEW
    group_palette   = c(
      "Proliferation"                     = "#E9A5F1",
      "Metabolism / Cellular Respiration" = "#B2DF8A",
      "Stress Response"                   = "#fb8500",
      "Pro Inflammatory"                  = "firebrick",
      "Pro Inhibitory"                    = "#48CAE4",
      "Migration / Chemotaxis"            = "#2C6E49"
    ),
    ylab_text     = NULL,      # default constructed below
    dash_y        ,         # dashed reference line
    dash_label    , # label for the dashed line
    big_title = 24,
    big_axis  = 20,
    big_txt   = 16
) {
  
  # browser()
  
  #──────────────────── 0. Sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────
  bad_gene <- names(meta_table_list)[
    vapply(meta_table_list, function(df) !"gene" %in% colnames(df), logical(1))
  ]
  if (length(bad_gene) > 0)
    stop("Missing `gene` column in: ", paste(bad_gene, collapse = ", "))
  
  bad_metric <- names(meta_table_list)[
    vapply(meta_table_list, function(df) !metric %in% colnames(df), logical(1))
  ]
  if (length(bad_metric) > 0)
    stop("'", metric, "' column not found in: ", paste(bad_metric, collapse = ", "))
  
  
  # do the required-set names all appear in the meta-table list?
  known_sets <- stringr::str_remove(names(meta_table_list), "_meta_table$")
  bad_sets <- setdiff(
    unique(unlist(map(group_defs_inclusive, "required"))),
    known_sets
  )
  if (length(bad_sets) > 0)
    stop("Unknown set names in `group_defs_inclusive`: ",
         paste(bad_sets, collapse = ", "))
  
  ## ---------- recode_map sanity ------------------------------------------
  if (!is.null(recode_map)) {
    if (is.null(names(recode_map)) || any(names(recode_map) == ""))
      stop("`recode_map` must be a *named* character vector (gene = \"group\").")
    unknown_groups <- setdiff(unname(recode_map), names(group_palette))
    if (length(unknown_groups))
      stop("Unknown pathway groups in `recode_map`: ",
           paste(unique(unknown_groups), collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  #──────────────────── 1. wide matrix (gene × celltype metric) ────────────
  dsi_wide <- meta_table_list %>%
    imap(~ .x %>%
           dplyr::select(gene, !!metric) %>%
           rename(!!str_remove(.y, "_meta_table") := !!metric)) %>%
    reduce(full_join, by = "gene")
  
  # helper to pull genes present in the required sets and absent in forbidden
  get_genes <- function(df, req, forb) {
    df %>%
      filter(
        if_all(all_of(req),  ~ .x),
        if_all(all_of(forb), ~ !.x)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(gene, pathway_group)
  }
  
  #──────────────────── 2. long table with mean metric per intersection ────
  long_tbl <- imap_dfr(group_defs_inclusive, function(rule, grp_name) {
    g_tbl <- get_genes(upset_output_df %||%
                         stop("upset_output_df not found"),  # fallback
                       rule$required, rule$forbidden)
    
    dsi_cols <- map_chr(rule$required, function(ct) {
      col_match <- names(dsi_wide)[tolower(names(dsi_wide)) == tolower(ct)]
      if (length(col_match) == 0)
        stop("Column for cell type ‘", ct, "’ not found in dsi_wide")
      col_match
    })
    
    g_tbl %>%
      left_join(dsi_wide, by = "gene") %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        intersection_group = grp_name,
        avg_metric         = mean(c_across(all_of(dsi_cols)), na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      dplyr::select(intersection_group, gene, pathway_group, avg_metric)
  })
  
  ## ---------- manual pathway-group overrides -----------------------------
  if (!is.null(recode_map)) {
    long_tbl <- long_tbl %>%
      mutate(
        pathway_group = dplyr::recode(
          gene,
          !!!recode_map,                    # splice the named vector
          .default = pathway_group          # keep original if not listed
        )
      )
  }
  
  # tidy pathway-group label
  # long_tbl <- long_tbl %>%
  #   mutate(pathway_group = ifelse(
  #     pathway_group == "Stress",
  #     "Replication-Stress Response",
  #     pathway_group
  #   ))
  # 
  long_tbl$intersection_group <- factor(
    long_tbl$intersection_group,
    levels = names(group_defs_inclusive)
  )
  
  #──────────────────── 3. legend breaks ───────────────────────────────────
  breaks_to_show <- if (is.null(legend_breaks)) {
    names(group_palette)
  } else {
    setdiff(names(group_palette), legend_breaks)
  }
  
  #──────────────────── 4. label table (core signature) ────────────────────
  if (is.null(core_signature) || length(core_signature) == 0) {
    
    ## keep all the columns but zero rows ⟶ ggplot finds the
    ## aesthetics yet no labels are drawn
    label_tbl <- long_tbl %>% dplyr::slice(0)
    
  } else {
    
    missing_core <- setdiff(core_signature, long_tbl$gene)
    if (length(missing_core) > 0)
      stop("These core-signature genes not found in data: ",
           paste(missing_core, collapse = ", "))
    
    label_tbl <- dplyr::filter(long_tbl, gene %in% core_signature)
  }
  
  #──────────────────── 5. build the violin plot ───────────────────────────
  if (is.null(ylab_text)) {                                          # ← modified
    ylab_text <- switch(tolower(metric),                             # ← new
                        "dsi"           = "Average DSI per Gene",
                        "median_log2fc" = 'Average "Median Log2FC" per Gene',
                        paste("Average", metric, "per Gene"))
  }
  
  pos_jit <- position_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0)

  violin_plot <- ggplot(long_tbl,
                        aes(x = intersection_group, y = avg_metric)) +

    ## violin outline ----------------------------------------------------------
  geom_violin(
    fill      = NA,
    colour    = "black",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    width     = 0.9,
    trim      = FALSE
  ) +

    ## reference lines ---------------------------------------------------------
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,      linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = 0,      label = "y = 0",
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = dash_y, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = dash_y, label = dash_label,
             hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 6) +

    ## jittered dots -----------------------------------------------------------
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = pathway_group),
    shape    = 21,
    colour   = "black",
    size     = 3,
    stroke   = 0.5,
    alpha    = 0.9,
    position = pos_jit
  ) +

    ## labels locked to the same jitter ----------------------------------------
  geom_label_repel(
    data          = label_tbl,
    aes(label = gene, fill = pathway_group),
    position      = pos_jit,      # ← identical jitter
    colour        = "white",
    fontface      = "bold",
    size          = 5,
    box.padding   = 0.25,
    point.padding = 0.15,
    segment.color = "grey40",
    segment.size  = 0.4,
    max.overlaps  = Inf,
    show.legend   = FALSE
  ) +

    ## colours & legend --------------------------------------------------------
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = group_palette,
    breaks = breaks_to_show,
    name   = "Pathway group",
    guide  = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 21, colour = "black",
                          stroke = 0.5, size = 5, alpha = 1)
    )
  ) +

    ## labels & theme ----------------------------------------------------------
  labs(
    x     = "Intersection Group",
    y     = ylab_text,
    title = plot_title
  ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = big_txt) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = big_title),
      axis.title.x     = element_text(size = big_axis),
      axis.title.y     = element_text(size = big_axis),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = big_txt),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      plot.margin      = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )



  
  list(violin_plot = violin_plot,
       long_tbl = long_tbl)
}
```

```{r, "old get_core_enrichment_genes_violin_plot function", eval=FALSE}
get_upset_plot <- function(
    df,
    plot_title ,
    recode_genes   = NULL,
    sets           = c("Monocytes", "NK", "B_cells", "CD4_T_cells", "CD8_T_cells"),
    group_palette  = c(
      "Proliferation"                     = "#E9A5F1",
      "Metabolism / Cellular Respiration" = "#B2DF8A",
      "Replication-Stress"                 = "#fb8500",
      "Oxidative-Stress"                 = "#ffb703", 
      "p53-Senescence"                 = "#03045e", 
      "Pro Inflammatory"                  = "firebrick",
      "Pro Inhibitory"                    = "#48CAE4",
      "Migration / Chemotaxis"            = "#2C6E49",
      "Other"                             = "grey"
    ),
    legend_breaks  = NULL,
    intersections  = NULL,
    big_title = 28,
    big_axis  = 26,
    big_txt   = 22,
    big_legend = 22,
    my_themes = NULL,
    mode      = "exclusive_intersection",
    ...
) {
  
  ## ── recode genes  (unchanged) ─────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(recode_genes)) {
    df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        pathway_group = dplyr::case_when(
          gene %in% names(recode_genes) ~ unname(recode_genes[gene]),
          TRUE                          ~ pathway_group
        )
      )
  }
  
  ## ── legend breaks  (unchanged) ────────────────────────────────────
  breaks_to_show <- if (is.null(legend_breaks)) {
    names(group_palette)
  } else {
    setdiff(names(group_palette), legend_breaks)
  }
  
  ## ── intersections/min_degree setup (unchanged) ────────────────────
  if (is.null(intersections)) {
    intersections_param <- "all";      min_degree_param <- 0 #
  } else {
    intersections_param <- intersections; min_degree_param <- 0
  }
  
  ## ── themes (unchanged) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(my_themes)) {
    my_themes <- ComplexUpset::upset_modify_themes(list(
      'intersections_matrix' = ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt),
        axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
        axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank()
      ),
      'Intersection size' = ggplot2::theme(
        axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt, family = "sans"),
        axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis, family = "sans"),
        legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_legend,
                                             family = "sans"),
        legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_legend, family = "sans"),
      ),
      'overall_sizes' = ggplot2::theme(
        axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
        axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt),
        axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_blank()
      ),
      'default' = ggplot2::theme(text = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt, family = "sans"))
    ))
  }
  
  ## ── *** NEW PART: work out y-limit *** ────────────────────────────
  y_lim <- get_intersection_ylim(
    df   = df,
    sets = sets,
    intersections = if (is.null(intersections)) NULL else intersections,
    mode = mode
  )
  
  # int_sizes <- ComplexUpset::intersection_size_data(
  #   df,
  #   intersect = tidyselect::all_of(sets),
  #   mode      = mode,
  #   intersections = intersections_param
  # )
  # 
  # y_lim <- max(int_sizes$size) * 1.05        # 5 % head-room

browser()
  ComplexUpset::upset(
    df,
    intersect             = tidyselect::all_of(sets),
    name                  = "Cell Type",
    encode_sets           = FALSE,
    intersections         = intersections_param,
    mode                  = mode,
    sort_intersections_by = "cardinality",
    sort_intersections    = "ascending",
    sort_sets             = FALSE,
    keep_empty_groups     = TRUE,
    width_ratio           = 0.12,
    wrap                  = TRUE,
    themes                = my_themes,
    min_degree            = min_degree_param,
    base_annotations = list(
      "Intersection size" =
        ComplexUpset::intersection_size(
          counts  = TRUE,
          mapping = ggplot2::aes(fill = pathway_group),
          text    = list(size = 6),
          mode    = mode
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
          # limits = c(0, y_lim),
          expand = c(0, 0)
        ) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
          values = group_palette,
          breaks = breaks_to_show,
          name   = "Pathway group"
        ) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          legend.title    = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis, hjust = .5),
          legend.text     = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_legend),
          legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.8, "cm")
        )
    ),
    ...
  ) +
    ggplot2::ggtitle(plot_title) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = big_txt + 4) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(
        size  = big_title,
        face  = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      )
    )
}
```

```{r, "old get_ORA function", eval=FALSE}


get_ora <- function(meta_table, integrated_list, threshold_column_meta = "median_log2FC" ,threshold_meta = 1 ,
                    threshold_int =1 , sample_name, dataset_name, cell_type = "NKs", get_ora_statistics = TRUE,
                    effect_size_threshold = 0.04) {
  
  # Description:
  #   Runs Over‑Representation Analysis (ORA) for meta and integrated DE gene sets
  #   across Reactome, KEGG, and Hallmark collections, generates bar/dot/patchwork plots,
  #   optional scatter of ORA effect sizes, and saves as PDF.
  # Arguments:
  #   meta_table         – data.frame of meta‐analysis results (genes × metrics, rownames = gene).
  #   integrated_list    – list with integrated_seu (two‐condition Seurat) and de_table (data.frame).
  #   threshold_column_meta – character; name of column in meta_table for log2FC threshold.
  #   threshold_meta     – numeric; log2FC cutoff for meta DE genes.
  #   threshold_int      – numeric; log2FC cutoff for integrated DE genes.
  #   sample_name        – character; sample ID for titles and filenames.
  #   dataset_name       – character; dataset ID for titles and filenames.
  #   cell_type          – character; cell type label (default "NKs").
  #   get_ora_statistics – logical; whether to include ORA scatter plot (default TRUE).
  #   effect_size_threshold – numeric; GeneRatio cutoff for labeling scatter.
  # Returns:
  #   A list of original enrichResult objects:
  #     meta_reactome, meta_kegg, meta_h,
  #     int_reactome,  int_kegg,  int_h (all filtered p.adjust ≤ 0.1).
  
  # 1) Ensure integrated seu has exactly two conditions
  conds <- unique(integrated_list$integrated_seu@meta.data$condition)
  if (length(conds) != 2) {
    stop("Error: integrated Seurat object must have exactly two conditions: ",
         paste(conds, collapse = ", "))
  }
  group_a <- names(which.min(table(integrated_list$integrated_seu@meta.data$condition)))
  group_b <- names(which.max(table(integrated_list$integrated_seu@meta.data$condition)))
  title_suffix <- paste0(group_a, "" ,cell_type, " vs. Healthy Controls NKs (log2FC threshold of ",threshold_meta,")")
  
  universe_genes_sym <- intersect(rownames(meta_table), rownames(integrated_list$integrated_seu))
  
  universe_genes_entrez <- unname(mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                                         keys = universe_genes_sym,
                                         column = "ENTREZID",
                                         keytype = "SYMBOL",
                                         multiVals = "first"))
  
  # 2) ORA for the "meta" method
  #    a) Build data frame for meta_table
  
  {
    
    meta_up_genes <- rownames(meta_table)[ meta_table[[threshold_column_meta]] >=  threshold_meta ]
    meta_down_genes <- rownames(meta_table)[ meta_table[[threshold_column_meta]]  <= -threshold_meta ]
    
    meta_de_genes   <- union(meta_up_genes, meta_down_genes)
    
    df_meta <- data.frame(t(meta_table$median_log2FC))
    rownames(df_meta) <- "median_log2FC"
    colnames(df_meta) <- rownames(meta_table)
    
    df_meta <- df_meta[, colnames(df_meta) %in% meta_de_genes]
    
    
    
    
    # Symbol-based vector for Hallmark
    ora_vec_meta_sym  <- make_symbol_vector(df_meta, "median_log2FC")
    # ENTREZ-based vector for Reactome/KEGG
    ora_vec_meta_ent  <- make_entrez_vector(df_meta, "median_log2FC")
    
    #    b) Run Reactome
    meta_reactome <- ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = names(ora_vec_meta_ent), organism = "human", universe = universe_genes_entrez)
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_reactome_original <- meta_reactome
    
    meta_reactome@result <- meta_reactome@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    #    c) Run KEGG
    meta_kegg     <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = names(ora_vec_meta_ent), pvalueCutoff = 0.05, universe = universe_genes_entrez)
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_kegg_original <- meta_kegg
    
    meta_kegg@result <- meta_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    #    d) Run Hallmark
    hallmark_df <- msigdbr(
      species  = "Homo sapiens",   # same as before
      category = "H"               # “H” = Hallmark collection
    ) %>%
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) # TERM2GENE format (symbol column)
    
    meta_h        <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = names(ora_vec_meta_sym),
                                               TERM2GENE = hallmark_df,
                                               universe  = universe_genes_sym)
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_h_original <- meta_h
    
    meta_h@result <- meta_h@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    
    
    # e)  Run GO: Biological-Process 
    meta_gobp <- enrichGO(
      gene      = names(ora_vec_meta_ent),   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",                # Biological Process
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_gobp_original <- meta_gobp
    meta_gobp@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_gobp@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # f)  Run GO: Cellular-Component 
    meta_gocc <- enrichGO(
      gene      = names(ora_vec_meta_ent),   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "CC",                # Cellular Component
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_gocc_original <- meta_gocc
    meta_gocc@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_gocc@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # g)  Run BioCarta pathways (MSigDB C2 CP:BIOCARTA 2016+)
    
    biocarta_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
      species     = "Homo sapiens",
      category    = "C2",
      subcategory = "CP:BIOCARTA"          # BioCarta collection
    ) |>
      dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)  # TERM2GENE format
    
    meta_biocarta <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = names(ora_vec_meta_ent),
                                               TERM2GENE = biocarta_df,
                                               universe  = universe_genes_entrez)
    
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_biocarta_original <- meta_biocarta
    meta_biocarta@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_biocarta@result, pvalue <= 0.1)
    
    
  }

  
  #plots for meta ORA
  {
    
    
    #    e) Plot top-10
    p_meta_reactome <- plot_top10(meta_reactome,
                                  paste("REACTOME ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                                  xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio", color1 = "firebrick")
    
    p_meta_kegg <- plot_top10(meta_kegg,
                              paste("KEGG ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),ycol = "GeneRatio", xcol = "Description", color1 = "#03045e")
    
    # Hallmark has "ID" column with "HALLMARK_..."
    top10_meta_h <- meta_h@result %>%
      arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(ID_clean = ID %>%
               str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
               str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
               str_to_title())
    
    top10_meta_h[["GeneRatio"]] <- sapply(top10_meta_h[["GeneRatio"]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
    
    
    p_meta_h <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_meta_h,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "GeneRatio",
      title = paste("MSigDB Hallmark ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#fb8500", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    # Biocarta has "ID" column with "BIOCARTA_"
    
    top10_meta_biocarta <- meta_biocarta@result %>%
      arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(ID_clean = ID %>%
               str_remove("^BIOCARTA_") %>%
               str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
               str_to_title())
    
    top10_meta_biocarta[["GeneRatio"]] <- sapply(top10_meta_biocarta[["GeneRatio"]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
    
    p_meta_biocarta <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_meta_biocarta,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "GeneRatio",
      title = paste("MSigDB Biocarta ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#2C6E49", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    p_meta_gobp <- plot_top10(meta_gobp,
                              paste("GO:BP ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                              xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio", color1 = "#7C4585"
    )
    
    p_meta_gocc <- plot_top10(meta_gocc,
                              paste("GO:CC ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                              xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio", color1 = "#000000"
    )  
    
  }

  # Combine meta hallmark plots if needed, or just store separately
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) ORA for the "integrated" method
  
  {
    int_up_genes   <- rownames(integrated_list$de_table)[ integrated_list$de_table[["avg_log2FC"]] >=  threshold_int ]
    
    int_down_genes <- rownames(integrated_list$de_table)[ integrated_list$de_table[["avg_log2FC"]]  <= -threshold_int ]
    
    int_de_genes   <- union(int_up_genes, int_down_genes)
    
    df_int <- data.frame(t(integrated_list$de_table$avg_log2FC))
    rownames(df_int) <- "log2FC"
    colnames(df_int) <- rownames(integrated_list$de_table)
    
    df_int <- df_int[, colnames(df_int) %in% int_de_genes]
    
    # Symbol-based vector for Hallmark
    ora_vec_int_sym  <- make_symbol_vector(df_int, "log2FC")
    # ENTREZ-based vector for Reactome/KEGG
    ora_vec_int_ent  <- make_entrez_vector(df_int, "log2FC")
    
    
    # Run Reactome, KEGG, Hallmark
    int_reactome <- ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = names(ora_vec_int_ent), organism = "human", universe = universe_genes_entrez)
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_reactome_original <- int_reactome
    
    
    int_reactome@result <- int_reactome@result %>% filter(p.adjust <= 0.1)
    #    c) Run KEGG
    int_kegg     <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = names(ora_vec_int_ent), universe = universe_genes_entrez)
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_kegg_original <- int_kegg
    
    int_kegg@result <- int_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    #    d) Run Hallmark
    
    int_h  <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = names(ora_vec_int_sym),
                                        TERM2GENE = hallmark_df,
                                        universe  = universe_genes_sym)
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_h_original <- int_h
    
    int_h@result <- int_h@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    
    # e)  Run GO: Biological-Process 
    int_gobp <- enrichGO(
      gene      = names(ora_vec_int_ent),   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",                # Biological Process
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_gobp_original <- int_gobp
    int_gobp@result   <- dplyr::filter(int_gobp@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # f)  Run GO: Cellular-Component 
    int_gocc <- enrichGO(
      gene      = names(ora_vec_int_ent),   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "CC",                # Cellular Component
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_gocc_original <- int_gocc
    int_gocc@result   <- dplyr::filter(int_gocc@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # g)  Run BioCarta pathways (MSigDB C2 CP:BIOCARTA 2016+)
    
    
    int_biocarta <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = names(ora_vec_int_ent),
                                              TERM2GENE = biocarta_df,
                                              universe  = universe_genes_entrez)
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_biocarta_original <- int_biocarta
    int_biocarta@result   <- dplyr::filter(int_biocarta@result, pvalue <= 0.1)
    
    
    
  }
 
  # integrated ORA plots
  {
    
    
    # Plot
    p_int_reactome <- plot_top10(int_reactome,
                                 paste("REACTOME ORA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
                                 xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio",color1 = "#FF8FA3")
    
    p_int_kegg <- plot_top10(int_kegg,
                             paste("KEGG ORA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
                             xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio", color1 = "#48CAE4")
    
    top10_int_h <- int_h@result %>%
      arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(ID_clean = ID %>%
               str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
               str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
               str_to_title()
      )
    
    top10_int_h[["GeneRatio"]] <- sapply(top10_int_h[["GeneRatio"]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
    
    p_int_h <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_int_h,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "GeneRatio",
      title = paste("MSigDB Hallmark ORA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#ffb703", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    # Biocarta has "ID" column with "BIOCARTA_"
    
    top10_int_biocarta <- int_biocarta@result %>%
      arrange(desc(GeneRatio)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(ID_clean = ID %>%
               str_remove("^BIOCARTA_") %>%
               str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
               str_to_title())
    
    top10_int_biocarta[["GeneRatio"]] <- sapply(top10_int_biocarta[["GeneRatio"]], function(s) eval(parse(text = s)))
    
    p_int_biocarta <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_int_biocarta,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "GeneRatio",
      title = paste("MSigDB Biocarta ORA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#B2DF8A", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    p_int_gobp <- plot_top10(int_gobp,
                             paste("GO:BP ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                             xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio", color1 = "#E9A5F1")
    
    p_int_gocc <- plot_top10(int_gocc,
                             paste("GO:CC ORA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                             xcol = "Description", ycol = "GeneRatio", color1 = "#A76545"
    )    
    
    
    
  }
 
  
  
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  # 4) Patchwork them together: meta on top, integrated on bottom
  p_pathways_h        <- p_meta_h        / p_int_h
  p_pathways_reactome <- p_meta_reactome / p_int_reactome
  p_pathways_kegg     <- p_meta_kegg     / p_int_kegg
  p_pathways_biocarta     <- p_meta_biocarta     / p_int_biocarta
  p_pathways_gobp     <- p_meta_gobp     / p_int_gobp
  p_pathways_gocc     <- p_meta_gocc    / p_int_gocc
  
  
  
  # 5) Create p_bar_plot_percentage
  {
    
    # 1. Extract pathway IDs from your GSEA results 
    meta_reactome <- meta_reactome_original@result$ID
    int_reactome  <- int_reactome_original@result$ID
    
    meta_kegg <- meta_kegg_original@result$ID
    int_kegg  <- int_kegg_original@result$ID
    
    meta_h <- meta_h_original@result$ID
    int_h  <- int_h_original@result$ID
    
    meta_biocarta <-meta_biocarta_original@result$ID
    int_biocarta <- int_biocarta_original@result$ID
    
    meta_gobp <- meta_gobp_original@result$ID
    int_gobp <- int_gobp_original@result$ID
    
    meta_gocc <- meta_gocc_original@result$ID
    int_gocc <- int_gocc_original@result$ID
    
    # 2. Build one combined data frame
    df_reactome <- calc_fractions(meta_ids = meta_reactome, int_ids = int_reactome, dataset_label = "REACTOME")
    df_kegg     <- calc_fractions(meta_kegg,     int_kegg,     "KEGG")
    df_h        <- calc_fractions(meta_h,        int_h,        "HALLMARK")
    df_biocarta <- calc_fractions(meta_biocarta, int_biocarta, "BIOCARTA")
    df_gobp     <- calc_fractions(meta_gobp,     int_gobp,     "GO:BP")
    df_gocc        <- calc_fractions(meta_gocc,        int_gocc,        "GO:CC")    
    
    plot_df <- bind_rows(df_reactome, df_kegg, df_h, df_biocarta, df_gobp, df_gocc)
    
    # Ensure a consistent stacking order
    plot_df$group <- factor(plot_df$group, levels = c("Meta-exclusive", "Shared", "Int-exclusive"))
    
    # 3. Plot a stacked bar with text labels centered, but hide zeros
    p_bar_plot_percentage <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = dataset, y = fraction, fill = group)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ifelse(fraction == 0, "", percent(fraction, accuracy = 1))),
        position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
        color = "white",
        size = 5
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Meta-exclusive" = "#03045e",
        "Shared"         = "grey70",
        "Int-exclusive"  = "#fb8500"
      )) +
      labs(
        title = "Comparison of Meta vs. Integrated pathways",
        x = "Pathway type",
        y = "Fraction of union of pathways"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
    
    
    
  }
  
  
  # create_return_list
  
  return_list <- list(
    meta_reactome  = meta_reactome_original,
    meta_kegg      = meta_kegg_original,
    meta_h         = meta_h_original,
    meta_gobp      = meta_gobp_original,
    meta_gocc      = meta_gocc_original,
    meta_biocarta  = meta_biocarta_original,
    int_reactome   = int_reactome_original,
    int_kegg       = int_kegg_original,
    int_h          = int_h_original,
    int_gobp       = int_gobp_original,
    int_gocc       = int_gocc_original,
    int_biocarta   = int_biocarta_original
  )
  

  
  #  PDF
  {
    dir_name <- paste0("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/", cell_type)
    
    if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) {
      dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    dir_name <- paste0("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/", cell_type,"/",group_a,"_",dataset_name, "_", sample_name)
    
    if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) {
      dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    full_pdf_name <- paste0(dir_name, "/",group_a,"_",dataset_name, "_", sample_name, "_ora_plots.pdf")
    
    if (get_ora_statistics) {
      p_ora_scatter <- get_ora_scatter_plot(ora_list = return_list, effect_size_threshold = effect_size_threshold)
      pdf(full_pdf_name, width = 26, height = 20)
      print(p_pathways_h)
      print(p_pathways_reactome)
      print(p_pathways_kegg)
      print(p_pathways_biocarta)
      print(p_pathways_gobp)
      print(p_pathways_gocc)      
      print(p_bar_plot_percentage)
      print(p_ora_scatter)
      dev.off()
        
    } else {
      pdf(full_pdf_name, width = 26, height = 20)
      print(p_pathways_h)
      print(p_pathways_reactome)
      print(p_pathways_kegg)
      print(p_pathways_biocarta)
      print(p_pathways_gobp)
      print(p_pathways_gocc)      
      print(p_bar_plot_percentage)
      dev.off()
    }
    

  }

  return(return_list)
}
```

```{r, "old add_pathway_group function", eval=FALSE}

## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
##  Add a “pathway_group” column to a gene-presence matrix
## ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
##
##  Arguments
##    gene_upset_df   ⬅  data frame built by `build_presence_df`,
##                         containing at least a “gene” column
##    pathway_list    ⬅  named list of GSEA result tables
##    id_col          ⬅  name of the gene column in gene_upset_df (default "gene")
##    other_label     ⬅  label to use when a gene never occurs in any pathway
##
##  Value
##    A copy of gene_upset_df with a new character column “pathway_group”.
##
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  Add a “pathway_group” column to a gene-presence matrix
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  Tag a gene-presence matrix with its majority pathway group
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
add_pathway_group <- function(gene_upset_df,
                              pathway_list,
                              id_col      = "gene",
                              other_label = "Other / No Pathway") {
  stopifnot(id_col %in% names(gene_upset_df))
  
  ## libraries (assumes they’re installed)
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(stringr)
  library(AnnotationDbi); library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  
  ## 1 ─ global Entrez-to-symbol map -----------------------------------------
  core_vec <- unlist(lapply(pathway_list, `[[`, "core_enrichment"),
                     use.names = FALSE)
  
  raw_ids  <- unique(unlist(strsplit(core_vec, "/", fixed = TRUE),
                            use.names = FALSE))
  
  entrez2symbol <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
    org.Hs.eg.db,
    keys      = raw_ids[str_detect(raw_ids, "^[0-9]+$")],
    column    = "SYMBOL",
    keytype   = "ENTREZID",
    multiVals = "first"
  )
  
  ## 2 ─ (gene_symbol, group) pairs for every pathway row ---------------------
  gene_group_df <- purrr::map_dfr(
    pathway_list,
    ~ .x %>% dplyr::select(dataset, group, core_enrichment)
  ) %>%
    mutate(raw_id = str_split(core_enrichment, "/")) %>%
    unnest(raw_id, keep_empty = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      gene_symbol = if_else(
        str_detect(dataset, regex("^hallmark$", TRUE)),
        raw_id,
        unname(entrez2symbol[raw_id])
      ),
      group = if_else(group == "Other/No pathway", other_label, group)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(gene_symbol) & nzchar(gene_symbol)) %>%
    distinct(gene_symbol, group)
  
  ## 3 ─ majority vote per gene ----------------------------------------------
  majority_tbl <- gene_group_df %>%
    dplyr::count(gene_symbol, group, name = "n") %>%
    slice_max(n, by = gene_symbol, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_symbol, majority_group = group)
  
  ## 4 ─ merge back & return --------------------------------------------------
  result <- gene_upset_df %>%
    left_join(majority_tbl, by = setNames("gene_symbol", id_col)) %>%
    mutate(group = coalesce(majority_group, other_label)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-majority_group)
  
  result <- result %>% 
    mutate(group = case_when(
      group == "Other" ~ other_label,
      TRUE ~ group       # keep any pre-existing label
    ))
  
  result
}
```

```{r, "GSEA pathways: Create positive_list, negative_list and annotate them", eval=FALSE}
  #create positive_list 
  {

      B_cells_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/GSEA/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")
      CD4_T_cells_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/GSEA/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")
      CD8_T_cells_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/GSEA/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")

      group_lookup <- pathway_group_bank %>%
        dplyr::select(ID, group) %>%
        distinct()            # just in case
      
      ## ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      ## 2.  Add/replace “group” column in each sub-list
      ## ───────────────────────────────────────────────
      full_pathway_list <- imap(
        full_pathway_list,
        ~ .x %>%
          dplyr::select(-any_of("group")) %>%         # drop a pre-existing column, if any
          left_join(group_lookup, by = "ID") %>%
          mutate(group = coalesce(group, "Other"))
      )
      
      
    }
    
    
    #subset into positive and negative
    {
      
      ## 3. Generate *positive* and *negative* lists --------------------------------
      positive_list <- setNames(
        lapply(full_pathway_list, make_subsets, sign = "positive"),
        paste0(names(full_pathway_list), "_positive")
      )
      
      negative_list <- setNames(
        lapply(full_pathway_list, make_subsets, sign = "negative"),
        paste0(names(full_pathway_list), "_negative")
      )
      
      ## 4. Optionally expose each subset as its own object -------------------------
      list2env(c(positive_list, negative_list), envir = .GlobalEnv)
      # → now objects like NK_gsea_clean_positive / NK_gsea_clean_negative exist
      
      ## 5. Combine into the nested master list -------------------------------------
      full_pathway_list_subsetted <- list(
        full_pathway_list_positive = positive_list,
        full_pathway_list_negative = negative_list
      )
      
      rm(NK_gsea_negative, monocytes_gsea_negative, B_cells_gsea_negative, CD4_T_cells_gsea_negative, CD8_T_cells_gsea_negative)
      rm(NK_gsea_positive, monocytes_gsea_positive, B_cells_gsea_positive, CD4_T_cells_gsea_positive, CD8_T_cells_gsea_positive)
      
      
    }
  }
```

```{r, "get_core_enrichment_genes_violin_plot function", eval=FALSE}



get_core_enrichment_genes_violin_plot <- function(
    gene_df,
    plot_title,
    genes_to_label   = NULL,
    legend_breaks    = NULL,
    group_palette    = c(
      "Proliferation"                     = "#E9A5F1",
      "Metabolism / Cellular Respiration" = "#B2DF8A",
      "Stress"                            = "#fb8500",
      "Pro Inflammatory"                  = "firebrick",
      "Pro Inhibitory"                    = "#48CAE4",
      "Migration / Chemotaxis"            = "#2C6E49"
    ),
    x_order          = c("avg_score","NK_cells_score", "Monocytes_score",
                         "B_cells_score","CD4_T_cells_score", "CD8_T_cells_score"),
    x_labels         = c(
      avg_score        = "Average Across all Cell types",
      NK_cells_score   = "NKs",
      CD4_T_cells_score= "CD4+ T Cells",
      CD8_T_cells_score= "CD8+ T Cells",
      B_cells_score    = "B Cells",
      Monocytes_score  = "Monocytes"
    ),
    big_title        = 24,
    big_axis         = 20,
    big_txt          = 16,
    gene_label_size  = 6,      # NEW: size of the ggrepel gene labels
    axis_label_size  = NULL    # NEW: size of x-axis tick labels (NULL → big_txt)
) {
  axis_label_size <- axis_label_size %||% big_txt     # fallback
  
  ## ── 1. long format ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  long_tbl <- gene_df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(x_order),
                        names_to  = "intersection_group",
                        values_to = "avg_metric") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      intersection_group = factor(intersection_group, levels = x_order)
    )
  
  ## ── 2. choose genes to label ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  label_tbl <- if (!is.null(genes_to_label) && length(genes_to_label) > 0) {
    dplyr::semi_join(long_tbl, tibble::tibble(gene = genes_to_label), by = "gene")
  } else {
    long_tbl %>%
      dplyr::group_by(intersection_group) %>%
      dplyr::slice_max(avg_metric, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }
  
  pos_jit <- ggplot2::position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1)
  
  ## ── 3. plotting ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  violin_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(long_tbl,
                                 ggplot2::aes(x = intersection_group,
                                              y = avg_metric)) +
    ggplot2::geom_violin(fill = NA, colour = "black",
                         linewidth = 0.8, width = 0.9, trim = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      ggplot2::aes(fill = pathway_group),
      shape    = 21, colour = "black",
      size     = 3,  stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.9,
      position = pos_jit
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(
      data          = label_tbl,
      ggplot2::aes(label = gene, fill = pathway_group),
      position      = pos_jit,
      colour        = "white",
      fontface      = "bold",
      size          = gene_label_size,   # ← bigger/smaller gene labels here
      box.padding   = 0.25,
      point.padding = 0.15,
      segment.color = "grey40",
      segment.size  = 0.4,
      max.overlaps  = Inf,
      show.legend   = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = group_palette,
      breaks = unique(long_tbl$pathway_group),
      name   = "Pathway group",
      guide  = ggplot2::guide_legend(
        force = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(
          shape  = 21,
          colour = "black",
          stroke = 0.5,
          size   = 5,
          alpha  = 1
        )
      )
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x     = "Score type / Cell type",
      y     = "Gene Score",
      title = plot_title
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = big_txt) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title   = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = big_title),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
      axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_label_size, angle = 45,
                                           hjust = 1, vjust = 1),   # ← x-axis label size
      axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "bottom",
      legend.title     = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
      legend.text      = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt),
      plot.margin      = ggplot2::margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
    )
  
  return(violin_plot)
}
```

```{r, "Signature functions", eval=FALSE}

#───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  get_gene_signature_boxplot()
#───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  meta_df          :  data-frame (e.g. Seurat @meta.data)
#  condition_col    :  column that defines the 2 groups (default "condition")
#  condition_levels :  length-2 character vector, left→right order
#  signature_col    :  column with gene-signature scores  **(required)**
#  colour_palette   :  named length-2 vector whose *names* match condition_levels
#  title            :  main plot title
#  delta            :  if TRUE centre each cell-type on the control (2nd level)
#  big_title        :  title text size
#  big_axis         :  axis-title **and legend-title** size
#  big_txt          :  axis-tick, legend-label, **p-value** text size
#  big_p_value      :  size (pt) for p-value labels (default = big_txt)
#───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_gene_signature_boxplot <- function(
    meta_df,
    condition_col    = "condition",
    condition_levels = c("CD59.Def", "Healthy"),
    comparison_groups = NULL,            # ← NEW
    baseline_level   = NULL,             # only for delta
    signature_col,
    colour_palette,
    title            = "Distribution of Signature per Cell Type & Sample",
    delta            = FALSE,
    big_title        = 30,
    big_axis         = 28,
    big_txt          = 26,
    big_p_value      = 10,
    big_legend_title = 26
) {
  ## ── sanity checks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  stopifnot(
    length(condition_levels) >= 2,
    all(condition_levels %in% meta_df[[condition_col]]),
    setequal(names(colour_palette), condition_levels),
    !missing(signature_col),
    signature_col %in% names(meta_df)
  )
  
  ## additional checks if >2 levels ----------------------------------------
  if (length(condition_levels) > 2) {
    if (is.null(comparison_groups) ||
        !is.list(comparison_groups) ||
        length(comparison_groups) != 2)
      stop("'comparison_groups' must be a list of two vectors when you supply >2 condition_levels")
    
    # must partition the levels without overlap / omission
    all_cmp <- unlist(comparison_groups, use.names = FALSE)
    if (!(setequal(all_cmp, condition_levels)))
      stop("Each condition level must appear in exactly one of the two elements of 'comparison_groups'")
  }
  
  if (delta) {
    baseline_level <- baseline_level %||% tail(condition_levels, 1)
    stopifnot(baseline_level %in% condition_levels)
  }
  
  ## ── fixed cell-type order ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  cell_levels <- c("NK cells", "Monocytes",
                   "B cells", "CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells")
  
  plot_df <- meta_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(final_cell_type %in% cell_levels) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      final_cell_type = factor(final_cell_type, levels = cell_levels),
      !!condition_col := factor(.data[[condition_col]], levels = condition_levels)
    )
  
  ## pooled group for p-value layer (only if >2 conditions) -----------------
  if (length(condition_levels) > 2) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        comparison_group = dplyr::case_when(
          .data[[condition_col]] %in% comparison_groups[[1]] ~ "A",
          .data[[condition_col]] %in% comparison_groups[[2]] ~ "B"
        )
      )
  }
  
  ## Δ shift ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if (delta) {
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      dplyr::group_by(final_cell_type) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        !!signature_col :=
          .data[[signature_col]] -
          median(.data[[signature_col]][.data[[condition_col]] == baseline_level])
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup()
  }
  
  ## jitter points within whiskers only -------------------------------------
  jitter_df <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(final_cell_type, .data[[condition_col]]) %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[signature_col]] <=
                    boxplot.stats(.data[[signature_col]])$stats[5]) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  my_dodge <- 0.75
  
  ## build the plot ----------------------------------------------------------
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_df,
    ggplot2::aes(x      = final_cell_type,
                 y      = .data[[signature_col]],
                 fill   = .data[[condition_col]],
                 colour = .data[[condition_col]])
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(
      data     = jitter_df,
      position = ggplot2::position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                               dodge.width  = my_dodge),
      size = 0.55, alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
      position      = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = my_dodge),
      width         = 0.6,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      alpha         = 0.65,
      colour        = "black",
      lwd           = 0.4,
      fatten        = 6
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = colour_palette, name = "Sample") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = colour_palette, guide = "none")
  
  ## --- p-value layer -------------------------------------------------------
  if (length(condition_levels) == 2) {
    p <- p + ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      ggplot2::aes(group = .data[[condition_col]]),
      method        = "wilcox.test",
      label         = "p.format",
      size          = big_p_value,
      step.increase = 0.07,
      hide.ns       = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    p <- p + ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
      ggplot2::aes(group = comparison_group),
      method        = "wilcox.test",
      label         = "p.format",
      size          = big_p_value,
      step.increase = 0.07,
      hide.ns       = TRUE
    )
  }
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  p <- p +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = big_txt) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title       = ggplot2::element_text(
        hjust  = 0.5, face = "bold", size = big_title,
        margin = ggplot2::margin(b = 6)
      ),
      axis.title.x     = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
      axis.title.y     = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_axis),
      axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_legend_title),
      legend.text        = ggplot2::element_text(size = big_txt),
      plot.margin        = ggplot2::margin(t = 5, r = 20, b = 10, l = 10)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x     = NULL,
      y     = if (delta)
        paste0(signature_col, " (Δ vs ", baseline_level, " median)")
      else
        "CD59 Def. Signature Score",
      title = title
    )
  
  return(p)
}




get_cd59_signature <- function(positive_top_genes, negative_top_genes,seu){
  ## combine them into one vector -------------------------------------
  cd59_gene_signature <- c(paste0(positive_top_genes, "+") , paste0(negative_top_genes, "-"))
  
  
  # Create the list
  signatures <- list(cd59_gene_signature = cd59_gene_signature)
  
  
  
  seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
  return(seu)
  
}
```

```{r, "creating seu_cd59_only_patient_full_annotation without the activated T cells", eval=FALSE}
get_slim_seu <- function(seu) {
  seu_slim <- seu
  DefaultAssay(seu_slim) <- "RNA"
  seu_slim[["SCT"]] <- NULL
  seu_slim@reductions$pca <- NULL
  seu_slim@reductions$umap <- NULL
  
  # Keep only specific metadata columns: orig.ident, nCount_RNA, nFeature_RNA, sample
  metadata_colnames <- colnames(seu_slim@meta.data)
  
  # Exclude these columns (removed the empty string "")
  excluded_names <- c(
    "orig.ident", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA",
    "sample",     "condition"
  )
  # Find indices of the excluded names in the metadata columns
  indices_to_remove <- match(excluded_names, metadata_colnames)
  
  # Check for any names not found and print a message, then return if any are missing
  not_found <- excluded_names[is.na(indices_to_remove)]
  if (length(not_found) > 0) {
    for (name in not_found) {
      cat(paste0("\nThe column '", name, "' wasn't found.\nPlease make sure to create such a column and then rerun this command.\n"))
    }
    return(invisible())
  }
  
  # Determine which metadata columns to keep (i.e. remove the excluded ones)
  metadata_to_keep <- setdiff(metadata_colnames, excluded_names)
  
  # Remove all other metadata columns
  for (column in metadata_to_keep) {
    seu_slim@meta.data[[column]] <- NULL
  }
  
  # seu_slim <- DietSeurat(object = seu_slim,layers = "counts")
  
  return(seu_slim)
}
```

```{r, "creating seu_cd59_control and seu_cd55_control without the activated T cells, saving both in healthy_list", eval=FALSE}
    prefixes <- unique(sub("_.*$", "", cells))    # drop everything after first “_”
    sort(prefixes)    
    
    
    get_full_seurat <- function(seu){
      
      seu <- PercentageFeatureSet(seu, "^MT-", col.name = "percent_mito")
      seu <- SCTransform(seu, vars.to.regress = "percent_mito", verbose = FALSE)
      
      #Change the name of the column to view it each time 
      
      seu <- subset(seu, subset = nFeature_SCT > 500 & percent_mito < 20)
      
      DefaultAssay(seu) <- "SCT"
      
      seu <- CellCycleScoring(
        seu,
        s.features  = cc.genes$s.genes,
        g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
        nbin        = 22,        # any number ≤ unique(rowMeans) (which is 1)
        assay       = "SCT"
      )
      
      seu <- RunPCA(seu, npcs = 50, verbose = F)
      VizDimLoadings(seu, dims = 1:5, reduction = "pca", ncol = 5, balanced = T)
      ElbowPlot(seu, reduction = "pca", ndims = 50)
      
      seu <- FindNeighbors(seu, dims = 1:25)
      seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 0.6)
      seu <- RunUMAP(seu, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:25, n.components = 2, n.neighbors = 30,
                     n.epochs = 200, min.dist = 0.3, learning.rate = 1, spread = 1)
      return(seu)
      
      
    }
    
    
    seu_cd55_control <- get_full_seurat(seu_cd55_control)
    
    
    seu_cd55_control <- get_all_cell_types(seu_cd55_control, n_cores = 8)
    
    
    healthy_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list.qs")
    
    
    healthy_list$seu_cd55 <- seu_cd55_control
    
    qsave(healthy_list, "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list.qs")
```

```{r, "stand alone get_cell_types, 5 functions for 5 cell types", eval=FALSE}
get_nk <- function(seu){
  
  
  
  seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 80)
  
  #SingleR with Blueprint
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main,
                               clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
    )
    
    x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")
    
  }
  
  #SingleR with Monaco
  
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main,
                               clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
                               
    )
    
    x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
  }
  
  #Ucell with Viver's NK Signature doi: 10.1016/j.immuni.2018.09.009
  
  {
    positive_nk_signature <- c("CD160+", "CD244+", "CHST12+", "CST7+", "GNLY+", "IL18RAP+", "IL2RB+", "KLRC1+", "KLRC3+", "KLRD1+", "KLRF1+", "PRF1+", "XCL2+")
    
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_nk_signature = positive_nk_signature)
    
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    seu$nk_by_ucell <- ifelse(seu$positive_nk_signature >= 0.4, "NK cells", "other")
    
  }
  
  # Final idetification
  
  seu$is_nk <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$nk_by_ucell == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "NK cells") |
      (seu$nk_by_ucell == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "NK cells") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80 == "NK cells" & seu$SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80 == "NK cells") ~ "NK cells",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  
  return(seu)
}

get_CD4_cells <- function(seu, n_cores = 8){
  

  plan(multicore, workers = n_cores)
  
  # seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 80)
  
  #SingleR with Blueprint
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main
                               # ,clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
    )
    
    # x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    # 
    # seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(
      seu,
      metadata = setNames(singler_results$labels, rownames(singler_results)),
      col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint"
    )
    
    seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint <-
      gsub("-", " ", seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint, fixed = TRUE)
    
  }
  
  #SingleR with Monaco
  
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main
                               # ,clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
                               
    )
    
    # x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    # 
    # seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(
      seu,
      metadata = setNames(singler_results$labels, rownames(singler_results)),
      col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco"
    )
  }
  
  #Ucell with Robinson's monocytes Signature DOI: 10.1016/j.it.2020.12.001 
  
  {


    
    
    positive_cd_4_signature <- c(
      "CD4+",
      "IL7R+",
      "TRAC+",
      "CD3D+",
      "CD3E+",
      "CD2+",
      # "CD40LG",
      # "IL4I1"
      # ,"FOXP3",
      "CXCR4+",
       "LTB+"    # re-introduce one homing marker to boost naïve recall
    )

    
   # non_classical_positive_cd_4_signature <- c(
   #    "CD4+",
   #    "CD40LG+",
   #    "IL4I1+",
   #    "FOXP3+",
   #    "CCL20+"
   #  )
    
    
    # positive_cd8_signature <- c(
    #   "CD8A+","CD8B+","CD8B2+","GZMB+","NKG7+","GNLY+","PRF1+","CD248+"
    # )
    
    positive_cd8_burden_signature <- c(
      "CD8A+","CD8B+","CD8B2+"
      # ,"GZMB+","CD248+","KLRC2","KLRC3",#  "NKG7-","GNLY-","PRF1-"

    )
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_cd_4_signature = positive_cd_4_signature,
      positive_cd8_burden_signature = positive_cd8_burden_signature
    )
    
    
    # This appends a column named  'positive_cd_4_signature_UCell'
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
      seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    # 3. Compute a composite score and threshold
    seu$CD4_score_primary     <- seu$positive_cd_4_signature - seu$positive_cd8_burden_signature
    # seu$CD4_score_nonclassic  <- seu$non_classical_positive_cd_4_signature - seu$positive_cd8_signature
    
    seu$cd_4_signature_by_ucell <- ifelse(
      seu$CD4_score_primary    >= 0.3,
      "CD4+ T cells", "other"
    )
    
  }
  
  # Final idetification
  
  seu$is_CD4_T_cell <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$cd_4_signature_by_ucell == "CD4+ T cells" &
       seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint == "CD4+ T cells") |
      (seu$cd_4_signature_by_ucell == "CD4+ T cells" &
         seu$SingleR.labels.monaco    == "CD4+ T cells") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint   == "CD4+ T cells" &
         seu$SingleR.labels.monaco    == "CD4+ T cells") ~ "CD4+ T cells",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  
  return(seu)
}

get_CD8_cells <- function(seu, n_cores = 8){
  
  plan(multicore, workers = n_cores)
  
  # seu <- FindClusters(seu, resolution = 80)
  
  #SingleR with Blueprint
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::BlueprintEncodeData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main
                               # ,clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
    )
    
    # x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    # 
    # seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint.cluster80")
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(
      seu,
      metadata = setNames(singler_results$labels, rownames(singler_results)),
      col.name = "SingleR.labels.blueprint"
    )
    
    seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint <-
      gsub("-", " ", seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint, fixed = TRUE)
    
    bp_levels <- unique(gsub("-", " ", singler_ref$label.main))
    bp_levels <- bp_levels[order(bp_levels)]   # optional: alphabetical
    
    seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint_modified <- factor(
      case_when(
        seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint == "CD8+ T cells" &
          seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells" ~ "CD4+ T cells",
        TRUE ~ as.character(seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint)
      ),
      levels = bp_levels
    )
    
    

    
  }
  
  #SingleR with Monaco
  
  {
    singler_ref <- celldex::MonacoImmuneData()
    
    
    singler_results <- SingleR(test = GetAssayData(seu, assay = "SCT"),
                               ref = singler_ref,
                               labels = singler_ref@colData@listData$label.main
                               # ,clusters = seu@meta.data$SCT_snn_res.80
                               
    )
    
    # x <- data.frame(row.names = rownames(singler_results), labels = singler_results$labels)
    # 
    # seu <- AddMetaData(seu, metadata = x[seu$SCT_snn_res.80, 1], col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco.cluster80")
    
    seu <- AddMetaData(
      seu,
      metadata = setNames(singler_results$labels, rownames(singler_results)),
      col.name = "SingleR.labels.monaco"
    )
    
    mo_levels <- unique(gsub("-", " ", singler_ref$label.main))
    mo_levels <- mo_levels[order(mo_levels)]   # optional: alphabetical
    
    seu$SingleR.labels.monaco_modified <- factor(
      case_when(
        seu$SingleR.labels.monaco == "CD8+ T cells" &
          seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells" ~ "CD4+ T cells",
        TRUE ~ as.character(seu$SingleR.labels.monaco)
      ),
      levels = mo_levels
    )
    
  }
  
  #Ucell with Robinson's monocytes Signature DOI: 10.1016/j.it.2020.12.001 

  {

    positive_cd8_signature <- c("CD8A+","CD8B+","CD8B2+", "TRAC+","LCK+","RUNX3+"                              ,"CD3E+","EOMES+"
                                ,"CD3E+","EOMES+"
                                # ,"TRDC+", "IKZF2+"
    )
    
    
    positive_cd_4_burden_signature <- c("CD4+",
                                        "CCR7+", "IL7R")
    
    positive_nk_burden_signature <- c("NCR1", "FCGR3A", "TYROBP")
    
    signatures <- list(
      positive_cd8_signature = positive_cd8_signature,
      positive_cd_4_burden_signature = positive_cd_4_burden_signature,
      positive_nk_burden_signature = positive_nk_burden_signature
    )
    
    
    # This appends a column named  'positive_cd_4_signature_UCell'
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(
      seu, features = signatures, name = NULL)
    
    # 3. Compute a composite score and threshold
    seu$CD8_to_CD4_score_primary     <- seu$positive_cd8_signature - seu$positive_cd_4_burden_signature
    seu$CD8_to_NK_score_primary     <- seu$positive_cd8_signature - seu$positive_nk_burden_signature
    
    
    seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell <- ifelse(
      (seu$CD8_to_CD4_score_primary >= 0.3) |
        (seu$CD8_to_NK_score_primary >= 0.3),
      "CD8+ T cells",
      "other"
    )
    
    seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell <- ifelse((seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell == "CD8+ T cells" & 
                                             seu$is_CD4_T_cell == "CD4+ T cells"), "other",seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell)
    
  }
  
  # Final idetification
  
  seu$is_CD8_T_cell <- dplyr::case_when(
    (seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell == "CD8+ T cells" &
       seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint_modified == "CD8+ T cells") |
      (seu$cd_8_signature_by_ucell == "CD8+ T cells" &
         seu$SingleR.labels.monaco_modified    == "CD8+ T cells") |
      (seu$SingleR.labels.blueprint_modified   == "CD8+ T cells" &
         seu$SingleR.labels.monaco_modified    == "CD8+ T cells") ~ "CD8+ T cells",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )
  
  return(seu)
}
```
