```{r, "old get_GSEA function", eval=FALSE}


get_gsea <- function(meta_table, integrated_list,
                     sample_name, dataset_name, cell_type = "NKs") {
  
  # Description:
  #   Performs Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) on both meta‐analysis and integrated DE results
  #   using Reactome, KEGG, and MSigDB Hallmark sets, generates dot/patchwork/bar plots,
  #   and saves them as a multipanel PDF.
  # Arguments:
  #   meta_table     – data.frame of meta‐analysis results (genes × metrics, rownames = gene).
  #   integrated_list– list with elements:
  #                      $integrated_seu (Seurat object with exactly two conditions),
  #                      $de_table      (data.frame of integrated DE results, rownames = gene).
  #   sample_name    – character; sample identifier for titles and filenames.
  #   dataset_name   – character; dataset identifier for titles and filenames.
  #   cell_type      – character; label for cell type (default "NKs").
  # Returns:
  #   A list of original GSEA result objects:
  #     meta_reactome, meta_kegg, meta_h,
  #     int_reactome,  int_kegg,  int_h (all filtered p.adjust ≤ 0.1).
  
  # 1) Ensure integrated seu has exactly two conditions
  conds <- unique(integrated_list$integrated_seu@meta.data$condition)
  if (length(conds) != 2) {
    stop("Error: integrated Seurat object must have exactly two conditions: ",
         paste(conds, collapse = ", "))
  }
  group_a <- names(which.min(table(integrated_list$integrated_seu@meta.data$condition)))
  group_b <- names(which.max(table(integrated_list$integrated_seu@meta.data$condition)))
  title_suffix <- paste(group_a, cell_type, "vs. Healthy Controls NKs")
  
  
  # Gsaea for meta
  {
    # 2) GSEA for the "meta" method
    #    a) Build data frame for meta_table
    df_meta <- data.frame(t(meta_table$median_log2FC))
    rownames(df_meta) <- "median_log2FC"
    colnames(df_meta) <- rownames(meta_table)
    
    # Symbol-based vector for Hallmark
    gsea_vec_meta_sym  <- make_symbol_vector(df_meta, "median_log2FC")
    # ENTREZ-based vector for Reactome/KEGG
    gsea_vec_meta_ent  <- make_entrez_vector(df_meta, "median_log2FC")
    
    #    b) Run Reactome
    meta_reactome <- ReactomePA::gsePathway(geneList = gsea_vec_meta_ent, organism = "human")
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_reactome_original <- meta_reactome
    meta_reactome@result <- meta_reactome@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    #    c) Run KEGG
    meta_kegg <- clusterProfiler::gseKEGG(geneList = gsea_vec_meta_ent)
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_kegg_original <- meta_kegg
    meta_kegg@result <- meta_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    #    d) Run Hallmark
    # h_set         <- subsetCollection(msigdb.hs, 'h')   # hallmarks in symbol
    # h_df          <- msigCollectionToDf(h_set)
    # meta_h        <- clusterProfiler::GSEA(geneList = gsea_vec_meta_sym,
    #                                        TERM2GENE = h_df,
    #                                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05)
    
    hallmark_df <- msigdbr(
      species  = "Homo sapiens",   # same as before
      category = "H"               # “H” = Hallmark collection
    ) %>%
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) # TERM2GENE format (symbol column)
    
    ## 2.  Run GSEA with your SYMBOL-named vector -------------------------------
    meta_h <- GSEA(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_meta_sym,   # SYMBOL-named numeric vector
      TERM2GENE     = hallmark_df,
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_h_original <- meta_h
    meta_h@result <- meta_h@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    # e)  Run GO: Biological-Process 
    meta_gobp <- gseGO(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_meta_ent,   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",                # Biological Process
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_gobp_original <- meta_gobp
    meta_gobp@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_gobp@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # f)  Run GO: Cellular-Component 
    meta_gocc <- gseGO(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_meta_ent,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "CC",                # Cellular Component
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_gocc_original <- meta_gocc
    meta_gocc@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_gocc@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # g)  Run BioCarta pathways (MSigDB C2 CP:BIOCARTA 2016+)
    
    biocarta_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
      species     = "Homo sapiens",
      category    = "C2",
      subcategory = "CP:BIOCARTA"          # BioCarta collection
    ) |>
      dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)  # TERM2GENE format
    
    meta_biocarta <- GSEA(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_meta_ent,
      TERM2GENE     = biocarta_df,
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    meta_biocarta_original <- meta_biocarta
    meta_biocarta@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_biocarta@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
  }
 
  

  # GSEA plots meta
  {
    
    #    e) Plot top-10
    p_meta_reactome <- plot_top10(meta_reactome,
                                  paste("REACTOME GSEA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                                  xcol = "Description", color1 = "firebrick"
    )
    p_meta_kegg <- plot_top10(meta_kegg,
                              paste("KEGG GSEA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                              xcol = "Description", color1 = "#03045e"
    )
    
    # Hallmark has "ID" column with "HALLMARK_..."
    top10_meta_h <- meta_h@result %>%
      arrange(desc(enrichmentScore)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(ID_clean = ID %>%
               str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
               str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
               str_to_title()
      )
    
    
    p_meta_h <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_meta_h,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "enrichmentScore",
      title = paste("MSigDB Hallmark GSEA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#fb8500", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    
    
    # Biocarta has "ID" column with "BIOCARTA_"
    
    top10_meta_biocarta <- meta_biocarta@result %>%
      arrange(desc(enrichmentScore)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(
        raw       = ID %>%
          str_remove("^BIOCARTA_") %>%
          str_replace_all("_", " "),
        first     = word(raw, 1),
        rest      = str_remove(raw, paste0("^", first, " ")) %>%
          str_to_title(),
        ID_clean  = if_else(
          rest == "",
          # if no “rest”, just uppercase the first
          toupper(first),
          # otherwise, FIRST all-caps + space + Rest Title-case
          paste(toupper(first), rest)
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-raw, -first, -rest)
    
    
    p_meta_biocarta <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_meta_biocarta,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "enrichmentScore",
      title = paste("MSigDB Biocarta GSEA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#2C6E49", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    p_meta_gobp <- plot_top10(meta_gobp,
                              paste("GO:BP GSEA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                              xcol = "Description", color1 = "#7C4585"
    )
    
    p_meta_gocc <- plot_top10(meta_gocc,
                              paste("GO:CC GSEA for Meta Method:", title_suffix),
                              xcol = "Description", color1 = "#000000"
    )  
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3) GSEA for the "integrated" method
  
  {
    df_int <- data.frame(t(integrated_list$de_table$avg_log2FC))
    rownames(df_int) <- "log2FC"
    colnames(df_int) <- rownames(integrated_list$de_table)
    
    # Symbol-based vector for Hallmark
    gsea_vec_int_sym <- make_symbol_vector(df_int, "log2FC")
    # ENTREZ-based vector for Reactome/KEGG
    gsea_vec_int_ent <- make_entrez_vector(df_int, "log2FC")
    
    # Run Reactome
    int_reactome <- gsePathway(geneList = gsea_vec_int_ent, organism = "human")
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_reactome_original <- int_reactome
    
    int_reactome@result <- int_reactome@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    
    # Run KEGG
    
    int_kegg     <- gseKEGG(geneList = gsea_vec_int_ent)
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_kegg_original <- int_kegg
    
    int_kegg@result <- int_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    # Run  Hallmark
    
    int_h <- GSEA(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_meta_sym,   # SYMBOL-named numeric vector
      TERM2GENE     = hallmark_df,
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_h_original <- int_h
    
    int_h@result <- int_h@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.1)
    
    
    # e)  Run GO: Biological-Process 
    int_gobp <- gseGO(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_int_ent ,   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",                # Biological Process
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_gobp_original <- int_gobp
    int_gobp@result   <- dplyr::filter(int_gobp@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # f)  Run GO: Cellular-Component 
    int_gocc <- gseGO(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_int_ent ,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "CC",                # Cellular Component
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_gocc_original <- int_gocc
    int_gocc@result   <- dplyr::filter(int_gocc@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    # g)  Run BioCarta pathways (MSigDB C2 CP:BIOCARTA 2016+)
    
    int_biocarta <- GSEA(
      geneList      = gsea_vec_int_ent ,
      TERM2GENE     = biocarta_df,
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    #save a copy for barplot
    int_biocarta_original <- int_biocarta
    int_biocarta@result   <- dplyr::filter(int_biocarta@result, p.adjust <= 0.1)
    
    
  }

  
  # plots for "integrated" method
  {
    # Plot
    p_int_reactome <- plot_top10(int_reactome,
                                 paste("REACTOME GSEA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
                                 xcol = "Description", color1 = "#FF8FA3"
    )
    p_int_kegg <- plot_top10(int_kegg,
                             paste("KEGG GSEA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
                             xcol = "Description", color1 = "#48CAE4"
    )
    
    top10_int_h <- int_h@result %>%
      arrange(desc(enrichmentScore)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(ID_clean = ID %>%
               str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
               str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
               str_to_title()
      )
    p_int_h <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_int_h,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "enrichmentScore",
      title = paste("MSigDB Hallmark GSEA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#ffb703", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    
    # Biocarta has "ID" column with "BIOCARTA_"
    
    top10_int_biocarta <- int_biocarta@result %>%
      arrange(desc(enrichmentScore)) %>%
      slice_head(n = 10) %>%
      mutate(
        raw       = ID %>%
          str_remove("^BIOCARTA_") %>%
          str_replace_all("_", " "),
        first     = word(raw, 1),
        rest      = str_remove(raw, paste0("^", first, " ")) %>%
          str_to_title(),
        ID_clean  = if_else(
          rest == "",
          # if no “rest”, just uppercase the first
          toupper(first),
          # otherwise, FIRST all-caps + space + Rest Title-case
          paste(toupper(first), rest)
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-raw, -first, -rest)
    
    
    p_int_biocarta <- ggdotchart(
      data = top10_int_biocarta,
      x = "ID_clean", y = "enrichmentScore",
      title = paste("MSigDB Biocarta GSEA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
      color = "p.adjust",
      sorting = "descending",
      add = "segments",
      rotate = TRUE,
      dot.size = 10,
      gradient.cols = c("#B2DF8A", "grey"),
      ggtheme = theme_pubr()
    ) +
      theme(
        legend.key.height = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.width  = unit(1, "cm"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm")
      )
    
    p_int_gobp <- plot_top10(int_gobp,
                             paste("GO:BP GSEA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
                             xcol = "Description", color1 = "#E9A5F1"
    )
    
    p_int_gocc <- plot_top10(int_gocc,
                             paste("GO:CC GSEA for Integrated Method:", title_suffix),
                             xcol = "Description", color1 = "#A76545"
    )  
    
  }
 
  
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4) Patchwork them together: meta on top, integrated on bottom
  p_pathways_h        <- p_meta_h        / p_int_h
  p_pathways_reactome <- p_meta_reactome / p_int_reactome
  p_pathways_kegg     <- p_meta_kegg     / p_int_kegg
  p_pathways_biocarta     <- p_meta_biocarta     / p_int_biocarta
  p_pathways_gobp     <- p_meta_gobp     / p_int_gobp
  p_pathways_gocc     <- p_meta_gocc    / p_int_gocc
  
  
  # 5) Create p_bar_plot_percentage
  {
    
    # 1. Extract pathway IDs from your GSEA results 
    meta_reactome <- meta_reactome_original@result$ID
    int_reactome  <- int_reactome_original@result$ID
    
    meta_kegg <- meta_kegg_original@result$ID
    int_kegg  <- int_kegg_original@result$ID
    
    meta_h <- meta_h_original@result$ID
    int_h  <- int_h_original@result$ID
    
    meta_biocarta <-meta_biocarta_original@result$ID
    int_biocarta <- int_biocarta_original@result$ID
    
    meta_gobp <- meta_gobp_original@result$ID
    int_gobp <- int_gobp_original@result$ID
    
    meta_gocc <- meta_gocc_original@result$ID
    int_gocc <- int_gocc_original@result$ID
    
    # 2. Build one combined data frame
    df_reactome <- calc_fractions(meta_reactome, int_reactome, "REACTOME")
    df_kegg     <- calc_fractions(meta_kegg,     int_kegg,     "KEGG")
    df_h        <- calc_fractions(meta_h,        int_h,        "HALLMARK")
    df_biocarta <- calc_fractions(meta_biocarta, int_biocarta, "BIOCARTA")
    df_gobp     <- calc_fractions(meta_gobp,     int_gobp,     "GO:BP")
    df_gocc        <- calc_fractions(meta_gocc,        int_gocc,        "GO:CC")    
    
    plot_df <- bind_rows(df_reactome, df_kegg, df_h, df_biocarta, df_gobp, df_gocc)
    
    # Ensure a consistent stacking order
    plot_df$group <- factor(plot_df$group, levels = c("Meta-exclusive", "Shared", "Int-exclusive"))
    
    # 3. Plot a stacked bar with text labels centered, but hide zeros
    p_bar_plot_percentage <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = dataset, y = fraction, fill = group)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ifelse(fraction == 0, "", percent(fraction, accuracy = 1))),
        position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
        color = "white",
        size = 5
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Meta-exclusive" = "#03045e",
        "Shared"         = "grey70",
        "Int-exclusive"  = "#fb8500"
      )) +
      labs(
        title = "Comparison of Meta vs. Integrated pathways",
        x = "Pathway type",
        y = "Fraction of union of pathways"
      ) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
    
    
    
  }
  
  
  # create_return_list
  
  return_list <- list(
    meta_reactome  = meta_reactome_original,
    meta_kegg      = meta_kegg_original,
    meta_h         = meta_h_original,
    meta_gobp      = meta_gobp_original,
    meta_gocc      = meta_gocc_original,
    meta_biocarta  = meta_biocarta_original,
    int_reactome   = int_reactome_original,
    int_kegg       = int_kegg_original,
    int_h          = int_h_original,
    int_gobp       = int_gobp_original,
    int_gocc       = int_gocc_original,
    int_biocarta   = int_biocarta_original
  )
  
  
  
  #  PDF
  {
    dir_name <- paste0("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/", cell_type)
    
    if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) {
      dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    dir_name <- paste0("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/", cell_type,"/",group_a,"_",dataset_name, "_", sample_name)
    
    if (!dir.exists(dir_name)) {
      dir.create(dir_name, recursive = TRUE)
    }
    
    full_pdf_name <- paste0(dir_name, "/",group_a,"_",dataset_name, "_", sample_name, "_gsea_plots.pdf")
    
    pdf(full_pdf_name, width = 26, height = 20)
    print(p_pathways_h)
    print(p_pathways_reactome)
    print(p_pathways_kegg)
    print(p_pathways_biocarta)
    print(p_pathways_gobp)
    print(p_pathways_gocc)
    print(p_bar_plot_percentage)
    dev.off()
  }
  
  return(return_list)
}
```

```{r, "get_meta_int_comparison_pds_for_one_sample function", eval=FALSE}
get_meta_int_comparison_pds_for_one_sample <- function(meta_table, integrated_list, highlight_genes = NULL,

  # ora_list <- get_ora(meta_table = meta_table, integrated_list = integrated_list , sample_name = sample_name,dataset_name = dataset_name, cell_type = cell_type)
  
  return_list <- list(
    "gsea_list" = gsea_list
    # "ora_list" = ora_list
  )
  
}
```

```{r, "get_complex_pathway_lollipop function and code calling for it", eval=FALSE}

get_complex_pathway_lollipop <- function(
    df,
    manuall_changing_names = NULL,
    condition,
    sample_name,
    dataset_name,
    color_vector = c(
      "NK"            = "#B62055",  # claret-magenta
      "Monocytes"     = "#56B4E9",  # sky-blue  (unchanged)
      "B Cells"       = "#009E73",  # teal-green (unchanged)
      "CD4+ T cells"  = "#F0E442",  # vivid yellow (unchanged)
      "CD8+ T cells"  = "#F37707"   # pumpkin orange
    ),
    is_meta = TRUE,
    p_legend_max = NULL,          # (C) upper limit for p.adjust legend; NULL = auto
    row_order    = NULL,          # (E) character vec in the order you want rows
    dodge_width  = 0            #    distance between lollipops on same row
) {
  
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 1) isolate the pathways of interest --------------------------------
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  highlight_df <- df %>%
    mutate(Description_for_lollipop = Description)      # ← keep a copy
  
  # ————————————————————————————————————————————————
  # 2) manual renames (operate ONLY on the copy)
  # ————————————————————————————————————————————————
  if (length(manuall_changing_names) > 0) {
    for (old_name in names(manuall_changing_names)) {
      new_name <- manuall_changing_names[[old_name]]
      highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop[
        highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop == old_name
      ] <- new_name
    }
  }
  
  # after manual renames, decide which rows still need rule-based tidying
  descriptions_for_change <- setdiff(
    highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop,
    manuall_changing_names
  )
  
  # ————————————————————————————————————————————————
  # 3) rule-based tidying   (Hallmark, Biocarta, everything else)
  # ————————————————————————————————————————————————
  # browser()
  for (description in descriptions_for_change) {
    
    idx <- which(highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop == description)
    if (length(idx) == 0) next
    
    dataset_tag <- highlight_df$dataset[idx[1]]   # <<< pick the first row
    
    
    if (dataset_tag == "Hallmark") {
      
      highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop[idx] <-
        description %>%
        str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
        str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
        str_to_title()
      
    } else if (dataset_tag == "Biocarta") {
      
      raw   <- description %>%
        str_remove("^BIOCARTA_") %>%
        str_replace_all("_", " ")
      first <- word(raw, 1)
      rest  <- str_remove(raw, paste0("^", first, " ")) %>% str_to_title()
      
      highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop[idx] <-
        ifelse(rest == "", toupper(first), paste(toupper(first), rest))
      
    } else {
      
      highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop[idx] <- str_to_title(description)
      
    }
  }
  
  # browser()
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 4) plot title + helper columns ------------------------------------
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  title <- if (is_meta) {
    "PDE-Based GSEA: Comparative Pathway Landscape Across CD59-Deficient Immune Cells"
  } else {
    "Integration-Based GSEA: Comparative Pathway Landscape Across CD59-Deficient Immune Cells"
  }
  
  highlight_df <- highlight_df %>%
    mutate(display_dataset = ifelse(dataset %in% c("GO:BP", "GO:CC"),
                                    "GO", dataset))
  
  metric <- intersect(c("NES", "GeneRatio"), names(highlight_df))
  if (length(metric) != 1)
    stop("highlight_df must contain **exactly one** of 'NES' or 'GeneRatio'.")
  metric <- metric[[1]]
  
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  # 5) lollipop plot  (uses Description_for_lollipop) -----------------
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------ #
  
  ## 5) PREP → optional user-defined row order & dodge helper           ##
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ##
  if (!is.null(row_order)) {
    highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop <-
      factor(highlight_df$Description_for_lollipop,
             levels = rev(row_order))          # rev → first element appears top
    y_aes <- quote(Description_for_lollipop)   # no re-ordering in ggplot
  } else {
    y_aes <- expr(forcats::fct_reorder(Description_for_lollipop, !!sym(metric)))
  }
  
  
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = dodge_width)
  caption_txt <- "All pathways visualised meet the FDR cutoff; any missing cell-type trace reflects biological irrelevance (e.g. TCR-complex down-regulation in B-cells) despite statistical significance."
  
  
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ##
  ## 6) COMPLEX lollipop (multi-cell)                                   ##
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ##
  p_pathway_lollipop <- ggplot(
    highlight_df,
    aes(x = .data[[metric]],
        y = !!y_aes,
        shape  = display_dataset,
        colour = Cell_type,
        fill   = Cell_type,
        group  = interaction(Description_for_lollipop, Cell_type))
  ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = 0, yend = !!y_aes,
          group = interaction(Description_for_lollipop, Cell_type)),
      position = dodge, linewidth = 0.5,
      colour = "grey70", alpha = 1, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_point(position = dodge, size = 5, stroke = 0.8) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      name   = "Dataset",
      values = c(Biocarta = 25, GO = 24, Kegg = 22,
                 Hallmark = 21, Reactome = 23)
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(name = "Cell type", values = color_vector) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_vector, guide = "none") +
    labs(
      y        = "Pathway",
      x        = metric,
      title    = title,
      caption  = "All pathways visualised meet the FDR cutoff; any missing cell-type trace reflects biological irrelevance (e.g. TCR-complex down-regulation in B-cells) despite statistical significance."
    ) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(
      legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      legend.key.width  = unit(0.9, "cm"),
      axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.title        = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.title        = element_text(size = 20),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.caption      = element_text(
        hjust  = 0,          # left-align
        vjust  = 1,          # stick to bottom margin
        size   = 9,
        margin = margin(t = 8)
      )
    )
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ##
  ## 7) return                                                          ##
  ## ------------------------------------------------------------------ ##
  list(
    highlight_df       = highlight_df,
    p_pathway_lollipop = p_pathway_lollipop
  )
}


#Multi cell type lolipop
{
  
  NK_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/GSEA/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")
  monocytes_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/GSEA/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")
  B_cells_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/GSEA/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")
  CD4_T_cells_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/GSEA/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")
  CD8_T_cells_gsea <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/full_gsea_ora_results/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient/GSEA/full_meta_gsea_df.qs")

    "NK" = NK_gsea,
    "Monocytes" = monocytes_gsea,
    "B Cells" = B_cells_gsea, 
    "CD4+ T cells" = CD4_T_cells_gsea,
    "CD8+ T cells" = CD8_T_cells_gsea
  )
  
  ID_vector <- c(
    "GO:0002250",
    "hsa04062",
    "HALLMARK_APOPTOSIS",
    "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS",
    "HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT",
    "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA",
    "HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",
    "HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING",
    "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB",
    "HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING",
    "GO:0042743",
    "GO:0019814",
    "GO:0042775",
    "GO:0042101"
  )
  
  complex_lolipop_df <- data.frame(
    ID          = character(),
    Description = character(),
    Cell_type   = character(),
    dataset     = character(),
    NES         = numeric(),
    p.adjust    = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  
  complex_lolipop_df <- map2_dfr(
    gsea_list,                       # the list elements (data frames)
    names(gsea_list),                # their names (cell types)
    ~ .x %>%                         # .x = current data frame
      filter(ID %in% ID_vector) %>%# keep only the rows we want
      mutate(Cell_type = .y) %>%   # .y = current cell-type name
      dplyr::select(ID, Description, Cell_type, dataset, NES, p.adjust)
  )
  
  complex_lolipop_df <- complex_lolipop_df %>% 
    filter(
      !(
        ## 1) Monocytes or NK with GO:0070098
        (Cell_type %in% c("Monocytes", "NK") & ID == "GO:0002250") |
          ## 2) Monocytes or NK with GO:0042101
          (Cell_type %in% c("Monocytes", "NK") & ID == "GO:0042101") |
          ## 3) Monocytes, NK, CD4+ T cells, or CD8+ T cells with GO:0019814
          (Cell_type %in% c("Monocytes", "NK", "CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells") & ID == "GO:0019814")
      )
    )
  
  
  Changing_names_vector <- list(HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB = "TNFA Signaling via NFKB",
                                HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS = "E2F Targets",
                                HALLMARK_G2M_CHECKPOINT = "G2M Checkpoint",
                                "mitochondrial ATP synthesis coupled electron transport" = 
                                  "Mitochondrial ATP Synthesis Coupled Electron Transport",
                                HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING = "mTORC1 Signaling",
                                HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING = "TGF Beta Signaling",
                                "chemokine-mediated signaling pathway"= "Chemokine Mediated Signaling Pathway")
  
  
  # row_order <- c("TNFA Signaling via NFKB",

  #                "Inflammatory Response",
  #                "TGF Beta Signaling",
  #                "Mitochondrial ATP Synthesis Coupled Electron Transport",
  #                "Hypoxia",
  #                "G2M Checkpoint",
  #                "E2F Targets",
  #                "mTORC1 Signaling",
  #                "Apoptosis",
  #                "Hydrogen Peroxide Metabolic Process",
  #                "Chemokine Mediated Signaling Pathway",
  #                "Immunoglobulin Complex",
  #                "T Cell Receptor Complex")
  
  source("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/functions.R")
  cd59_all_cell_types_lolipop <- get_complex_pathway_lollipop(
    df = complex_lolipop_df,
    manuall_changing_names = Changing_names_vector,
    condition = "CD59 def.",
    sample_name = "CD59 patient",
    dataset_name = "Mevorach",
    color_vector = c(
      "NK"            = "#B62055",  # claret-magenta
      "Monocytes"     = "#56B4E9",  # sky-blue  (unchanged)
      "B Cells"       = "#009E73",  # teal-green (unchanged)
      "CD4+ T cells"  = "#F0E442",  # vivid yellow (unchanged)
      "CD8+ T cells"  = "#F37707"   # pumpkin orange
    ),
    is_meta = TRUE,
    p_legend_max = 0.15,          # (C) upper limit for p.adjust legend; NULL = auto
    row_order    = NULL,          # (E) character vec in the order you want rows
    dodge_width  =  0            #    distance between lollipops on same row
  )
  
  
  pdf("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/tryp.pdf", width = 26, height = 20)
  print(cd59_all_cell_types_lolipop$p_pathway_lollipop)
  dev.off()
  
  
  
  ggsave(
    filename = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/CD59.Def_all_cell_type_lolipop.jpg",
    plot     = cd59_all_cell_types_lolipop$p_pathway_lollipop,
    width    = 26,      # inches – change to taste

    dpi      = 600,     # dots per inch
    device   = ragg::agg_jpeg,  # requires `ragg`; gives better anti-aliasing than base R
    quality  = 1) # JPEG quality (1 = 100 %)
  
  
  
  
  
}
```

```{r, "Trying to figure out CD4, CD8, NKs annotation", eval=FALSE}

#Trying to figure out CD4, CD8, NKs annotation
{
  get_volcano_non_coding_genes <- function(de_results,
                                           key_genes  = NULL,
                                           plottitle  = "") {
    #--------------------------------------------------
    #  Publication-style volcano plot
    #  • Non-coding / mitochondrial / ribosomal genes  → red
    #  • NK-signature genes                            → green
    #  • αβ-T-cell-signature genes                     → blue
    #  • Everything else                               → black
    #  • –log10(adj-p) capped at 280
    #  • key_genes (optional) additionally labelled
    #--------------------------------------------------
    #
    #  de_results  data.frame: avg_log2FC, p_val_adj, rownames = gene symbols
    #  key_genes   (optional) char vector or data.frame$gene_name to label
    #  plottitle   character; plot title
    #
    #  returns ggplot object
    #--------------------------------------------------
    
    ## ── libraries ───────────────────────────────────
    suppressPackageStartupMessages({
      library(tidyverse)
      library(ggrepel)
    })
    source('/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/ggplot_theme_Publication-2.R',
           local = TRUE)
    
    ## ── signature lists ─────────────────────────────
    nk_pos <- c("PRF1","GNLY","CST7","KLRD1","KLRF1","KLRC1",
                "KLRC3","CD160","CD244","FCGR3A","IL18RAP",
                "IL2RB","XCL2","NCR1","NKG7")
    
    t_neg  <- c("CD3D","CD3E","CD3G","CD247","TRAC","TRBC1","TRBC2",
                "CD4","CD8A","CD8B","CCR7","LTB","IL7R")
    
    ## ── data prep ──────────────────────────────────
    de_results$gene <- rownames(de_results)
    
    de_results$gene_type <- case_when(
      grepl("^(AC[0-9]+|AL[0-9]+|AP[0-9]+|MT|RP)", de_results$gene) ~
        "Non-Coding / MT / RP",
      de_results$gene %in% nk_pos                                         ~
        "NK marker",
      de_results$gene %in% t_neg                                          ~
        "T-cell marker",
      TRUE                                                                ~
        "Other gene"
    )
    
    # cap –log10(p_adj)
    de_results <- de_results %>%
      mutate(y_display = pmin(-log10(p_val_adj), 280))
    
    # allow key_genes to be df or vector
    if (is.data.frame(key_genes) && "gene_name" %in% names(key_genes))
      key_genes <- key_genes$gene_name
    
    # genes to label: union of NK, T markers, and key_genes (if provided)
    genes_to_label <- unique(c(nk_pos, t_neg, key_genes))
    
    max_x <- max(abs(de_results$avg_log2FC), na.rm = TRUE) + 1
    
    ## ── plot ────────────────────────────────────────
    p <- ggplot(de_results, aes(avg_log2FC, y_display)) +
      geom_point(aes(fill = gene_type),
                 shape = 21, size = 3,
                 colour = "black", stroke = 0.5, alpha = 0.9) +
      
      geom_label_repel(
        data  = filter(de_results, gene %in% genes_to_label),
        aes(label = gene, fill = gene_type),
        colour       = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 5,
        box.padding  = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3,
        segment.colour = "gray40", segment.size = 0.4,
        max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1.30, linetype = "dashed",
                 colour = "#03045e", size = 1) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed",
                 colour = "#03045e", size = 1) +
      
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-max_x, max_x),
                         breaks = c(-10, -5, -1, 0, 1, 5, 10)) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.2))) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Non-Coding / MT / RP" = "firebrick",
        "NK marker"            = "#009E73",
        "T-cell marker"        = "#56B4E9",
        "Other gene"           = "black"
      )) +
      
      labs(title = plottitle,
           x     = "Log2 Fold Change",
           y     = "-Log10 Adjusted P-value",
           fill  = NULL) +
      
      theme_Publication(base_size = 20) +
      theme(plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 24),
            legend.position = "bottom") +
      
      annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = -Inf,
               label = "–log10(p_adj) capped at 280",
               hjust = 0, vjust = -1, colour = "white", size = 3.5)
    
    return(p)
  }

               fontface = "bold", size = 6)
    
    cd4_volcano_labeled <- cd4_wierd_to_nk_volcano +
      annotate("text",
               x = -Inf,  y =  Inf,       # upper-left corner
               label   = "B",
               hjust   = -0.6, vjust = 1.2,
               fontface = "bold", size = 6)
    
    cd8_volcano_labeled <- cd8_wierd_to_nk_volcano +
      annotate("text",
               x = -Inf,  y =  Inf,
               label   = "C",
               hjust   = -0.6, vjust = 1.2,
               fontface = "bold", size = 6)
    
    ## ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ## 2. build the right-hand column (B over C, 50 % / 50 %)
    ## ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    right_column <- cd4_volcano_labeled /
      cd8_volcano_labeled +
      plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))
    
    ## ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ## 3. assemble final plot: A | (B / C)
    ## ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    final_plot <- dimplot_labeled | right_column +
      plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))   # 50 % / 50 %
    
    
    ggsave(
      "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/cd59_new_cell_annotation_and_volcanos_comparing_to_NK.jpg",
```

```{r, "pathway upset plot", eval=FALSE}
    group_lookup <- pathway_group_bank %>%
      dplyr::select(ID, group) %>%
      distinct()            # just in case
    
    ## ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    ## 2.  Add/replace “group” column in each sub-list
    ## ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    full_pathway_list <- imap(
      full_pathway_list,
      ~ .x %>%
        dplyr::select(-any_of("group")) %>%         # drop a pre-existing column, if any
        left_join(group_lookup, by = "ID") %>%
        mutate(group = coalesce(group, "Other"))
    )
    
    
  }
  
  
  #subset into positive and negative
  {
    
    ## 3. Generate *positive* and *negative* lists --------------------------------
    positive_list <- setNames(
      lapply(full_pathway_list, make_subsets, sign = "positive"),
      paste0(names(full_pathway_list), "_positive")
    )
    
    negative_list <- setNames(
      lapply(full_pathway_list, make_subsets, sign = "negative"),
      paste0(names(full_pathway_list), "_negative")
    )
    
    ## 4. Optionally expose each subset as its own object -------------------------
    list2env(c(positive_list, negative_list), envir = .GlobalEnv)
    # → now objects like NK_gsea_clean_positive / NK_gsea_clean_negative exist
    
    ## 5. Combine into the nested master list -------------------------------------
    full_pathway_list_subsetted <- list(
      full_pathway_list_positive = positive_list,
      full_pathway_list_negative = negative_list
    )
    
    rm(NK_gsea_negative, monocytes_gsea_negative, B_cells_gsea_negative, CD4_T_cells_gsea_negative, CD8_T_cells_gsea_negative)

    oxidative_set <- c(

      "R-HSA-73884","R-HSA-73893","R-HSA-73933","hsa03410"
      
    )
    
    p53sen_set <- c(
      "BIOCARTA_P27_PATHWAY","BIOCARTA_P53_PATHWAY",
      "GO:0010948","GO:0010972","GO:0045786","GO:0045839",
      
      "GO:2000774","R-HSA-2559583","R-HSA-2559585",

      "R-HSA-69613","R-HSA-69615","hsa04115","hsa04218"
    )
    
    # keep the original spelling everywhere ➜ add the missing i
    positive_stress_pathways_ids <- positive_pathway_upset_df %>% 
      filter(group == "Stress") %>% 
      pull(ID)
    
    positive_pathway_upset_df <- positive_pathway_upset_df %>% 
      mutate(group = case_when(
        ID %in% positive_stress_pathways_ids & ID %in% replication_set ~ "Replication-Stress",
        ID %in% positive_stress_pathways_ids & ID %in% oxidative_set   ~ "Oxidative-Stress",
        ID %in% positive_stress_pathways_ids & ID %in% p53sen_set      ~ "p53-Senescence",
        ID %in% positive_stress_pathways_ids &
          !(ID %in% c(replication_set, oxidative_set, p53sen_set))     ~ "Other",
        TRUE ~ group       # keep any pre-existing label
      ))
    
    
    positive_pathway_upset_df <- positive_pathway_upset_df %>% 
      mutate(group = case_when(group == "Pro Inhibitory" ~ "Other",
                               TRUE ~ group))
    
    positive_pathway_upset_df <- positive_pathway_upset_df %>% 
      mutate(group = case_when(ID %in% c("GO:0048245", "GO:0072677") ~ "Other",
                               TRUE ~ group))
    
    positive_pathway_upset_df <- positive_pathway_upset_df %>%

                               TRUE ~ group))

    legend_order   = c("Metabolism / Cellular Respiration","Oxidative-Stress", "Proliferation",

    mode      = "inclusive_intersection",
    big_title  = 32,
    big_axis   = 30,
    big_txt    = 22,
    big_legend = 30) 

    
    
    ggsave(
      filename = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/plots/multi_cell_analysis/upsets/positive_pathway_upset_plot.jpg",
      plot     = positive_pathway_upset_plot,
      width    = 36,
      height   = 26,
      units    = "in",
      dpi      = 600
    )
    

    
  }
  
  #negative pathway upset 
  
  {
    

    negative_pathway_upset_df <- build_presence_df(obj_list = full_pathway_list_subsetted$full_pathway_list_negative,
                                                   id_col = "ID",meta_cols = c("Description", "group", "dataset"))
    
    
    
    negative_pathway_upset_df <- negative_pathway_upset_df %>%
```

```{r, "Old add_pathway_group_reactome and add_pathway_group_goslim functions", eval=FALSE}
add_pathway_group_reactome_old <- function(gene_upset_df,
                              id_col      = "gene",
                              other_label = "Other / No Pathway") {
  
  ## ---- 1 · SYMBOL → ENTREZ --------------------------------------------------
  gene_syms <- gene_upset_df[[id_col]]
  gene_entrezid <- {
    tmp <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys      = gene_syms,
      keytype   = "SYMBOL",
      column    = "ENTREZID",
      multiVals = "first")
    unique(unname(na.omit(tmp)))
  }
  
  ## ---- 2 · Gene → all Reactome pathway IDs ---------------------------------
  ext2path <- get("reactomeEXTID2PATHID", asNamespace("reactome.db"))
  mapL     <- mget(gene_entrezid, ext2path, ifnotfound = NA)
  
  gene2path <- data.table::rbindlist(
    lapply(names(mapL), function(ez) {
      pid <- mapL[[ez]]
      if (all(is.na(pid))) return(NULL)
      data.table(ENTREZID = ez, PathwayID = pid)
    })
  )
  
  ## ---- 3 · Top-level pathway IDs -------------------------------------------
  get_top_ids <- function(species = "Homo sapiens", cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("reactomeTop","cache")){
    dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    rel_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt")
    pth_file <- file.path(cache_dir, "ReactomePathways.txt")
    if (!file.exists(rel_file))
      download.file("https://reactome.org/download/current/ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt",
                    rel_file, quiet = TRUE)
    if (!file.exists(pth_file))
      download.file("https://reactome.org/download/current/ReactomePathways.txt",
                    pth_file, quiet = TRUE)
    rel <- data.table::fread(rel_file, col.names = c("Parent","Child"))
    pth <- data.table::fread(pth_file, col.names = c("PathwayID","PathwayName","Species"))
    list(top_ids = intersect(setdiff(rel$Parent, rel$Child),
                             pth[Species == species, PathwayID]),
         rel = rel)
  }
  
  cache <- get_top_ids()
  top_ids <- cache$top_ids
  rel     <- cache$rel
  
  ## ---- 4 · Child → single parent map ---------------------------------------
  data.table::setorder(rel, Child, Parent)
  child_parent <- setNames(rel$Parent, rel$Child)
  child_parent <- child_parent[!duplicated(names(child_parent))]
  
  find_top <- function(pid){
    while (!is.na(pid) && !(pid %in% top_ids)) pid <- child_parent[pid]
    pid
  }
  
  ## ---- 5 · Annotate & collapse ---------------------------------------------
  gene2path[, TopID := vapply(PathwayID, find_top, character(1))]
  gene2path  <- gene2path[!is.na(TopID)]
  
  all_ids <- unique(c(gene2path$TopID, gene2path$PathwayID))
  id2name <- unlist(mget(na.omit(all_ids),
                         reactomePATHID2NAME, ifnotfound = NA))
  gene2path[, Cluster :=
              fifelse(!is.na(TopID), id2name[TopID], id2name[PathwayID])]
  gene2path[, Cluster := sub("^Homo sapiens:\\s*", "", Cluster)]
  
  gene2path_final <- gene2path[
    , .(Cluster = {tab <- table(na.omit(Cluster))
    if (length(tab)) names(tab)[which.max(tab)] else NA_character_}),
    by = ENTREZID]
  
  ## ---- 6 · ENTREZ → SYMBOL --------------------------------------------------
  id2sym <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                                  keys      = gene2path_final$ENTREZID,
                                  keytype   = "ENTREZID",
                                  column    = "SYMBOL",
                                  multiVals = "first")
  gene2path_final[, HUGO := id2sym[ENTREZID]]
  
  ## ---- 7 · Join back to input ----------------------------------------------
  out <- gene_upset_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gene2path_final %>% dplyr::select(HUGO, Cluster),
                     by = setNames("HUGO", id_col)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(group_reactome = dplyr::if_else(is.na(Cluster), other_label, Cluster),
                  .keep = "unused")      # drops Cluster
  
  return(out)
}





add_pathway_group_GoSlim <- function(gene_upset_df,
                                      target_groups = c("anatomical structure development",
                                                        "DNA-templated transcription"),
                                      unwanted_slim = c("GO:0006351", "GO:0023052", "GO:0048856"),
                                      slim_obo = "https://current.geneontology.org/ontology/subsets/goslim_generic.obo") {
  

  ## 1 · pull the genes you want to re-annotate
  gene_syms <- gene_upset_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data$group_go %in% target_groups) %>%
    dplyr::pull(.data$gene) %>%
    unique()
  
  if (!length(gene_syms)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(Symbol = character(), Bucket = character()))
  }
  
  ## 2 · SYMBOL → ENTREZ
  gene_entrezid <- {
    tmp <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys      = gene_syms,
      keytype   = "SYMBOL",
      column    = "ENTREZID",
      multiVals = "first")
    unique(unname(stats::na.omit(tmp)))
  }
  
  if (!length(gene_entrezid)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(Symbol = gene_syms, Bucket = "Other / No Pathway"))
  }
  
  ## 3 · Full BP annotation
  ann <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = gene_entrezid,
                               keytype = "ENTREZID",
                               columns = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY"))
  ann <- ann[ann$ONTOLOGY == "BP" & !is.na(ann$GO), c("ENTREZID", "GO")]
  
  if (!nrow(ann)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(Symbol = gene_syms, Bucket = "Other / No Pathway"))
  }
  
  ## 4 · Map to GO-Slim generic
  goslim     <- GSEABase::getOBOCollection(slim_obo)
  goslim_ids <- unlist(GSEABase::ids(goslim))
  
  data("GOBPANCESTOR", package = "GO.db", envir = environment())
  go2slim <- function(go){
    anc <- GO.db::GOBPANCESTOR[[go]]
    slim_hit <- intersect(anc, goslim_ids)
    if (length(slim_hit)) slim_hit[1] else NA_character_
  }
  ann$Slim <- vapply(ann$GO, go2slim, character(1))
  
  ## 5 · Majority-vote bucket (exclude unwanted slim terms)
  gene2bucket <- data.table::as.data.table(ann)[, .(
    Slim = {
      tab <- table(Slim[!Slim %in% unwanted_slim])
      if (length(tab)) names(tab)[which.max(tab)] else NA_character_
    }), by = ENTREZID]
  
  ## 6 · ENTREZ → SYMBOL + human-readable name
  gene2bucket[, Symbol := AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                                                keys      = ENTREZID,
                                                column    = "SYMBOL",
                                                keytype   = "ENTREZID",
                                                multiVals = "first")]
  
  go_lookup <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db,
    keys    = stats::na.omit(unique(gene2bucket$Slim)),
    keytype = "GOID",
    columns = "TERM"
  )
  
  gene2bucket_named <- gene2bucket %>%
    dplyr::left_join(go_lookup,  by = c("Slim" = "GOID")) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Symbol,
      Bucket = ifelse(is.na(TERM) | TERM == "",
                      "Other / No Pathway", TERM)
    )
  
  gene2bucket_named
}
```

```{r, "Old create_meta_table function", eval=FALSE}


create_meta_table <- function(output_list) {
  # 1) Flatten output_list into a simple list of "sample" objects.
  #    Each "sample" has sample$original_table.
  #    unlist(..., recursive = FALSE) unwraps one level so we can iterate over them directly.
  samples_list <- unlist(output_list, recursive = FALSE)
  
  # 2) Combine all sample$original_table data into one big data frame:
  #    - Convert each sample's table into a data frame
  #    - Add a "gene" column from the rownames
  
  samples_names <- names(samples_list)             # keep the names once
  combined_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(samples_list), function(i) {
    df <- samples_list[[i]]$original_table
    df$gene    <- rownames(df)
    df$dataset <- sub("\\..*$", "", samples_names[i])   # e.g. "Mevorach.CD55-control" → "Mevorach"
    df
  }))
  
  # 3) Precompute columns to support dsi_scores:
  #    - "is_up" = 1 if avg_log2FC >= 1 & p_val_adj <= 0.05, else 0
  #    - "is_down" = 1 if avg_log2FC <= -1 & p_val_adj <= 0.05, else 0
  #    These let us sum up upregulated/downregulated counts by gene.
  combined_df <- combined_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_up = ifelse(!is.na(avg_log2FC) & avg_log2FC >= 1 &
                       !is.na(p_val_adj)  & p_val_adj <= 0.05, 1, 0),
      is_down = ifelse(!is.na(avg_log2FC) & avg_log2FC <= -1 &
                         !is.na(p_val_adj) & p_val_adj <= 0.05, 1, 0)
    )
  
  # 4) Summarize per gene using dplyr:
  #    This replaces the nested for-loops. We group by gene, then
  #    aggregate stats: comparisons_num, fisher_score, valid_comparisons, etc.
  
  meta_table <- combined_df %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarize(
      comparisons_num    = n(),
      fisher_score       = sum(-2 * log(p_val), na.rm = TRUE), # sum of -2*ln(p_val)
      valid_comparisons  = sum(!is.na(p_val)), # how many p_vals are not NA
      ## exclude Mevorach rows whose p_val > 0.05
      avg_log2FC   = mean( avg_log2FC[ !(dataset == "Mevorach" & p_val > 0.05) ], na.rm = TRUE ),
      median_log2FC= median( avg_log2FC[ !(dataset == "Mevorach" & p_val > 0.05) ], na.rm = TRUE ),
      num_upregulated    = sum(is_up),
      num_downregulated  = sum(is_down),
      dsi                = sum(is_up) - sum(is_down) # dsi = (#up) - (#down)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  
  # 5) Compute Fisher’s combined p-values, then BH adjust:
  #    - If valid_comparisons == 0, set NA
  meta_table <- meta_table %>%
    mutate(
      p_val_fisher = if_else(
        valid_comparisons == 0,
        NA_real_,
        1 - pchisq(fisher_score, df = 2 * valid_comparisons)
      ),
      q_val_fisher = p.adjust(p_val_fisher, method = "BH")
    )
  
  # 6) Round numeric columns where needed, to match your original
  meta_table <- meta_table %>%
    mutate(
      fisher         = round(fisher_score, 2),
      avg_log2FC     = round(avg_log2FC, 2)
      # median_log2FC can remain unrounded or you can also round it if you want:
      # median_log2FC = round(median_log2FC, 2)
    )
  
  # 7) Reorder columns to match your original output format
  #    and keep the data frame structure consistent.
  meta_table <- meta_table %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene,
      # "comparisons_num", "dsi", "num_upregulated", "num_downregulated",
      # "avg_log2FC", "median_log2FC", "fisher", "valid_comparisons",
      # "p_val_fisher", "q_val_fisher"
      comparisons_num,
      dsi,
      num_upregulated,
      num_downregulated,
      avg_log2FC,
      median_log2FC,
      fisher,           # from fisher_score
      valid_comparisons,
      p_val_fisher,
      q_val_fisher
    )
  meta_table <- as.data.frame(meta_table)
  
  
  # 8) Make gene names row names (optional).
  #    Remove the gene column if you like or keep it if you prefer.
  #    In your original code, "gene" wasn't an explicit column, so let's mimic that:
  rownames(meta_table) <- meta_table$gene
  
  # Return the final meta_table
  return(meta_table)
}
```

```{r, "old get_table_for_forest and create_forest_plot functions", eval=FALSE}


get_table_for_forest <- function(output_list, gene) {
  # Builds a “forest” summary table for one gene across many samples
  
  # Empty container ─ now includes p_val_adj
  forest_table <- data.frame(
    dataset   = character(),
    sample    = character(),
    avg_log2FC = numeric(),
    pct_2      = numeric(),
    CI_lower   = numeric(),
    CI_upper   = numeric(),
    p_val_adj  = numeric(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # -------- main loop --------
  for (dataset_name in names(output_list)) {
    for (sample_name in names(output_list[[dataset_name]])) {
      
      final_tbl <- output_list[[dataset_name]][[sample_name]]$original_table
      
      if (gene %in% rownames(final_tbl)) {
        row <- final_tbl[ gene, , drop = FALSE ]
        
        # Wald-type CI from p_val_adj (or use row$p_val if preferred)
        SE <- abs(row$avg_log2FC) / qnorm(1 - row$p_val / 2)
        
        forest_table <- rbind(
          forest_table,
          data.frame(
            dataset    = dataset_name,
            sample     = sample_name,
            avg_log2FC = row$avg_log2FC,
            pct_2      = row$pct.2,
            CI_lower   = row$avg_log2FC - 1.96 * SE,
            CI_upper   = row$avg_log2FC + 1.96 * SE,
            p_val_adj  = row$p_val_adj,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
      } else {
        forest_table <- rbind(
          forest_table,
          data.frame(
            dataset    = dataset_name,
            sample     = sample_name,
            avg_log2FC = NA,
            pct_2      = NA,
            CI_lower   = NA,
            CI_upper   = NA,
            p_val_adj  = NA,
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # -------- one-time pct_1 lookup (still from original_table) --------
  pct_1 <- NA
  for (dataset_name in names(output_list)) {
    for (sample_name in names(output_list[[dataset_name]])) {
      tbl <- output_list[[dataset_name]][[sample_name]]$original_table
      if (gene %in% rownames(tbl)) {
        pct_1 <- tbl$pct.1[ match(gene, rownames(tbl)) ]
        break
      }
    }
    if (!is.na(pct_1)) break
  }
  
  forest_table$pct_1 <- pct_1
  return(forest_table)
}

create_forest_plot <- function(forest_table, gene) {
  
  # Description:
  #   Given a forest‐table (from get_table_for_forest) and a gene name, returns
  #   a ggplot2 “forest” plot of avg_log2FC (with CIs) sized by pct_2 and
  #   colored by dataset.
  # Arguments:
  #   forest_table – data.frame as returned by get_table_for_forest.
  #   gene         – character string; gene symbol to use in plot title.
  # Returns:
  #   A ggplot object displaying the ordered forest plot.
  
  # Order the rows by avg_log2FC
  forest_table <- forest_table[order(forest_table$avg_log2FC, decreasing = FALSE), ]
  forest_table$sample <- factor(forest_table$sample, levels = forest_table$sample)  # Set factor levels to ensure proper ordering
  
  # Determine x-axis lines and breaks
  y_lines <- c(0)
  
  # Create the vertical forest plot
  forest_plot <- ggplot(forest_table, aes(y = avg_log2FC, x = sample)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pct_2, color = dataset), shape = 16, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), width = 0.2, color = "black") +  # Add CI lines
    geom_hline(yintercept = y_lines, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 0.8) +  # Add conditional dashed lines
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8)) +  # Adjust point size scale for visibility
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)(forest_table$avg_log2FC), y_lines)) +  # Ensure lines appear on y-axis
    theme_minimal() +  # Minimalistic theme
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Remove x-axis title
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # Adjust x-axis text size and orientation
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),  # Adjust y-axis text size
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12),  # Adjust legend title size
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),  # Adjust legend text size
      plot.title = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, color = "black")  # Center and adjust title size using markdown rendering
    ) +
    ylab("Log2 Fold Change") +  # Y-axis label
    ggtitle(paste0(nrow(forest_table), " Comparisons of <b>", gene, "</b> Expression (Pct.1 = ", round(unique(forest_table$pct_1)[1], 3), ")")) +  # Set plot title
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#ffc857", "#e9724c", "#c5283d", "#481d24", "#976391", "#255f85", "#2a9d8f", "#283618", "#606c38")) +  # Add custom colors
    guides(
      size = guide_legend(title = "pct.2"),
      color = guide_legend(title = "Dataset")
    )
  
  # Print the plot
  return(forest_plot)
}
```

```{r, "unparalell get_ora function", eval=FALSE}
get_ora <- function(meta_table_list, log2FC_threshold = 1, positive = TRUE ,q_value_threshold = 0.05,
                    cols = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells")) {
  
  
  #sanity-check arguments 
  {
    # 0a. make sure meta_table_list is a named list with the 5 expected elements
    expected_names <- c("NK_meta_table",
                        "monocytes_meta_table",
                        "B_cells_meta_table",
                        "CD4_T_cells_meta_table",
                        "CD8_T_cells_meta_table")
    
    if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || is.null(names(meta_table_list))) {
      stop("meta_table_list must be a *named* list holding the five cell-type meta tables.",
           call. = FALSE)
    }
    
    missing <- setdiff(expected_names, names(meta_table_list))
    extra    <- setdiff(names(meta_table_list), expected_names)
    
    if (length(missing) || length(extra)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "meta_table_list must contain exactly these elements *in this order*:\n",
          paste0(" • ", expected_names, collapse = "\n"),
          "\n\n",
          if (length(missing))
            paste0("Missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n") else "",
          if (length(extra))
            paste0("Extra:   ", paste(extra,   collapse = ", "), "\n") else ""
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    if (!identical(names(meta_table_list), expected_names)) {
      stop("The elements in meta_table_list are present but *not in the required order*.\n",
           "Please reorder them exactly as: ",
           paste(expected_names, collapse = ", "),
           call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
  
  
  ## ── 1 · filter each meta table by DE cut-offs ──────────────────────────────
  {
    
    meta_table_list_filtered <- map(
      meta_table_list,
      function(df) {
        if (positive) {
          filter(df,
                 median_log2FC  >  log2FC_threshold,
                 q_val_fisher   <= q_value_threshold)
        } else {
          filter(df,
                 median_log2FC  < -log2FC_threshold,  # note the minus sign
                 q_val_fisher   <= q_value_threshold)
        }
      }
    )
    
  }
  
  
  ## ── 2 · gene × cell-type presence matrix (upset DF) ────────────────────────
  gene_upset_df <- build_presence_df(
    meta_table_list_filtered,   # your helper from earlier
    id_col = "gene"
  )
  
  # foreground (intersection genes)
  {
    # 3a. check the cols argument first
    if (missing(cols) || !length(cols)) {
      stop("cols must be a non-empty character vector of column names to intersect.",
           call. = FALSE)
    }
    
    not_found <- setdiff(cols, names(gene_upset_df))
    if (length(not_found)) {
      stop("The following columns are missing in gene_upset_df: ",
           paste(not_found, collapse = ", "),
           call. = FALSE)
    }
    
    gene_ORA_df <- gene_upset_df |>
      dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cols), \(x) x))
    
    rownames(gene_ORA_df) <- gene_ORA_df$gene
    
    
    ora_vec_meta_sym <- unique(gene_ORA_df$gene)
    
    # ENTREZ – map symbols → ENTREZ, drop NAs & duplicates, strip names
    ora_vec_meta_ent <- {
      tmp <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
        org.Hs.eg.db,
        keys      = ora_vec_meta_sym,
        keytype   = "SYMBOL",
        column    = "ENTREZID",
        multiVals = "first"
      )
      unique(unname(na.omit(tmp)))
    }
  }
  
  
  
  # universe (genes tested in *every* cell type) 
  {
    genes_in_celltype <- function(meta_tbl) {
      meta_tbl %>% 
        dplyr::filter(comparisons_num > 0)  %>%    # or valid_comparisons > 0
        dplyr::pull(gene)  %>% 
        unique()
    }
    
    gene_sets <- purrr::map(meta_table_list, genes_in_celltype)
    universe_genes_sym  <- purrr::reduce(gene_sets, intersect)  %>%  sort()
    
    
    universe_genes_entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys      = universe_genes_sym,
      column    = "ENTREZID",
      keytype   = "SYMBOL",
      multiVals = "first"          # keep just one ENTREZ per symbol
    ) |>
      stats::na.omit() |>          # drop NAs
      unname() |>                  # remove names
      unique() |>                  # de-duplicate
      sort()                       # alphabetical order
    
    
  }
  
  
  
  # ORA itself
  {
    
    
    #    b) Run Reactome
    meta_reactome <- ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = ora_vec_meta_ent, organism = "human", universe = universe_genes_entrez)
    
    meta_reactome@result <- meta_reactome@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.05)
    #    c) Run KEGG
    meta_kegg     <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(gene = ora_vec_meta_ent, organism = "human", universe = universe_genes_entrez)
    
    
    meta_kegg@result <- meta_kegg@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.05)
    
    #    d) Run Hallmark
    hallmark_df <- msigdbr(
      species  = "Homo sapiens",   # same as before
      category = "H"               # “H” = Hallmark collection
    ) %>%
      dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) # TERM2GENE format (symbol column)
    
    meta_h        <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene =ora_vec_meta_sym,
                                               TERM2GENE = hallmark_df,
                                               universe  = universe_genes_sym)
    
    meta_h@result <- meta_h@result %>% filter(p.adjust  <= 0.05)
    
    
    
    # e)  Run GO: Biological-Process 
    meta_gobp <- enrichGO(
      gene      = ora_vec_meta_ent,   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "BP",                # Biological Process
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    meta_gobp@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_gobp@result, p.adjust <= 0.05)
    
    # f)  Run GO: Cellular-Component 
    meta_gocc <- enrichGO(
      gene      = ora_vec_meta_ent,   # ENTREZ-named numeric vector
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      ont           = "CC",                # Cellular Component
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05
    )
    
    
    meta_gocc@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_gocc@result, p.adjust <= 0.05)
    
    # g)  Run BioCarta pathways (MSigDB C2 CP:BIOCARTA 2016+)
    
    biocarta_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
      species     = "Homo sapiens",
      category    = "C2",
      subcategory = "CP:BIOCARTA"          # BioCarta collection
    ) |>
      dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)  # TERM2GENE format
    
    meta_biocarta <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = ora_vec_meta_ent,
                                               TERM2GENE = biocarta_df,
                                               universe  = universe_genes_entrez)
    
    
    meta_biocarta@result   <- dplyr::filter(meta_biocarta@result, pvalue <= 0.05)
    
    
  }
  
  
  
  # create_return_list
  
  return_list <- list(
    meta_reactome  = meta_reactome,
    meta_kegg      = meta_kegg,
    meta_h         = meta_h,
    meta_gobp      = meta_gobp,
    meta_gocc      = meta_gocc,
    meta_biocarta  = meta_biocarta
  )
  
  
  
  return(return_list)
}
```

```{r, "failed ways to calculte fold change for gene overlap between cell types", eval=FALSE}
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1.  Gather overlap statistics for a fixed filter (direction / thresholds)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_overlap_stats <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    sets             = c("NK_meta_table",
                         "monocytes_meta_table",
                         "B_cells_meta_table",
                         "CD4_T_cells_meta_table",
                         "CD8_T_cells_meta_table"),
    log2fc_threshold = 1,
    positive         = TRUE,
    q_val_threshold  = 0.05)
{
  ## 1 · Sanity checks ---------------------------------------------------------
  if (!all(sets %in% names(meta_table_list))) {
    stop("Missing sets: ",
         paste(sets[!sets %in% names(meta_table_list)], collapse = ", "))
  }
  bad <- vapply(
    meta_table_list,
    \(x) !is.data.frame(x) ||
      !all(c("gene", "median_log2FC", "q_val_fisher") %in% names(x)),
    logical(1)
  )
  if (any(bad)) {
    stop("Invalid data frames: ",
         paste(names(meta_table_list)[bad], collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  ## 2 · Universe --------------------------------------------------------------
  gene_universe <- unique(unlist(lapply(meta_table_list, `[[`, "gene"),
                                 use.names = FALSE))
  N <- length(gene_universe)
  
  ## 3 · Directional filter ----------------------------------------------------
  fc_filter <- if (positive) {
    \(df) dplyr::filter(df,
                        median_log2FC  >  log2fc_threshold,
                        q_val_fisher   <= q_val_threshold)
  } else {
    \(df) dplyr::filter(df,
                        median_log2FC  < -log2fc_threshold,
                        q_val_fisher   <= q_val_threshold)
  }
  
  filtered_lists <- lapply(meta_table_list[sets], fc_filter)
  A_vec          <- vapply(filtered_lists, nrow, integer(1))
  
  ## 4 · Overlap ---------------------------------------------------------------
  overlap_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(filtered_lists, `[[`, "gene"))
  overlap_num   <- length(overlap_genes)
  
  ## 5 · Return ---------------------------------------------------------------
  list(
    N             = N,
    gene_universe = gene_universe,
    A_vector      = A_vec,
    filtered_lists= filtered_lists,
    overlap_genes = overlap_genes,
    overlap_num   = overlap_num
  )
}

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2.  Empirical permutation test (simple gene-sampling version)
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_empirical_permutation <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    sets             = c("NK_meta_table",
                         "monocytes_meta_table",
                         "B_cells_meta_table",
                         "CD4_T_cells_meta_table",
                         "CD8_T_cells_meta_table"),
    log2fc_threshold = 1,
    positive         = TRUE,
    q_val_threshold  = 0.05,
    n_perm           = 10000,
    seed             = NULL)
{
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  ## 1 · Grab observed stats ---------------------------------------------------
  obs <- get_overlap_stats(meta_table_list,
                           sets, log2fc_threshold,
                           positive, q_val_threshold)
  
  genes <- obs$gene_universe
  A_vec <- obs$A_vector
  k     <- length(A_vec)
  
  ## 2 · Permutation -----------------------------------------------------------
  perm_overlap <- replicate(n_perm, {
    rand_lists <- lapply(A_vec, \(m) sample(genes, m, replace = FALSE))
    length(Reduce(intersect,
                  lapply(rand_lists, as.character)))
  })
  
  expected      <- mean(perm_overlap)
  fold_enrich   <- obs$overlap_num / expected
  p_val         <- mean(perm_overlap >= obs$overlap_num)
  
  ## 3 · Optional: leave-one-out overlaps -------------------------------------
  lol_combos <- combn(seq_len(k), k - 1, simplify = FALSE)
  
  observed_4of5 <- sapply(lol_combos, \(idx) {
    length(Reduce(intersect,
                  lapply(obs$filtered_lists[idx], `[[`, "gene")))
  })
  
  perm_4of5 <- replicate(n_perm, {
    rand_lists <- lapply(A_vec, \(m) sample(genes, m, replace = FALSE))
    sapply(lol_combos, \(idx) {
      length(Reduce(intersect, lapply(rand_lists[idx], as.character)))
    })
  })
  
  expected_4of5 <- rowMeans(perm_4of5)
  fold_4of5     <- observed_4of5 / expected_4of5
  p_4of5        <- rowMeans(t(perm_4of5) >= observed_4of5[col(perm_4of5)])
  
  ## 4 · Return ---------------------------------------------------------------
  list(
    observed_all5   = obs$overlap_num,
    expected_all5   = expected,
    fold_all5       = fold_enrich,
    p_all5          = p_val,
    
    observed_4of5   = observed_4of5,
    expected_4of5   = expected_4of5,
    fold_4of5       = fold_4of5,
    p_4of5          = p_4of5,
    
    perm_distribution_all5 = perm_overlap,
    perm_distribution_4of5 = perm_4of5  # matrix: combo × perm
  )
}








# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  Helper: build a 0/1 gene × cell-type matrix of “hits”
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
build_hit_matrix <- function(meta_table_list,
                             log2fc_threshold = 1,
                             positive         = TRUE,
                             q_val_threshold  = 0.05) {
  
  filter_fun <- if (positive) {
    \(df) df |>
      dplyr::filter(median_log2FC >  log2fc_threshold,
                    q_val_fisher  <= q_val_threshold) |>
      dplyr::select(gene)
  } else {
    \(df) df |>
      dplyr::filter(median_log2FC < -log2fc_threshold,
                    q_val_fisher  <= q_val_threshold) |>
      dplyr::select(gene)
  }
  
  gene_universe <- unique(unlist(lapply(meta_table_list, \(x) x$gene)))
  hit_mat <- matrix(0L,
                    nrow = length(gene_universe),
                    ncol = length(meta_table_list),
                    dimnames = list(gene_universe,
                                    names(meta_table_list)))
  
  for (ct in names(meta_table_list)) {
    keep <- filter_fun(meta_table_list[[ct]])$gene
    hit_mat[keep, ct] <- 1L
  }
  hit_mat
}


# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  1 · RAW-DATA SHUFFLE  →  p-value + enrichment
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
overlap_perm_raw <- function(meta_table_list,
                             log2fc_threshold = 1,
                             positive         = TRUE,
                             q_val_threshold  = 0.05,
                             n_perm           = 10000,
                             seed             = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  S <- build_hit_matrix(meta_table_list,
                         log2fc_threshold, positive, q_val_threshold)
  
  k        <- ncol(S)
  combos4  <- combn(seq_len(k), k - 1, simplify = FALSE)
  
  overlap_size <- \(mat, idx = seq_len(k))
  sum(rowSums(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]) == length(idx))
  
  # ── observed
  obs_all5 <- overlap_size(S)
  obs_4of5 <- sapply(combos4, \(idx) overlap_size(S, idx))
  
  # ── permutations
  genes <- rownames(S)
  A_vec <- colSums(S)           # keep list-size per column
  perm_all5 <- integer(n_perm)
  perm_4of5 <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(combos4), ncol = n_perm)
  
  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    S_star <- sapply(A_vec, \(m) {
      out <- integer(length(genes))
      out[sample.int(length(genes), m)] <- 1L
      out
    })
    dimnames(S_star) <- dimnames(S)
    
    perm_all5[b]   <- overlap_size(S_star)
    perm_4of5[, b] <- sapply(combos4, \(idx) overlap_size(S_star, idx))
  }
  
  expected_all5 <- mean(perm_all5)
  fold_all5     <- obs_all5 / expected_all5
  p_all5        <- (sum(perm_all5 >= obs_all5) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  
  expected_4of5 <- rowMeans(perm_4of5)
  fold_4of5     <- obs_4of5 / expected_4of5
  p_4of5        <- rowMeans(t(perm_4of5) >= obs_4of5[col(perm_4of5)])
  
  list(
    observed_all5   = obs_all5,
    expected_all5   = expected_all5,
    fold_all5       = fold_all5,
    p_all5          = p_all5,
    
    observed_4of5   = setNames(obs_4of5, paste0("omit_", colnames(S))),
    expected_4of5   = expected_4of5,
    fold_4of5       = fold_4of5,
    p_4of5          = p_4of5,
    
    perm_distribution_all5 = perm_all5,
    perm_distribution_4of5 = perm_4of5
  )
}


# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  2 · RESIDUAL SHUFFLE  →  95 % CI + enrichment + p-value
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
overlap_perm_residual <- function(meta_table_list,
                                  log2fc_threshold = 1,
                                  positive         = TRUE,
                                  q_val_threshold  = 0.05,
                                  n_perm           = 10000,
                                  seed             = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  S <- build_hit_matrix(meta_table_list,
                         log2fc_threshold, positive, q_val_threshold)
  k <- ncol(S)
  combos4 <- combn(seq_len(k), k - 1, simplify = FALSE)
  
  overlap_size <- \(mat, idx = seq_len(k))
  sum(rowSums(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]) == length(idx))
  
  # ── observed
  obs_all5 <- overlap_size(S)
  obs_4of5 <- sapply(combos4, \(idx) overlap_size(S, idx))
  
  # ── residual set-up
  pi_col <- colMeans(S)           # fitted probability per column
  R      <- sweep(S, 2, pi_col)   # residuals
  
  # ── permutations
  # -- permutations (inside the function)
  perm_all5 <- integer(n_perm)
  perm_4of5 <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(combos4), ncol = n_perm)
  
  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    R_star <- apply(R, 2, sample)          # shuffle each column separately
    S_star <- sweep(R_star, 2, pi_col, "+") > 0.5
    perm_all5[b]   <- overlap_size(S_star)
    perm_4of5[, b] <- sapply(combos4, \(idx) overlap_size(S_star, idx))
  }
  
  
  # ── summaries
  expected_all5 <- mean(perm_all5)
  fold_all5     <- obs_all5 / expected_all5
  log2FC_all5   <- log2(fold_all5)
  ci_all5       <- quantile(perm_all5, c(0.025, 0.975))
  p_all5        <- (sum(perm_all5 >= obs_all5) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  
  expected_4of5 <- rowMeans(perm_4of5)
  fold_4of5     <- obs_4of5 / expected_4of5
  log2FC_4of5   <- log2(fold_4of5)
  ci_4of5       <- t(apply(perm_4of5, 1, quantile, c(0.025, 0.975)))
  p_4of5        <- rowMeans(t(perm_4of5) >= obs_4of5[col(perm_4of5)])
  
  list(
    observed_all5   = obs_all5,
    expected_all5   = expected_all5,
    fold_all5       = fold_all5,
    log2FC_all5     = log2FC_all5,
    ci_all5_95      = as.numeric(ci_all5),
    p_all5          = p_all5,
    
    observed_4of5   = setNames(obs_4of5, paste0("omit_", colnames(S))),
    expected_4of5   = expected_4of5,
    fold_4of5       = fold_4of5,
    log2FC_4of5     = log2FC_4of5,
    ci_4of5_95      = ci_4of5,
    p_4of5          = p_4of5,
    
    perm_distribution_all5 = perm_all5,
    perm_distribution_4of5 = perm_4of5
  )
}


overlap_perm_pattern <- function(meta_table_list,
                                 log2fc_threshold = 1,
                                 positive         = TRUE,
                                 q_val_threshold  = 0.05,
                                 n_perm           = 10000,
                                 seed             = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  S <- build_hit_matrix(meta_table_list,
                        log2fc_threshold, positive, q_val_threshold)
  k        <- ncol(S)
  combos4  <- combn(seq_len(k), k - 1, simplify = FALSE)
  
  # helper: count genes present in *all* idx columns
  overlap_size <- \(mat, idx = seq_len(k))
  sum(rowSums(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE]) == length(idx))
  
  ## ── observed
  obs_all5 <- overlap_size(S)
  obs_4of5 <- sapply(combos4, \(idx) overlap_size(S, idx))
  
  ## ── pre-compute pattern vector
  pattern_vec <- apply(S, 1, paste, collapse = "")
  patterns    <- names(table(pattern_vec))
  pat_prob    <- prop.table(table(pattern_vec))
  N           <- nrow(S)
  
  # identify which patterns correspond to all 5 or 4 of 5 hits
  pat_bits <- t(vapply(strsplit(patterns, ""),
                       \(x) as.integer(x), integer(k)))
  rownames(pat_bits) <- patterns
  pat_is_all5 <- rowSums(pat_bits) == k
  pat_is_4of5 <- lapply(combos4, \(idx)
                        rowSums(pat_bits[, idx, drop = FALSE]) == k - 1)
  
  ## ── permutations
  perm_all5 <- integer(n_perm)
  perm_4of5 <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(combos4), ncol = n_perm)
  
  for (b in seq_len(n_perm)) {
    perm_pat <- sample(patterns, size = N, replace = TRUE, prob = pat_prob)
    
    perm_all5[b] <- sum(pat_is_all5[perm_pat])
    
    for (c in seq_along(combos4))
      perm_4of5[c, b] <- sum(pat_is_4of5[[c]][perm_pat])
  }
  
  ## ── summaries
  expected_all5 <- mean(perm_all5)
  fold_all5     <- obs_all5 / expected_all5
  p_all5        <- (sum(perm_all5 >= obs_all5) + 1) / (n_perm + 1)
  
  expected_4of5 <- rowMeans(perm_4of5)
  fold_4of5     <- obs_4of5 / expected_4of5
  p_4of5        <- rowMeans(perm_4of5 >= obs_4of5)
  
  names(obs_4of5)      <- paste0("omit_", colnames(S))
  names(expected_4of5) <- names(fold_4of5) <- names(p_4of5) <- names(obs_4of5)
  
  list(
    observed_all5   = obs_all5,
    expected_all5   = expected_all5,
    fold_all5       = fold_all5,
    p_all5          = p_all5,
    
    observed_4of5   = obs_4of5,
    expected_4of5   = expected_4of5,
    fold_4of5       = fold_4of5,
    p_4of5          = p_4of5,
    
    perm_distribution_all5 = perm_all5,
    perm_distribution_4of5 = perm_4of5
  )
}
```
