```{r, "Oxidative stress biological analysis", eval=FALSE}
        )
        
      }
      
      
      #create analysis_df
      {

    
        wanted   <- c("NK cells","B cells","Monocytes","CD4+ T cells","CD8+ T cells")
        present  <- intersect(wanted, as.character(unique(seu_cd59$final_cell_type)))
        
        scores_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(present, function(lbl) {
          make_sig_df(subset(seu_cd59, subset = final_cell_type == lbl), lbl)
        }))
        
        # optional: drop rows with missing scores and tidy types
        scores_df <- subset(scores_df, 
                            !is.na(TNFA_NFKB_signature) & !is.na(oxidative_stress_signature))
        scores_df <- scores_df %>% 
          dplyr::mutate(
            TNFA_NFKB_signature       = as.numeric(TNFA_NFKB_signature),
            oxidative_stress_signature = as.numeric(oxidative_stress_signature),
            # make cell_type a factor if you like
            cell_type                  = factor(cell_type,
                                                levels = c("NK cells","B cells",
                                                           "Monocytes","CD4+ T cells","CD8+ T cells")))
        
        # merge covariates from Seurat meta.data
        md <- seu_cd59@meta.data
        covars <- intersect(c("percent_mito","S.Score","G2M.Score","nCount_SCT","nFeature_SCT"),
                            colnames(md))
        # choose one depth metric
        depth_var <- if ("nCount_SCT" %in% covars) "nCount_SCT" else "nFeature_SCT"
        use_covars <- c("percent_mito","S.Score","G2M.Score", depth_var)
        
        analysis_df <- scores_df %>%
          mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type,
                                    levels = c("NK cells","B cells","Monocytes","CD4+ T cells","CD8+ T cells"))) %>%
          bind_cols(md[rownames(scores_df), use_covars, drop = FALSE]) %>%
          mutate(across(all_of(use_covars), as.numeric)) %>%
          tidyr::drop_na(TNFA_NFKB_signature, oxidative_stress_signature)
    
        
      }
      
      
      
      {

        
        # --- prep
        plot_df <- scores_df %>%
          dplyr::filter(cell_type %in% c("NK cells","B cells","Monocytes","CD4+ T cells","CD8+ T cells")) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(
            oxidative_stress_signature = as.numeric(oxidative_stress_signature),
            TNFA_NFKB_signature        = as.numeric(TNFA_NFKB_signature),
            cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = c("NK cells","B cells","Monocytes","CD4+ T cells","CD8+ T cells"))
          ) %>%
          tidyr::drop_na(oxidative_stress_signature, TNFA_NFKB_signature)
        
        high_cols <- c(
          "NK cells"      = "#B62055",
          "B cells"       = "#009E73",
          "Monocytes"     = "#56B4E9",
          "CD4+ T cells"  = "#F0E442",
          "CD8+ T cells"  = "#F37707"
        )
        
        # --- panel maker: axes end at 0.5, exactly 10 bins per axis (0.05 width)
        make_biheat <- function(df, ct, high_color) {
          panel_df <- df %>%
            dplyr::filter(cell_type == ct,
                          oxidative_stress_signature <= 0.4,
                          TNFA_NFKB_signature        <= 0.4)
          
          ggplot2::ggplot(panel_df,
                          ggplot2::aes(x = oxidative_stress_signature,
                                       y = TNFA_NFKB_signature)) +
            ggplot2::geom_bin2d(
              binwidth = c(0.05, 0.05),  # 10 bins per axis over [0, 0.5]
              ggplot2::aes(fill = ggplot2::after_stat(100 * count / sum(count)))
            ) +
            ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
              low = "grey92", high = high_color,
              trans = "sqrt",
              name = "% of cells",
              labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
            ) +
            ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1)) +
            ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1)) +
            ggplot2::coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
            ggplot2::labs(title = ct,
                          x = "Oxidative stress (UCell)",
                          y = "TNFα–NFκB (UCell)") +
            ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
            ggplot2::theme(
              panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
              plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
              legend.position = "right",
              legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
              legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10)
            )
        }
        
        plots <- lapply(levels(plot_df$cell_type), function(ct) {
          make_biheat(plot_df, ct, high_cols[[ct]])
        })
        
        # keep a legend per plot, arrange in one row
        final_plot <- patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, nrow = 1) +
          patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "keep")
        
        final_plot

          filename = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/tryp.jpg",
          plot     = final_plot,
          width    = 17,
          height   = 12,
          units    = "in",
          dpi      = 200
        )
        
        
      }

      
      {
        

        
        # choose quantiles
        q_os_high <- 0.75   # top quartile = "high oxidative stress"
        q_nf_low  <- 0.1   # bottom decile = "low / near-zero NF-κB"
        
        quadrant_summary <- function(df, os_col = "oxidative_stress_signature",
                                     nf_col = "TNFA_NFKB_signature") {
          df %>%
            group_by(cell_type) %>%
            mutate(
              os_hi  = !!sym(os_col) >= quantile(!!sym(os_col), q_os_high, na.rm = TRUE),
              nf_lo  = !!sym(nf_col) <= quantile(!!sym(nf_col), q_nf_low,  na.rm = TRUE)
            ) %>%
            summarise(
              n = n(),
              n_hi_lo = sum(os_hi & nf_lo, na.rm = TRUE),
              prop_hi_lo = n_hi_lo / n,
              # 95% CI for the proportion
              ci_low  = prop.test(n_hi_lo, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[1],
              ci_high = prop.test(n_hi_lo, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[2],
              # risk ratio comparing high-OS vs low-OS
              p_low_nf_given_high = mean(nf_lo[os_hi], na.rm = TRUE),
              p_low_nf_given_low  = mean(nf_lo[!os_hi], na.rm = TRUE),
              RR = (p_low_nf_given_high) / (p_low_nf_given_low),
              RR_p = fisher.test(table(os_hi, nf_lo))$p.value,
              .groups = "drop"
            )
        }
        
        quad_tbl <- quadrant_summary(scores_df)
        quad_tbl
        
        p <- ggplot(quad_tbl, aes(cell_type, prop_hi_lo)) +
          geom_col() +
          geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0) +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
          labs(y = "High OS & Low NF-κB (percent of cells)", x = NULL) +
          theme_bw(base_size = 14)
        
        ggsave(
          filename =       "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/tryp.jpg",
          plot     =  p,
          width    = 17,
          height   = 12,
          units    = "in",
          dpi      = 200
        )
        
        df_q <- scores_df %>%
          group_by(cell_type) %>%
          mutate(os_q = ntile(oxidative_stress_signature, 4)) %>%
          filter(os_q %in% c(1,4)) %>%
          mutate(os_group = ifelse(os_q == 4, "High OS (Q4)", "Low OS (Q1)"))
        
        p <- ggplot(df_q, aes(os_group, TNFA_NFKB_signature)) +
          geom_violin(draw_quantiles = c(0.1, 0.5)) +
          facet_wrap(~cell_type, nrow = 1) +
          labs(x = NULL, y = "TNFα–NFκB (UCell)") +
          theme_bw(base_size = 14)
        

        ggsave(
          filename =       "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/tryp.jpg",
          plot     =  p,
          width    = 17,
          height   = 12,
          units    = "in",
          dpi      = 200
        )
        
 
        
      }
      
    }
    
  }
}
```

```{r, "get_meta_table_signature_scores_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways UCELL", eval=FALSE}
get_meta_table_signature_scores_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    vec_path_ids,
    w_neg = 1,
    pct.threshold = 0,
    max_rank = 1500,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE
) {
  # 0) sanity checks
  if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || length(meta_table_list) == 0)
    stop("`meta_table_list` must be a non-empty list of meta tables.")
  needed <- c("meta_table_nk", "meta_table_monocytes", "meta_table_b_cells",
              "meta_table_cd4_t_cells", "meta_table_cd8_t_cells")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(meta_table_list)))
    stop("`meta_table_list` must contain: ",
         paste(needed, collapse = ", "))
  if (!is.character(vec_path_ids) || !length(vec_path_ids))
    stop("`vec_path_ids` must be a non-empty character vector of pathway IDs.")
  
  # 1) list-name -> display-name mapping & desired column order
  cell_name_map <- c(
    meta_table_nk          = "NKs",
    meta_table_monocytes   = "Monocytes",
    meta_table_b_cells     = "B Cells",
    meta_table_cd4_t_cells = "CD4+ T Cells",
    meta_table_cd8_t_cells = "CD8+ T Cells"
  )
  desired_cols <- unname(cell_name_map)
  
  # 2) helper: resolve a pretty pathway name from ID
  get_pathway_name_by_id <- function(path_id, species = "hsa") {
    # KEGG: e.g., hsa04668
    if (grepl(sprintf("^%s\\d{5}$", species), path_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("KEGGREST", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("KEGGREST", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      kg <- tryCatch(KEGGREST::keggGet(path_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
      nm <- if (!is.null(kg) && !is.null(kg$NAME)) kg$NAME else path_id
      return(as.character(nm))
    }
    # Reactome: e.g., R-HSA-168256
    if (grepl("^R-HSA-\\d+$", path_id)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("reactome.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("reactome.db", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      nm <- tryCatch(reactome.db::reactomePATHID2NAME[[path_id]], error = function(e) NULL)
      return(if (is.null(nm)) path_id else as.character(nm))
    }
    # MSigDB gs_name (any category). Pretty-print if possible.
    nm <- toupper(path_id)
    # Replace underscores with spaces and Title Case for readability
    nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm, fixed = TRUE)
    nm <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(nm))
    nm
  }
  # 3) prepare result container: rows = pathways, cols = cell types + num_genes
  path_names <- vapply(vec_path_ids, get_pathway_name_by_id, character(1))
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vec_path_ids), ncol = length(desired_cols),
                dimnames = list(path_names, desired_cols))
  num_genes_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, length(vec_path_ids))   # <── new
  
  # 4) loop over pathways
  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {
    pid <- vec_path_ids[i]
    
    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    num_genes_vec[i] <- length(positive_genes)   # <── new
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_signature_score(
          meta_table     = mt,
          positive_genes = positive_genes,
          negative_genes = NULL,
          pct.threshold  = pct.threshold,
          w_neg          = w_neg,
          max_rank       = max_rank,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      res[i, display] <- score
    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with num_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$num_genes <- num_genes_vec
  df
}

  # 3) prepare result container: rows = pathways, cols = cell types + num_genes
  path_names <- vapply(vec_path_ids, get_pathway_name_by_id, character(1))
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vec_path_ids), ncol = length(desired_cols),
                dimnames = list(path_names, desired_cols))
  num_genes_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, length(vec_path_ids))   # <── new
  
  # 4) loop over pathways
  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {
    pid <- vec_path_ids[i]
    
    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    num_genes_vec[i] <- length(positive_genes)   # <── new
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_signature_score(
          meta_table     = mt,
          positive_genes = positive_genes,
          negative_genes = NULL,
          pct.threshold  = pct.threshold,
          w_neg          = w_neg,
          max_rank       = max_rank,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      res[i, display] <- score
    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with num_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$num_genes <- num_genes_vec
  df
}
```

```{r, "score with scmetabolisim functions", eval=FALSE}



get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample <- function(
    seu,
    filter_nocoding   = TRUE,
    assay             = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector       = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector   = NULL
) {
  ## ──────────────────────── sanity checks ────────────────────────────────
  if (!"final_cell_type" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))
    stop("Column `final_cell_type` not found in `seu@meta.data`.")
  
  if (is.null(KEGG_vector) && is.null(REACTOME_vector))
    stop("Nothing to compute: both `KEGG_vector` and `REACTOME_vector` are NULL.")
  
  if (!is.null(KEGG_vector)) {
    if (!is.character(KEGG_vector))
      stop("`KEGG_vector` must be a character vector.")
    if (anyDuplicated(KEGG_vector))
      stop("`KEGG_vector` contains duplicated pathway names.")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(REACTOME_vector)) {
    if (!is.character(REACTOME_vector))
      stop("`REACTOME_vector` must be a character vector.")
    if (anyDuplicated(REACTOME_vector))
      stop("`REACTOME_vector` contains duplicated pathway names.")
  }
  
  if (!requireNamespace("scMetabolism", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package ‘scMetabolism’ (provides sc.metabolism.Seurat) is not installed.")
  
  .barcode_canon <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x, fixed = TRUE)      # dots → dashes
    sub("^[^_]+_", "", x)                      # kill prefix up to first "_"
  }
  
  ## ── 1. grab the SCT ‘corrected counts’ matrix ───────────────────────────
  sct_counts <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, layer = "counts")
  
  ## ── 1a. OPTIONAL: keep only protein-coding genes ────────────────────────
  if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
    coding_syms <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
      mart  <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
      annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
        filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
        values     = rownames(sct_counts),
        mart       = mart
      )
      unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Protein-coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ",
              conditionMessage(e), ").")
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(coding_syms)) {
      keep <- intersect(rownames(sct_counts), coding_syms)
      sct_counts <- sct_counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  
  ## ── 2. create a legacy RNA assay & set as default ───────────────────────
  seu[["RNA"]]  <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sct_counts)
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"
  
  ## ── shared objects for later ────────────────────────────────────────────
  cell_type_vec <- setNames(
    as.character(seu@meta.data$final_cell_type),
    rownames(seu@meta.data)
  )
  cell_types <- sort(setdiff(unique(cell_type_vec), "Other"))  # desired columns
  names(cell_type_vec) <- gsub("-", ".", names(cell_type_vec))
  
  
  ## helper: median per cell-type for a vector of pathways ──────────────────
  median_one_set <- function(seu_obj, pathways) {
    
    mat         <- seu_obj@assays$METABOLISM$score
    cell_names  <- colnames(mat)
    
    lapply(pathways, function(pw) {
      # browser()
      idx <- grep(paste0("^", pw, "$"), rownames(mat), ignore.case = TRUE)
      
      vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(cell_types)), cell_types)  # default NA
      if (length(idx) == 1) {
        auc <- as.numeric(mat[idx, ])
        names(auc) <- sub("^([^.]+)\\.(.*)\\.(\\d+)$", "\\1-\\2-\\3", cell_names)
        
        names(cell_type_vec) <- {
          fixed <- names(cell_type_vec)
          
          ## 1. unify delimiter ----------------------------------------------------
          ref_delim <- sub(".*([.-])[0-9]+$", "\\1", names(auc)[1])
          tgt_delim <- sub(".*([.-])[0-9]+$", "\\1", fixed[1])
          if (ref_delim != tgt_delim)
            fixed <- gsub(tgt_delim, ref_delim, fixed, fixed = TRUE)
          
          ## 2. (optionally) fix leading “X” ---------------------------------------
          ref_has_X <- startsWith(names(auc)[1], "X")
          
          if (ref_has_X && any(!startsWith(fixed, "X"))) {
            fixed[!startsWith(fixed, "X")] <- paste0("X", fixed[!startsWith(fixed, "X")])
          } else if (!ref_has_X && any(startsWith(fixed, "X"))) {
            fixed[startsWith(fixed, "X")]  <- sub("^X", "", fixed[startsWith(fixed, "X")])
          }
          
          fixed
        }
        
        common <- intersect(names(auc), names(cell_type_vec))
        if (length(common) > 0) {
          med <- tapply(auc[common], cell_type_vec[common], median, na.rm = TRUE)
          vec[names(med)] <- med
        }
      }
      return(vec)
    }) |>
      setNames(pathways)
  }
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  ## ── 3. KEGG block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(KEGG_vector) && length(KEGG_vector) > 0) {
    seu <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(
      obj             = seu,
      method          = "AUCell",
      imputation      = FALSE,
      ncores          = 4,
      metabolism.type = "KEGG"
    )
    results_list <- c(results_list,
                      median_one_set(seu, KEGG_vector))
  }
  
  ## ── 4. REACTOME block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(REACTOME_vector) && length(REACTOME_vector) > 0) {
    seu@assays$METABOLISM$score <- NULL  # drop prior KEGG scores
    seu <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(
      obj             = seu,
      method          = "AUCell",
      imputation      = FALSE,
      ncores          = 4,
      metabolism.type = "REACTOME"
    )
    results_list <- c(results_list,
                      median_one_set(seu, REACTOME_vector))
  }
  
  ## ── 5. bind into tidy data-frame ────────────────────────────────────────
  path_mat <- do.call(rbind, results_list)               # rbind aligns by names
  med_df   <- as.data.frame(path_mat)
  med_df$pathway <- rownames(med_df)
  med_df <- med_df[, c("pathway", cell_types)]            # order columns
  rownames(med_df) <- NULL
  
  return(med_df)
}



get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset <- function(
    seu_obj,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE,
    assay           = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector     = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector = NULL
) {
  ## 0. check if the object contains > 1 sample -----------------------------
  multi_sample <- length(unique(seu_obj$sample)) > 1
  
  ## 1. outer list keyed by orig.ident (“Hong”, “Kang”, …) ------------------
  orig_ids <- unique(seu_obj$orig.ident)
  res_out  <- setNames(vector("list", length(orig_ids)), orig_ids)
  
  for (oid in orig_ids) {
    seu_oid   <- subset(seu_obj, subset = orig.ident == oid)
    samp_ids  <- sort(unique(seu_oid$sample))          # HC-1 … HC-n
    
    ## 2. inner list keyed by sample ----------------------------------------
    samp_list <- lapply(samp_ids, function(samp) {
      seu_samp <- subset(seu_oid, subset = sample == samp)
      
      ## optional: rebuild a “clean” Seurat object per sample ---------------
      if (multi_sample) {
        seu_samp <- get_full_seurat(
          seu               = seu_samp,
          compute_cell_cycle = FALSE      # skip CellCycleScoring
        )
      }
      
      get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample(
        seu             = seu_samp,
        filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
        assay           = assay,
        KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
        REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
      )
    })
    names(samp_list) <- samp_ids
    res_out[[oid]]   <- samp_list
  }
  
  return(res_out)
}





get_scMetab_log2fc_barplot <- function(
    controls_medians = NULL,
    seu_patient,
    healthy_list,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE,
    assay           = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector     = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector = NULL,
    title              = "Ox-stress pathways (patient vs. controls)",
    my_pathway_cols    = c("Glutathione metabolism" = "#fb8500",
                           "Oxidative phosphorylation" = "#219ebc"),
    title_size        = 12,
    y_title_size      = 12,
    y_text_size       = 12,
    mat_row_text_size = 12,
    legend_title_size = 12,
    legend_text_size  = 12,
    base_size         = 12) {
  ## ── 0 · sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(controls_medians)) {
    if (!is.list(healthy_list) || length(healthy_list) == 0)
      stop("`healthy_list` must be a non-empty *list* of Seurat objects.")
    
    if (is.null(names(healthy_list)) || any(names(healthy_list) == ""))
      stop("`healthy_list` must be a *named* list (e.g. names like 'seu_cd55').")
    
    if (anyDuplicated(names(healthy_list)))
      stop("`healthy_list` contains duplicated names: ",
           paste(unique(names(healthy_list)[duplicated(names(healthy_list))]),
                 collapse = ", "))
    
    not_seurat <- !vapply(healthy_list, inherits, logical(1), what = "Seurat")
    if (any(not_seurat))
      stop("All elements of `healthy_list` must be Seurat objects. ",
           "Problems at positions: ", paste(which(not_seurat), collapse = ", "))
    
  } else {
    if (!is.list(controls_medians) || length(controls_medians) == 0)
      stop("`controls_medians` must be a non-empty list produced by ",
           "`get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset()`.")
    if (is.null(names(controls_medians)) || any(names(controls_medians) == ""))
      stop("`controls_medians` must be a *named* list.")
    
    bad <- vapply(controls_medians, function(donor_list) {
      # each donor_list should be a non-empty list of data.frames with a "pathway" column
      if (!is.list(donor_list) || length(donor_list) == 0) return(TRUE)
      !all(vapply(donor_list, function(df) {
        is.data.frame(df) && "pathway" %in% colnames(df)
      }, logical(1)))
    }, logical(1))
    
    if (any(bad)) {
      stop("`controls_medians` has unexpected structure at positions: ",
           paste(which(bad), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
  
  
  ## ── 1 · patient medians ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  patient_medians <- get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample(
    seu             = seu_patient,
    filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
    assay           = assay,
    KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
    REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
  )
  
  ## ── 2 · controls (compute only if not supplied) ──────────────────────────
  if (is.null(controls_medians)) {
    controls_medians <- lapply(healthy_list, function(seu_obj) {
      print(seu_obj@meta.data$orig.ident)
      get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset(
        seu_obj         = seu_obj,
        filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
        assay           = assay,
        KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
        REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
      )
    })
    names(controls_medians) <- names(healthy_list)
    
    control_medians <- controls_medians
    
    ## ── 3 · flatten & merge by dataset ───────────────────────────────────────
    {
      dataset_lists  <- lapply(control_medians, function(x) x[[1]])
      dataset_names  <- sapply(control_medians, function(x) names(x)[1])
      merged <- list()
      for (i in seq_along(dataset_lists)) {
        ds <- dataset_names[i]
        if (!ds %in% names(merged)) {
          merged[[ds]] <- dataset_lists[[i]]
        } else {
          merged[[ds]] <- c(merged[[ds]], dataset_lists[[i]])
        }
      }
      control_medians <- merged
    }
    
    
  } else{
    control_medians <- controls_medians
    
  }
  
  
  
  ## ── 4 · calculate controls medians ───────────────────────────────────────
  {
    sample_list <- do.call(c, control_medians)
    pathways    <- sample_list[[1]]$pathway
    cell_types  <- setdiff(names(sample_list[[1]]), "pathway")
    
    control_medians_df <- data.frame(pathway = pathways, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      mat <- sapply(sample_list, `[[`, ct)
      control_medians_df[[paste0(ct, "_median")]] <- apply(mat, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
      control_medians_df[[paste0(ct, "_nNA")]]    <- apply(mat, 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
    }
  }
  
  ## ── 5 · calculate log2FC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    clean_pathway <- function(x) {
      x <- trimws(x)
      x <- gsub("([A-Za-z0-9])\\.([A-Za-z0-9])", "\\1 \\2", x)  # word.word -> word word
      x
    }
    patient_medians$pathway    <- clean_pathway(patient_medians$pathway)
    control_medians_df$pathway <- clean_pathway(control_medians_df$pathway)
    
    fc_df <- merge(
      patient_medians,
      control_medians_df,
      by       = "pathway",
      suffixes = c("_patient", "_control")
    )
    
    cell_types <- c("B cells", "CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells", "Monocytes", "NK cells")
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      pat_col  <- ct
      ctrl_col <- paste0(ct, "_median")
      out_col  <- paste0(ct, "_log2FC")
      fc_df[[out_col]] <- log2((fc_df[[pat_col]] + 1e-6) / (fc_df[[ctrl_col]] + 1e-6))
    }
    log2fc_only <- fc_df[, c("pathway", paste0(cell_types, "_log2FC"))]
    
    log2fc_only <- log2fc_only %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = tidyselect::ends_with("_log2FC"),
        names_to  = "cell_type",
        values_to = "log2FC"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        cell_type = sub("_log2FC$", "", cell_type),
        cell_type = gsub("\\.+", " ", cell_type)
      )
  }
  
  ## ── 6 · CIs and q value ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    patient_long <- patient_medians %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "patient_median")
    
    control_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(control_medians, function(dataset_list, dataset) {
      purrr::imap_dfr(dataset_list, function(sample_df, sample_id) {
        sample_df %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -pathway, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "control_median") %>%
          dplyr::mutate(dataset = dataset, sample_id = sample_id)
      })
    })
    
    patient_long$pathway <- clean_pathway(patient_long$pathway)
    control_long$pathway <- clean_pathway(control_long$pathway)
    
    merged <- patient_long %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(control_long, by = c("pathway", "cell_type")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(log2fc_each = log2(patient_median / control_median))
    
    summary_df <- merged %>%
      dplyr::group_by(pathway, cell_type) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        log2FC    = mean(log2fc_each),
        se        = stats::sd(log2fc_each) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
        t95       = stats::qt(0.975, df = dplyr::n() - 1),
        CI_top    = log2FC +  t95 * se,
        CI_bottom = log2FC -  t95 * se,
        p_val     = stats::t.test(log2fc_each, mu = 0)$p.value,
        .groups   = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q_val = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"))
    
    log2fc_only <- log2fc_only %>%
      dplyr::left_join(summary_df %>% 
                         dplyr::select(pathway, cell_type, CI_top, CI_bottom, q_val),
                       by = c("pathway", "cell_type"))
  }
  
  ## ── 7 · barplot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    pdat <- log2fc_only
    
    order_vec <- pdat %>%
      dplyr::filter(pathway == "Glutathione metabolism") %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(log2FC)) %>% 
      dplyr::pull(cell_type)
    
    pdat <- pdat %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = order_vec))
    
    ## FIX 1: keep only pathways we color, then lock factor levels to mapping
    pdat <- pdat %>%
      dplyr::filter(pathway %in% names(my_pathway_cols)) %>%     # <- FIX
      dplyr::mutate(pathway = factor(pathway,                    # <- FIX
                                     levels = names(my_pathway_cols)))
    
    pdodge <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.65)
    
    p_bar <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      pdat,
      ggplot2::aes(x = cell_type, y = log2FC, fill = pathway)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, position = pdodge) +
      ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
        ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI_bottom, ymax = CI_top),
        width = 0.4, position = pdodge, linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        values = my_pathway_cols,
        breaks = names(my_pathway_cols),                                   # <- FIX
        labels = stringr::str_to_title(names(my_pathway_cols)),
        name   = "Pathway"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.5, 1),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0)
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = expression(log[2] * " EF"),
        title = title
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = title_size),
        axis.title.y       = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_title_size),
        axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size),
        axis.text.x        = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = y_text_size),
        axis.ticks.x       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
        legend.text        = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
        panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )
  }
  
  list(
    control_medians = control_medians,
    log2fc_df       = log2fc_only,
    p_bar           = p_bar
  )
}
```

```{r, "old auc functions: with padding", eval=FALSE}

get_meta_table_auc_score <- function(meta_table,
                                     positive_genes,
                                     filter_nocoding = TRUE) {
  ## 0 ·──────── sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.data.frame(meta_table))
    stop("`meta_table` must be a data-frame.")
  
  if (is.null(rownames(meta_table))) {
    if (!"gene" %in% colnames(meta_table))
      stop("`meta_table` must have gene symbols as row names or a 'gene' column.")
    rownames(meta_table) <- as.character(meta_table$gene)
  }
  
  if (!"median_log2FC" %in% colnames(meta_table))
    stop("`meta_table` is missing required column: 'median_log2FC'.")
  
  if (missing(positive_genes) || length(positive_genes) == 0)
    stop("`positive_genes` must be a non-empty character vector.")
  
  ## 1 ·──────── optional: filter to protein-coding genes ─────────────────────
  if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
    coding_syms <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
      mart  <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
      annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
        filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
        values     = unique(rownames(meta_table)),
        mart       = mart
      )
      unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Protein-coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ",
              conditionMessage(e), ").")
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(coding_syms))
      meta_table <- meta_table[rownames(meta_table) %in% coding_syms, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  ## 2 ·──────── assemble the gene universe and pad missing ───────────────────
  positive_genes <- unique(positive_genes)
  universe <- unique(c(rownames(meta_table), positive_genes))
  
  missing_genes <- setdiff(universe, rownames(meta_table))
  if (length(missing_genes)) {
    pad <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = length(missing_genes), ncol = ncol(meta_table)))
    colnames(pad) <- colnames(meta_table)
    rownames(pad) <- missing_genes
    if ("gene" %in% colnames(pad)) pad$gene <- missing_genes
    # ensure missing positives get the worst possible score
    if ("median_log2FC" %in% colnames(pad)) pad$median_log2FC <- -Inf
    meta_table <- rbind(meta_table, pad)
  }
  
  ## 3 ·──────── prepare the score vector (median_log2FC) ─────────────────────
  logfc_vec <- meta_table$median_log2FC
  names(logfc_vec) <- rownames(meta_table)
  
  # drop NAs in the scoring metric
  logfc_vec <- logfc_vec[!is.na(logfc_vec)]
  
  pos <- intersect(positive_genes, names(logfc_vec))
  if (!length(pos)) {
    warning("None of the `positive_genes` are present after filtering; returning NA.")
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  neg <- setdiff(names(logfc_vec), pos)
  if (!length(neg)) {
    warning("Background set is empty; returning NA.")
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  ## 4 ·──────── compute AUC via Mann–Whitney/Wilcoxon equivalence ────────────
  # rank() gives ascending ranks; higher logFC -> larger rank → larger AUC
  r <- rank(logfc_vec, ties.method = "average")
  L <- length(pos)
  N <- length(logfc_vec)
  sum_r_pos <- sum(r[pos])
  U <- sum_r_pos - L * (L + 1) / 2
  auc <- U / (L * length(neg))
  
  # clamp to [0,1] in case of tiny numerical wobble
  auc <- max(0, min(1, auc))
  return(auc)
}


get_meta_table_auc_score_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    vec_path_ids,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE
) {
  # 0) sanity checks
  if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || length(meta_table_list) == 0)
    stop("`meta_table_list` must be a non-empty list of meta tables.")
  needed <- c("meta_table_nk", "meta_table_monocytes", "meta_table_b_cells",
              "meta_table_cd4_t_cells", "meta_table_cd8_t_cells")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(meta_table_list)))
    stop("`meta_table_list` must contain: ",
         paste(needed, collapse = ", "))
  if (!is.character(vec_path_ids) || !length(vec_path_ids))
    stop("`vec_path_ids` must be a non-empty character vector of pathway IDs.")
  
  # 1) list-name -> display-name mapping & desired column order
  cell_name_map <- c(
    meta_table_nk          = "NKs",
    meta_table_monocytes   = "Monocytes",
    meta_table_b_cells     = "B Cells",
    meta_table_cd4_t_cells = "CD4+ T Cells",
    meta_table_cd8_t_cells = "CD8+ T Cells"
  )
  desired_cols <- unname(cell_name_map)
  
  # 2) helper: resolve a pretty pathway name from ID
  get_pathway_name_by_id <- function(path_id, species = "hsa") {
    # KEGG: e.g., hsa04668
    if (grepl(sprintf("^%s\\d{5}$", species), path_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("KEGGREST", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("KEGGREST", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      kg <- tryCatch(KEGGREST::keggGet(path_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
      nm <- if (!is.null(kg) && !is.null(kg$NAME)) kg$NAME else path_id
      return(as.character(nm))
    }
    # Reactome: e.g., R-HSA-168256
    if (grepl("^R-HSA-\\d+$", path_id)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("reactome.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("reactome.db", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      nm <- tryCatch(reactome.db::reactomePATHID2NAME[[path_id]], error = function(e) NULL)
      return(if (is.null(nm)) path_id else as.character(nm))
    }
    # MSigDB gs_name (any category). Pretty-print if possible.
    nm <- toupper(path_id)
    # Replace underscores with spaces and Title Case for readability
    nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm, fixed = TRUE)
    nm <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(nm))
    nm
  }
  # 3) prepare result container: rows = pathways, cols = cell types + num_genes
  path_names <- vapply(vec_path_ids, get_pathway_name_by_id, character(1))
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vec_path_ids), ncol = length(desired_cols),
                dimnames = list(path_names, desired_cols))
  num_genes_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, length(vec_path_ids))   # <── new
  
  # 4) loop over pathways
  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {
    pid <- vec_path_ids[i]
    
    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    num_genes_vec[i] <- length(positive_genes)   # <── new
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_auc_score(
          meta_table     = mt,
          positive_genes = positive_genes,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      res[i, display] <- score
    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with num_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$num_genes <- num_genes_vec
  df
}
```

```{r, "relations between shared PDE genes in CD59 pateint - stringDB ", eval=FALSE}
#trying to make sense of the PDE genes, shared between 4 or more cell types
{
  
  #getting meta_table_list
  {
    
    NK_meta_table <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/meta_tables/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_meta_table.qs")
    monocytes_meta_table <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/meta_tables/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_meta_table.qs")
    B_cells_meta_table <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/meta_tables/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_meta_table.qs")
    CD4_T_cells_meta_table <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/meta_tables/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_meta_table.qs")
    CD8_T_cells_meta_table <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/meta_tables/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_meta_table.qs")
    
    
    meta_table_list <- list(NK_meta_table = NK_meta_table,
                            monocytes_meta_table = monocytes_meta_table,
                            B_cells_meta_table = B_cells_meta_table,
                            CD4_T_cells_meta_table = CD4_T_cells_meta_table,
                            CD8_T_cells_meta_table = CD8_T_cells_meta_table)
    
    
    rm(NK_meta_table, monocytes_meta_table, B_cells_meta_table, CD4_T_cells_meta_table, CD8_T_cells_meta_table)
    
  }

  
  #getting these shared, protein coding PDE genes
  {
    get_ora_4_cell_types <- function(meta_table_list,
                                     log2FC_threshold_for_gene = 1,
                                     positive = TRUE,
                                     q_value_threshold_for_gene = 0.05,
                                     cols = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                     BPPARAM = BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 6),
                                     q_value_threshold_for_pathway = 0.05) {
      ## helper: protein-coding HGNC symbols via biomaRt (same pattern as your snippet)
      lookup_protein_coding_syms <- function(symbols) {
        tryCatch({
          if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
            stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
          mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
          annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
            attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
            filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
            values     = unique(symbols),
            mart       = mart
          )
          annot %>%
            dplyr::filter(.data$gene_biotype == "protein_coding") %>%
            dplyr::pull(.data$hgnc_symbol) %>%
            unique()
        }, error = function(e) {
          warning("Protein-coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ", conditionMessage(e), ")")
          NULL
        })
      }
      
      ## ── sanity checks (unchanged) ─────────────────────────────────────────────
      {
        expected_names <- c("NK_meta_table",
                            "monocytes_meta_table",
                            "B_cells_meta_table",
                            "CD4_T_cells_meta_table",
                            "CD8_T_cells_meta_table")
        if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || is.null(names(meta_table_list))) {
          stop("meta_table_list must be a *named* list holding the five cell-type meta tables.", call. = FALSE)
        }
        missing <- setdiff(expected_names, names(meta_table_list))
        extra   <- setdiff(names(meta_table_list), expected_names)
        if (length(missing) || length(extra)) {
          stop(paste0(
            "meta_table_list must contain exactly:\n",
            paste0(" • ", expected_names, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n",
            if (length(missing)) paste0("Missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "), "\n") else "",
            if (length(extra))   paste0("Extra:   ", paste(extra,   collapse = ", "), "\n") else ""
          ), call. = FALSE)
        }
        if (!identical(names(meta_table_list), expected_names)) {
          stop("Elements present but not in required order: ",
               paste(expected_names, collapse = ", "),
               call. = FALSE)
        }
      }
      
      ## ── 1 · parallel filter per meta table ────────────────────────────────────
      meta_table_list_filtered <- BiocParallel::bplapply(
        meta_table_list,
        function(df) {
          if (positive) {
            dplyr::filter(df,
                          median_log2FC  >  log2FC_threshold_for_gene,
                          q_val_fisher   <= q_value_threshold_for_gene)
          } else {
            dplyr::filter(df,
                          median_log2FC  < -log2FC_threshold_for_gene,
                          q_val_fisher   <= q_value_threshold_for_gene)
          }
        },
        BPPARAM = BPPARAM
      )
      
      ## ── 2 · presence matrix ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
      gene_upset_df <- build_presence_df(meta_table_list_filtered, id_col = "gene")
      
      ## foreground (≥4 of the selected cols) ------------------------------------
      {
        if (missing(cols) || !length(cols))
          stop("cols must be a non-empty character vector.", call. = FALSE)
        not_found <- setdiff(cols, names(gene_upset_df))
        if (length(not_found))
          stop("Missing columns in gene_upset_df: ", paste(not_found, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
        
        k <- min(4L, length(cols))  # in case user passes fewer than 4 columns
        gene_ORA_df <- dplyr::filter(
          gene_upset_df,
          rowSums(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cols), ~ as.integer(.x))) >= k
        )
        rownames(gene_ORA_df) <- gene_ORA_df$gene
        ora_vec_meta_sym <- unique(gene_ORA_df$gene)
        
        ## ── keep only protein-coding in FOREGROUND (via biomaRt) ───────────────
        pc_syms_fg <- lookup_protein_coding_syms(ora_vec_meta_sym)
        if (!is.null(pc_syms_fg)) {
          ora_vec_meta_sym <- sort(intersect(ora_vec_meta_sym, pc_syms_fg))
        }
        
        ## map to Entrez AFTER protein-coding filter
        ora_vec_meta_ent <- {
          if (length(ora_vec_meta_sym) == 0) character(0) else {
            tmp <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
              org.Hs.eg.db,
              keys      = ora_vec_meta_sym,
              keytype   = "SYMBOL",
              column    = "ENTREZID",
              multiVals = "first"
            )
            unique(unname(stats::na.omit(tmp)))
          }
        }
      }
      
      ## universe (with protein-coding filter) -----------------------------------
      {
        genes_in_celltype <- function(meta_tbl) {
          meta_tbl %>%
            dplyr::filter(comparisons_num > 0) %>%
            dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
            unique()
        }
        gene_sets <- purrr::map(meta_table_list, genes_in_celltype)
        universe_genes_sym <- sort(purrr::reduce(gene_sets, intersect))
        
        ## ── keep only protein-coding in UNIVERSE (via biomaRt) ─────────────────
        pc_syms_univ <- lookup_protein_coding_syms(universe_genes_sym)
        if (!is.null(pc_syms_univ)) {
          universe_genes_sym <- sort(intersect(universe_genes_sym, pc_syms_univ))
        }
        
        universe_genes_entrez <- {
          if (length(universe_genes_sym) == 0) character(0) else {
            AnnotationDbi::mapIds(
              org.Hs.eg.db,
              keys      = universe_genes_sym,
              column    = "ENTREZID",
              keytype   = "SYMBOL",
              multiVals = "first"
            ) |>
              stats::na.omit() |>
              unname() |>
              unique() |>
              sort()
          }
        }
      }
      
      ## If foreground is empty after protein-coding filter, return early --------
      if (length(ora_vec_meta_sym) == 0 || length(ora_vec_meta_ent) == 0) {
        return(list(
          foreground_genes = list(
            symbols = ora_vec_meta_sym,
            entrez  = ora_vec_meta_ent
          ),
          enrichments = list(
            meta_reactome  = NULL,
            meta_kegg      = NULL,
            meta_h         = NULL,
            meta_gobp      = NULL,
            meta_gocc      = NULL,
            meta_biocarta  = NULL
          )
        ))
      }
      
      ## ── 3 · Run enrichments in parallel (unchanged) ───────────────────────────
      enrichment_tasks <- list(
        reactome = list(
          fun = function() {
            x <- ReactomePA::enrichPathway(gene = ora_vec_meta_ent,
                                           organism = "human",
                                           universe = universe_genes_entrez)
            x@result <- dplyr::filter(x@result, p.adjust <= q_value_threshold_for_pathway)
            x
          }
        ),
        kegg = list(
          fun = function() {
            x <- clusterProfiler::enrichKEGG(
              gene     = ora_vec_meta_ent,
              organism = "hsa",
              universe = universe_genes_entrez
            )
            if (is.null(x) || nrow(x@result) == 0) return(x)
            x@result <- dplyr::filter(x@result, p.adjust <= q_value_threshold_for_pathway)
            x
          }
        ),
        hallmark = list(
          fun = function() {
            hallmark_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
              species  = "Homo sapiens",
              category = "H"
            ) %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol)
            x <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = ora_vec_meta_sym,
                                           TERM2GENE = hallmark_df,
                                           universe  = universe_genes_sym)
            x@result <- dplyr::filter(x@result, p.adjust <= q_value_threshold_for_pathway)
            x
          }
        ),
        gobp = list(
          fun = function() {
            x <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
              gene    = ora_vec_meta_ent,
              OrgDb   = org.Hs.eg.db,
              ont     = "BP",
              keyType = "ENTREZID"
            )
            x@result <- dplyr::filter(x@result, p.adjust <= q_value_threshold_for_pathway)
            x
          }
        ),
        gocc = list(
          fun = function() {
            x <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
              gene    = ora_vec_meta_ent,
              OrgDb   = org.Hs.eg.db,
              ont     = "CC",
              keyType = "ENTREZID"
            )
            x@result <- dplyr::filter(x@result, p.adjust <= q_value_threshold_for_pathway)
            x
          }
        ),
        biocarta = list(
          fun = function() {
            biocarta_df <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
              species     = "Homo sapiens",
              category    = "C2",
              subcategory = "CP:BIOCARTA"
            ) %>% dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene)
            x <- clusterProfiler::enricher(gene = ora_vec_meta_ent,
                                           TERM2GENE = biocarta_df,
                                           universe  = universe_genes_entrez)
            x@result <- dplyr::filter(x@result, p.adjust <= q_value_threshold_for_pathway)
            x
          }
        )
      )
      
      safe_run <- function(f) {
        res <- f()
        if (is.null(res)) return(res)
        if (!methods::is(res, "enrichResult") && !methods::is(res, "gseaResult")) return(res)
        if (!"p.adjust" %in% names(res@result)) return(res)
        res
      }
      
      enrichment_results <- BiocParallel::bplapply(
        enrichment_tasks,
        function(task) safe_run(task$fun),
        BPPARAM = BPPARAM
      )
      
      meta_reactome <- enrichment_results$reactome
      meta_kegg     <- enrichment_results$kegg
      meta_h        <- enrichment_results$hallmark
      meta_gobp     <- enrichment_results$gobp
      meta_gocc     <- enrichment_results$gocc
      meta_biocarta <- enrichment_results$biocarta
      
      ## ── 4 · return: foreground + enrichments ──────────────────────────────────
      return(list(
        foreground_genes = list(
          symbols = ora_vec_meta_sym,
          entrez  = ora_vec_meta_ent
        ),
        enrichments = list(
          meta_reactome  = meta_reactome,
          meta_kegg      = meta_kegg,
          meta_h         = meta_h,
          meta_gobp      = meta_gobp,
          meta_gocc      = meta_gocc,
          meta_biocarta  = meta_biocarta
        )
      ))
    }
    
    

    cols <- c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells")
    
    
    positive_ora <- get_ora_4_cell_types (meta_table_list, log2FC_threshold_for_gene = 1.25,
                                          positive = TRUE ,q_value_threshold_for_gene = 0.05,
                                          cols = cols, q_value_threshold_for_pathway = 0.1)
    
    
    
  }
  
  
  #string db
  {
    

    library(STRINGdb)
    library(dplyr)
    library(igraph)
    library(visNetwork)   # for an interactive network
    
    your_254_gene_symbols <- positive_ora$foreground_genes$symbols
    
    # 1) Your genes (HGNC symbols)
    genes <- unique(your_254_gene_symbols)  # character vector
    
    # 2) Init STRING (H. sapiens = 9606). Use a stricter score if you want high-confidence edges.
    string_db <- STRINGdb$new(species = 9606, score_threshold = 700)  # 400=med, 700=high
    
    # 3) Map symbols → STRING IDs (remove unmapped)
    map_df <- string_db$map(data.frame(gene = genes), "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)
    
    # 4) Edges within your set (subnetwork among your proteins only)
    edges_raw <- string_db$get_subnetwork(map_df$STRING_id)
    # NOTE: depending on STRINGdb version, columns might be named "from"/"to" or "protein1"/"protein2".
    # The following handles the common "from"/"to" case; if you see "protein1/protein2", just rename accordingly.
    id2sym <- map_df %>% dplyr::select(STRING_id, gene)
    # edges <- edges_raw %>%
    #   inner_join(id2sym, by = c("to" = "STRING_id")) %>% rename(from_gene = gene) %>%
    #   inner_join(id2sym, by = c("to"   = "STRING_id")) %>% rename(to_gene   = gene) %>%
    #   dplyr::select(from_gene, to_gene, combined_score) %>%
    #   distinct()
    
    # First, extract edges from the igraph object as a data frame
    edges <- as_data_frame(edges_raw, what = "edges") %>%
      inner_join(id2sym, by = c("from" = "STRING_id")) %>% 
      rename(from_gene = gene) %>%
      inner_join(id2sym, by = c("to" = "STRING_id")) %>% 
      rename(to_gene = gene) %>%
      dplyr::select(from_gene, to_gene, combined_score) %>%
      distinct()
    
    
    # 5) Optional: PPI enrichment test (are these genes more connected than random?)
    ppi_enrich <- string_db$get_ppi_enrichment(map_df$STRING_id)
    ppi_enrich$enrichment  
    
    # 6) Build a graph for analytics/clustering
    g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE, vertices = data.frame(name = map_df$gene))
    # Example: connected components and a simple “modules” list
    comp <- components(g)
    modules <- split(names(comp$membership), comp$membership)  # list of gene-sets per component
    
    # 7) Quick interactive network in R
    nodes <- data.frame(id = map_df$gene, label = map_df$gene)
    edges_vn <- edges %>% transmute(from = from_gene, to = to_gene, value = combined_score)
    visNetwork(nodes, edges_vn) %>%
      visOptions(highlightNearest = TRUE, nodesIdSelection = TRUE) %>%
      visPhysics(stabilization = TRUE)
    
    # 8) If you just want a STRING-style PNG without coding a plot:
    string_db$plot_network(map_df$STRING_id)  # opens an image of the network
    
  }
  
  # ASK1→MKK3/6→p38
  
  
  #possible pathways
  {
MED11
```

```{r, "old auc functions: requires all 5 cell types to work", eval=FALSE}
get_meta_table_auc_score_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    vec_path_ids,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE
) {
  # 0) sanity checks
  if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || length(meta_table_list) == 0)
    stop("`meta_table_list` must be a non-empty list of meta tables.")
  needed <- c("meta_table_nk", "meta_table_monocytes", "meta_table_b_cells",
              "meta_table_cd4_t_cells", "meta_table_cd8_t_cells")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(meta_table_list)))
    stop("`meta_table_list` must contain: ",
         paste(needed, collapse = ", "))
  if (!is.character(vec_path_ids) || !length(vec_path_ids))
    stop("`vec_path_ids` must be a non-empty character vector of pathway IDs.")
  
  # 1) list-name -> display-name mapping & desired column order
  cell_name_map <- c(
    meta_table_nk          = "NKs",
    meta_table_monocytes   = "Monocytes",
    meta_table_b_cells     = "B Cells",
    meta_table_cd4_t_cells = "CD4+ T Cells",
    meta_table_cd8_t_cells = "CD8+ T Cells"
  )
  desired_cols <- unname(cell_name_map)
  
  # 2) helper: resolve a pretty pathway name from ID
  get_pathway_name_by_id <- function(path_id, species = "hsa") {
    if (grepl(sprintf("^%s\\d{5}$", species), path_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("KEGGREST", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("KEGGREST", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      kg <- tryCatch(KEGGREST::keggGet(path_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
      nm <- if (!is.null(kg) && !is.null(kg$NAME)) kg$NAME else path_id
      return(as.character(nm))
    }
    if (grepl("^R-HSA-\\d+$", path_id)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("reactome.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("reactome.db", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      nm <- tryCatch(reactome.db::reactomePATHID2NAME[[path_id]], error = function(e) NULL)
      return(if (is.null(nm)) path_id else as.character(nm))
    }
    nm <- toupper(path_id)
    nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm, fixed = TRUE)
    nm <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(nm))
    nm
  }
  
  # 3) prepare result container: rows = pathways, cols = cell types + found_genes
  path_names <- vapply(vec_path_ids, get_pathway_name_by_id, character(1))
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vec_path_ids), ncol = length(desired_cols),
                dimnames = list(path_names, desired_cols))
  found_str_vec <- rep(NA_character_, length(vec_path_ids))  # <── replaces num_genes
  
  # (optional) precompute protein-coding symbols once across all tables
  coding_syms_all <- NULL
  if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
    coding_syms_all <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
      all_syms <- unique(unlist(lapply(meta_table_list, function(df) {
        rn <- rownames(df)
        if (is.null(rn) && "gene" %in% colnames(df)) rn <- as.character(df$gene)
        rn
      })))
      mart  <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
      annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
        filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
        values     = all_syms,
        mart       = mart
      )
      unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  # helper to get available genes in one meta table (respecting filter_nocoding)
  get_available_genes <- function(df) {
    rn <- rownames(df)
    if (is.null(rn) && "gene" %in% colnames(df)) rn <- as.character(df$gene)
    rn <- unique(rn)
    if (!is.null(coding_syms_all)) rn <- intersect(rn, coding_syms_all)
    rn
  }
  
  # 4) loop over pathways
  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {
    pid <- vec_path_ids[i]
    
    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    # x/y: x = #found across union of available genes in all cell types; y = pathway size
    available_union <- unique(unlist(lapply(meta_table_list, get_available_genes)))
    x_found <- length(intersect(unique(positive_genes), available_union))
    y_all   <- length(unique(positive_genes))
    found_str_vec[i] <- sprintf("%d/%d", x_found, y_all)
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_auc_score(
          meta_table      = mt,
          positive_genes  = positive_genes,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      res[i, display] <- score
    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with found_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$found_genes <- found_str_vec
  df
}
```

```{r, "old heatmap functions", eval=FALSE}
get_list_of_condition_objects <- function(path,
                                          files_to_exclude = NULL,
                                          condition = "MS",
                                          workers   = 4) {
  
  ## ── 0.  Set up a future back‑end ───────────────────────────────────
  old_plan <- future::plan()
  future::plan(multisession, workers = workers)
  on.exit(future::plan(old_plan), add = TRUE)
  
  ## ── 1.  Validate path type ─────────────────────────────────────────
  if (grepl("integrated_objects", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    type <- "integrated"
  } else if (grepl("meta_tables", path, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    type <- "meta"
  } else {
    stop("Path must contain either 'integrated_objects' or 'meta_tables'.")
  }
  
  ## ── 2.  Build the list of files to read ────────────────────────────
  file_names <- list.files(path, full.names = TRUE) |> normalizePath("/")
  if (!is.null(files_to_exclude)) {
    file_names <- setdiff(file_names, files_to_exclude)
  }
  
  ## ---- NEW: skip the prefix filter when condition == 'all' ----------
  if (!identical(tolower(condition), "all")) {
    file_names <- file_names[grepl(paste0("^", condition, "_"), basename(file_names))]
  }
  
  if (!length(file_names)) {
    stop(
      if (identical(tolower(condition), "all")) {
        sprintf("No files found under %s.", path)
      } else {
        sprintf("No '%s_*' files found under %s.", condition, path)
      }
    )
  }
  
  ## ── 3.  File‑specific helpers ──────────────────────────────────────
  strip_suffix <- function(x)
    sub("(_meta_table|_integrated_objects)\\.qs$", "", basename(x))
  
  process_one <- function(f) {
    base_name <- strip_suffix(f)
    parts     <- strsplit(base_name, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    
    cond <- parts[1]
    if (parts[2] == "Ramesh") {
      dataset <- "Ramesh"
      sample  <- paste(parts[-(1:3)], collapse = "_")      # skip the “5/3”
    } else {
      dataset <- parts[2]
      sample  <- paste(parts[-(1:2)], collapse = "_")
    }
    final_name <- paste(cond, dataset, sample, sep = "_")
    
    tbl <- qs::qread(f)
    if (type == "integrated") {
      tbl <- tbl$de_table
      tbl$gene <- rownames(tbl)
    }
    stopifnot(is.data.frame(tbl), "gene" %in% colnames(tbl))
    
    list(name = final_name, table = tbl)
  }
  
  ## ── 4.  Parallel map ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  library(furrr)
  results <- furrr::future_map(
    file_names, process_one,
    .options  = furrr::furrr_options(seed = TRUE),
    .progress = TRUE
  )
  
  ## ── 5.  Assemble & return ──────────────────────────────────────────
  results_list <- setNames(
    lapply(results, `[[`, "table"),
    vapply(results, `[[`, "", "name")
  )
  
  list(results_list = results_list, type = type)
}



get_correlation_matrix_for_metric_heatmap <- function(list_of_condition_objects, comparison_type) {
  
  # Description:
  #   Retrieves a list of per‐sample tables (meta or integrated) for a given condition,
  #   computes pairwise Spearman correlations of gene ranks, and assembles an n×n matrix.
  # Arguments:
  #   path             – character; directory of meta_tables or integrated_objects.
  #   files_to_exclude – optional vector; full paths to skip.
  #   condition        – character; sample prefix (e.g. “MS”) to include.
  # Returns:
  #   data.frame correlation matrix (samples × samples) with Spearman coefficients.
  
  valid_types <- c(
    "spearman", "pearson",
    "jaccard_20", "jaccard_50", "jaccard_100"
  )
  
  if (! comparison_type %in% valid_types) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "`comparison_type` must be one of: %s\n  You supplied: '%s'",
        paste(valid_types, collapse = ", "),
        comparison_type
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # 2) Extract the sample list
  results_list <- list_of_condition_objects$results_list
  samples <- names(results_list)
  n <- length(samples)
  
  # 3) Prepare an n x n matrix
  corr_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = n,
                     dimnames = list(samples, samples))
  diag(corr_mat) <- 1  # correlation with self = 1
  
  if (comparison_type == "spearman"){

    # 4) Define the correct rank columns based on type
    if (list_of_condition_objects$type == "meta") {
      meta_main_rank_column   <- "dsi"
      meta_tie_breaker_column <- "median_log2FC"
      int_main_rank_column    <- "dsi"
      int_tie_breaker_column  <- "median_log2FC"  
    } else {
      meta_main_rank_column   <- "avg_log2FC"     
      meta_tie_breaker_column <- NULL
      int_main_rank_column    <- "avg_log2FC"
      int_tie_breaker_column  <- NULL
    }
    
    # 5) Fill the upper-triangle only; mirror to lower-triangle
    for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
      for (j in seq(i + 1, n)) {
        cat("Computing Spearman for i =", i, "(", samples[i], ")",
            "and j =", j, "(", samples[j], ")\n")
        
        # 'results_list[[i]]' is the data for sample i
        # 'results_list[[j]]' is the data for sample j
        s <- get_spearman(
          meta_table = results_list[[i]],
          de_table   = results_list[[j]],
          join_column = "gene",
          meta_main_rank_column   = meta_main_rank_column,
          meta_tie_breaker_column = meta_tie_breaker_column,
          int_main_rank_column    = int_main_rank_column,
          int_tie_breaker_column  = int_tie_breaker_column
        )
        
        corr_mat[i, j] <- s$spearman_correlation
        corr_mat[j, i] <- s$spearman_correlation
      }
    }
    
    corr_mat <- as.data.frame(corr_mat)
    
    return_list <- list(
      "correlation_matrix" = corr_mat,
      "type" = list_of_condition_objects$type
    )
    
    
  }
  
  if (comparison_type == "pearson"){
    
    
    # 4) Define the correct rank columns based on type
    if (list_of_condition_objects$type == "meta") {
      meta_effect_size_column   <- "median_log2FC"
      int_effect_size_column <- "median_log2FC"
    } else {
      meta_effect_size_column   <- "avg_log2FC"     
      int_effect_size_column <- "avg_log2FC"
    }
    
    # 5) Fill the upper-triangle only; mirror to lower-triangle
    for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
      for (j in seq(i + 1, n)) {
        cat("Computing Pearson for i =", i, "(", samples[i], ")",
            "and j =", j, "(", samples[j], ")\n")
        
        # 'results_list[[i]]' is the data for sample i
        # 'results_list[[j]]' is the data for sample j
        s <- get_effect_size_correlation(
          meta_table = results_list[[i]],
          de_table   = results_list[[j]],
          join_column = "gene",
          meta_effect_size_column   = meta_effect_size_column,
          int_effect_size_column = int_effect_size_column)
        # browser()
        corr_mat[i, j] <- s$effect_size_pearson_correlation
        corr_mat[j, i] <- s$effect_size_pearson_correlation
      }
    }
    
    corr_mat <- as.data.frame(corr_mat)
    
    return_list <- list(
      "correlation_matrix" = corr_mat,
      "type" = list_of_condition_objects$type
    )
    
  }
  
  if (grepl("^jaccard_", comparison_type)){
    

  #get the threshold from comparison_type. I.e, for jaccard_20 get 20 etc  
  threshold <- as.numeric(sub("^jaccard_(\\d+)$", "\\1", comparison_type))
  

    
    # 4) Define the correct rank columns based on type
    if (list_of_condition_objects$type == "meta") {
      main_meta_rank_column   <- "dsi"
      secondry_meta_rank_column <- "median_log2FC"
      main_int_rank_column   <- "dsi"
      secondry_int_rank_column <- "median_log2FC"
    } else {
      main_meta_rank_column   <- "avg_log2FC"
      secondry_meta_rank_column <- NULL
      main_int_rank_column   <- "avg_log2FC"
      secondry_int_rank_column <- NULL
    }
  
  #one dataframe for top jaccard and one for bottom   
  corr_mat_top <- corr_mat
  corr_mat_bottom <- corr_mat
  
  top_index <- paste0("top_", threshold, "_jaccard_index")
  bottom_index <- paste0("bottom_", threshold, "_jaccard_index")
  
  
    # 5) Fill the upper-triangle only; mirror to lower-triangle
    for (i in seq_len(n - 1)) {
      for (j in seq(i + 1, n)) {
        cat("Computing Jaccard for i =", i, "(", samples[i], ")",
            "and j =", j, "(", samples[j], ")\n")
        
        # 'results_list[[i]]' is the data for sample i
        # 'results_list[[j]]' is the data for sample j
        s <- get_jaccard_index(
          meta_table = results_list[[i]],
          de_table   = results_list[[j]],
          threshold = threshold,
          main_meta_rank_column = main_meta_rank_column,
          secondry_meta_rank_column = secondry_meta_rank_column,
          main_int_rank_column = main_int_rank_column,
          secondry_int_rank_column = secondry_int_rank_column)
        
        
        corr_mat_top[i, j] <- s[[top_index]]
        corr_mat_top[j, i] <- s[[top_index]]
        
        corr_mat_bottom[i, j] <- s[[bottom_index]]
        corr_mat_bottom[j, i] <- s[[bottom_index]]
      }
    }
  
    
  corr_mat_top <- as.data.frame(corr_mat_top)
  corr_mat_bottom <- as.data.frame(corr_mat_bottom)
  
    return_list <- list(
      "corr_mat_top" = corr_mat_top,
      "corr_mat_bottom" = corr_mat_bottom,
      "type" = list_of_condition_objects$type
    )
    
  }
  
  # 6) Return the correlation matrix
  return(return_list)
}

get_metric_heatmap <- function(correlation_matrix,
                               method_type,
                               comparison_type,
                               comparison_type_in_plural,
                               condition = "Multiple Sclerosis") {
  
  information_df <- qs::qread(
    "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/information_df_neuroimmunulogical_samples.qs"
  )
  
  ## 1.  Work out sample keys ---------------------------------------------------
  extract_sample <- if (method_type == "meta") {
    function(x) sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_", "", x)
  } else {
    function(x) sub("_integrated\\.qs$", "",
                    sub("^[^_]+_[^_]+_", "", x))
  }
  
  sample_key <- extract_sample(colnames(correlation_matrix))
  key_tbl <- tibble::tibble(matrix_name = colnames(correlation_matrix),
                            sample      = sample_key)
  
  ## 2.  Align metadata ---------------------------------------------------------
  filt_meta <- information_df |>
    dplyr::filter(condition == condition) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sample = as.character(sample)) |>
    dplyr::inner_join(key_tbl, by = "sample")
  
  mat_keep <- filt_meta$matrix_name
  cor_mat  <- correlation_matrix[mat_keep, mat_keep]
  rownames(cor_mat) <- colnames(cor_mat) <- filt_meta$sample
  
  ## 3.  Colour palettes --------------------------------------------------------
  subtype_pal <- c(CIS = "#bb9457", RRMS = "#432818",
                   "MS-unknown" = "#99582a", CDMS = "#ffe6a7")
  dataset_pal <- c(Esaulova = "#fb8500", Kang = "#8ecae6",
                   Ramesh = "#ffb703", Schafflick = "#219ebc")
  sex_pal     <- c(Female = "#ff8daa", Male = "#32b7ff")
  edss_pal    <- colorRamp2(c(0, 6), c("#70e000", "#e01e37"))
  age_pal     <- colorRamp2(
    range(filt_meta$age, na.rm = TRUE),
    c("#48CAE4", "#03045e")
  )
  
  ## 4.  Column annotation ------------------------------------------------------
  anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    Dataset = filt_meta$dataset,
    Sex     = filt_meta$sex,
    Age     = filt_meta$age,
    EDSS    = filt_meta$EDSS,
    Subtype = filt_meta$condition_subtype,
    col = list(
      Dataset = dataset_pal,
      Sex     = sex_pal,
      Age     = age_pal,
      EDSS    = edss_pal,
      Subtype = subtype_pal
    ),
    na_col = "grey85",
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      EDSS = list(
        title     = "EDSS",
        at        = seq(0, 8, 2),
        labels    = as.character(seq(0, 8, 2)),
        legend_gp = gpar(fill = edss_pal(seq(0, 8, 2)))
      )
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 7)
  )
  
  ## 5.  Heat‑map --------------------------------------------------------------
  column_title <- paste(
    comparison_type_in_plural, "Between", condition,
    "Samples in the", tools::toTitleCase(method_type), "Pipeline"
  )
  
  Heatmap(
    as.matrix(cor_mat),
    name                       = "ρ",
    top_annotation             = anno,
    show_row_names             = FALSE,
    show_column_names          = FALSE,
    cluster_rows               = TRUE,
    cluster_columns            = TRUE,
    clustering_distance_rows    = function(x) as.dist(1 - x),
    clustering_distance_columns = function(x) as.dist(1 - x),
    heatmap_legend_param        = list(
      at    = legend_breaks(cor_mat),
      title = nice_two_line_title(comparison_type),
      title_position = "leftcenter-rot"
    ),
    column_title    = column_title,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 14)
  )
}

get_pdf_metric_heatmaps <- function(path_list, files_to_exclude_list = NULL, condition = "MS", full_condition_name = "Multiple Sclerosis",
                                    pdf_path){
  
  # get meta_list_of_condition_objects and int_list_of_condition_objects
  {
    meta_list_of_condition_objects <- get_list_of_condition_objects(
      path = path_list$meta_path, 
      files_to_exclude = files_to_exclude_list$meta, 
      condition = condition
    )
    
    int_list_of_condition_objects <- get_list_of_condition_objects(
      path = path_list$int_path, 
      files_to_exclude = files_to_exclude_list$int, 
      condition = condition
    )
  }
  

  #get corelation matrixes for each metric
  {
    
    #Spearman and pearson (4 jobs in parallel)
    {
      plan(multisession, workers = 4)      # good default on Windows & Linux
      # use plan(multicore) on macOS/Linux if you like
      
      # Map from the label ("meta"/"int") to the actual object list you already have
      list_map <- list(
        meta = meta_list_of_condition_objects,
        int  = int_list_of_condition_objects
      )
      
      # What do we want to run?
      jobs <- expand.grid(
        list_name = c("meta", "int"),
        metric    = c("spearman", "pearson"),   # add "jaccard_100" here if you want that in parallel too
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # ── Fire the jobs in parallel ─────────────────────────────────────
      result_list <- furrr::future_pmap(
        jobs,
        \(list_name, metric) {
          get_correlation_matrix_for_metric_heatmap(
            list_of_condition_objects = list_map[[list_name]],
            comparison_type           = metric
          )
        }
      )
      
      
      names(result_list) <- paste(jobs$metric, jobs$list_name, sep = "_")
      list2env(result_list, .GlobalEnv)         # creates spearman_meta, …
      plan(sequential)                          # tidy up 
      
      
      
      
    }
   
    #jaccard_100
    jaccard_100_meta <- get_correlation_matrix_for_metric_heatmap(
      list_of_condition_objects = meta_list_of_condition_objects, comparison_type = "jaccard_100")
    
    jaccard_100_int <- get_correlation_matrix_for_metric_heatmap(
      list_of_condition_objects = int_list_of_condition_objects, comparison_type = "jaccard_100")
    
  }
  
  #Get heatmaps
  
  {
    
    spearman_meta_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = spearman_meta$correlation_matrix,
                                                 method_type = spearman_meta$type, comparison_type = "Spearman Correlation" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Spearman Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
    spearman_int_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = spearman_int$correlation_matrix,
                                                method_type = spearman_int$type, comparison_type = "Spearman Correlation" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Spearman Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
    pearson_meta_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = pearson_meta$correlation_matrix,
                                                method_type = pearson_meta$type, comparison_type = "Pearson Correlation" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Pearson Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    pearson_int_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = pearson_int$correlation_matrix,
                                               method_type = pearson_int$type, comparison_type = "Pearson Correlation" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Pearson Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
    jaccard_top_100_meta_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = jaccard_100_meta$corr_mat_top,
                                                        method_type = jaccard_100_meta$type, comparison_type = "Jaccard Top 100" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Jaccard Top 100 Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
    jaccard_bottom_100_meta_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = jaccard_100_meta$corr_mat_bottom,
                                                           method_type = jaccard_100_meta$type, comparison_type = "Jaccard Bottom 100" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Jaccard Bottom 100 Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
    
    jaccard_top_100_int_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = jaccard_100_int$corr_mat_top,
                                                       method_type = jaccard_100_int$type, comparison_type = "Jaccard Top 100" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Jaccard Top 100 Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
    jaccard_bottom_100_int_heatmapt <- get_metric_heatmap(correlation_matrix = jaccard_100_int$corr_mat_bottom,
                                                          method_type = jaccard_100_int$type, comparison_type = "Jaccard Bottom 100" ,comparison_type_in_plural = "Jaccard Bottom 100 Correlations" ,condition = full_condition_name)  
    
  }

  
  #print pdf
  
  {
    pdf(pdf_path, width = 26, height = 20)
    
    
    
    draw(spearman_meta_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    
    draw(spearman_int_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    draw(pearson_meta_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    draw(pearson_int_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    draw(jaccard_top_100_meta_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    draw(jaccard_top_100_int_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    draw(jaccard_bottom_100_meta_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square
    
    draw(jaccard_bottom_100_int_heatmapt,
         heatmap_legend_side      = "right",
         annotation_legend_side   = "right",
         annotation_legend_list   = list(legend_NA("NA")))  # grey85 square    
    
    dev.off()
  
  }

  
}
```
