```{r, "old get_auc_heatmap function", eval=FALSE}


get_auc_heatmap <- function(df,
                               title) {
  
  # --- Sanity checks ----------------------------------------------------------
  required_cols <- c("sample", "pathway", "AUC", "dataset",
                     "condition", "condition_subtype", "age", "sex", "EDSS")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Input data.frame is missing required columns: ",
         paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  if (!is.numeric(df$AUC)) {
    stop("Column 'AUC' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$AUC)[1])
  }
  if (!is.numeric(df$age)) {
    stop("Column 'age' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$age)[1])
  }
  if (!is.numeric(df$EDSS)) {
    stop("Column 'EDSS' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$EDSS)[1])
  }
  if (!is.character(df$sample) && !is.factor(df$sample)) {
    stop("Column 'sample' must be character or factor, but got: ",
         class(df$sample)[1])
  }
  if (!is.character(df$pathway) && !is.factor(df$pathway)) {
    stop("Column 'pathway' must be character or factor, but got: ",
         class(df$pathway)[1])
  }
  
  # --- 1. Prepare meta --------------------------------------------------------
  df <- df |> dplyr::mutate(sample = as.character(.data$sample))
  
  # Per-sample metadata (one row per sample)
  filt_meta <- df |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$sample) |>
    dplyr::distinct(.data$sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- 2. Build AUC matrix: pathways (rows) × samples (cols) -----------------
  auc_wide <- df |>
    dplyr::select(.data$pathway, .data$sample, .data$AUC) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$pathway, .data$sample) |>
    dplyr::summarise(AUC = mean(.data$AUC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = .data$sample,
      values_from = .data$AUC,
      values_fill = NA_real_
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$pathway)
  
  auc_mat <- as.matrix(auc_wide[ , -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(auc_mat) <- auc_wide$pathway
  browser()
  
  # Ensure column order matches metadata order
  # --- Custom column ordering ---------------------------------------------------
  condition_order <- c("CD59 Def.", "CD55 Def.", "Multiple Sclerosis", "Ab-mediated IDD")
  
  # Ensure 'condition' is a factor with the desired order
  filt_meta$condition <- factor(filt_meta$condition, levels = condition_order)
  
  # Order metadata first by condition, then by dataset (alphabetically), then by sample
  filt_meta <- filt_meta |>
    dplyr::arrange(condition, dataset, sample)
  
  # Reorder columns of the matrix to match this metadata
  common_cols <- filt_meta$sample
  auc_mat     <- auc_mat[ , common_cols, drop = FALSE]  
  
  filt_meta   <- filt_meta[match(common_cols, filt_meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # --- 3. Colour palettes -----------------------------------------------------
  dataset_pal <- c(Esaulova = "#E9A5F1", Kang = "#FFB4B4",
                   Ramesh = "#e76f51", Schafflick = "#000", Mevorach ="#ff4d6d")
  
  subtype_pal <- c(CIS = "#bb9457", RRMS = "#432818",
                   "CD55 Def." = "#ffb703", "CD59 Def." = "#fb8500",
                   "MOGAD" = "#2C6E49", "NMOSD" = "#B2DF8A")
  
  condition_pal <- c("Multiple Sclerosis" = "#023047", "Ab-mediated IDD" = "#8ecae6",
                     "CD55 Def." = "#ffb703", "CD59 Def." = "#fb8500")
  sex_pal     <- c(Female = "#ff8daa", Male = "#32b7ff")
  
  edss_pal <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 6),  c("#70e000", "#e01e37"))
  age_pal  <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(20, 80), c("#48CAE4", "#03045e"))
  
  # --- 4. Column annotation ---------------------------------------------------
  anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    Dataset   = filt_meta$dataset,
    Condition = filt_meta$condition,
    Sex       = filt_meta$sex,
    Age       = filt_meta$age,
    EDSS      = filt_meta$EDSS,
    Subtype   = filt_meta$condition_subtype,
    col = list(
      Dataset   = dataset_pal,
      Condition = condition_pal,
      Sex       = sex_pal,
      Age       = age_pal,
      EDSS      = edss_pal,
      Subtype   = subtype_pal
    ),
    na_col = "grey85",
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      EDSS = list(
        title     = "EDSS",
        at        = seq(0, 6, 2),
        labels    = as.character(seq(0, 6, 2)),
        legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = edss_pal(seq(0, 6, 2)))
      )
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = 7)
  )
  
  # --- 5. Heat-map ------------------------------------------------------------
  ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    auc_mat,
    name                        = "AUC",
    top_annotation              = anno,
    show_row_names              = TRUE,
    show_column_names           = FALSE,
    cluster_rows                = TRUE,
    cluster_columns             = TRUE,
    clustering_distance_rows    = "euclidean",
    clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
    na_col                      = "grey95",
    heatmap_legend_param        = list(
      at    = legend_breaks(auc_mat),
      title = "AUC",
      title_position = "leftcenter-rot"
    ),
    column_title    = title,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 14)
  )
}
```

```{r, "rerun ramesh_31b_cd4 one on one, and meta table and auc scores", eval=FALSE}
ramesh_31b_nk <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs")
ramesh_31b_mon <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs")

ramesh_31b_b <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs")
ramesh_31b_cd4 <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs")
ramesh_31b_cd8 <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs")


  # Check that they have 12 controls each
  {
    # packages
    if (!requireNamespace("qs", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'qs' is required")
    library(qs)
    
    # ── Expected datasets → samples (12 total) ───────────────────────────────────
    expected <- list(
      "Mevorach" = c("CD55-control", "CD59-control"),
      "Hong"     = paste0("HC-", 1:5),
      "Kang"     = c("JSB", "KYO"),
      "Ramesh"   = c("2", "3", "32")
    )
    
    # ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    is_valid_table <- function(x) {
      if (is.null(x)) return(FALSE)
      if (length(x) == 1L && is.na(x)) return(FALSE)
      if (is.data.frame(x)) return(nrow(x) > 0)
      FALSE
    }
    
    check_file <- function(file_path, cell_type, expected_map) {
      obj <- tryCatch(qread(file_path), error = function(e) NULL)
      
      missing <- character(0)
      for (ds in names(expected_map)) {
        for (smp in expected_map[[ds]]) {
          ot <- tryCatch({
            if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj[[ds]]) || is.null(obj[[ds]][[smp]])) {
              NA
            } else {
              obj[[ds]][[smp]][["original_table"]]
            }
          }, error = function(e) NA)
          
          if (!is_valid_table(ot)) {
            missing <- c(missing, paste(ds, smp, sep = "/"))
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (length(missing) > 0) {
        data.frame(
          cell_type        = cell_type,
          object           = sub("\\.qs$", "", basename(file_path)),
          num_of_missing   = length(missing),
          names_of_missing = paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }
    
    # ── Check the 5 specific output_lists ───────────────────────────────────────
    files_map <- c(
      "NKs"           = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs",
      "Monocytes"     = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs",
      "B Cells"       = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs",
      "CD4 + T cells" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs",
      "CD8 + T cells" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/MS_Ramesh_31b_outputlist.qs"
    )
    
    res_list <- list()
    
    for (ct in names(files_map)) {
      fpath <- files_map[[ct]]
      if (!file.exists(fpath)) {
        # If file is missing, mark all 12 as missing for visibility
        all_missing <- unlist(lapply(names(expected), function(ds) {
          paste(ds, expected[[ds]], sep = "/")
        }))
        res_list[[ct]] <- data.frame(
          cell_type        = ct,
          object           = sub("\\.qs$", "", basename(fpath)),
          num_of_missing   = length(all_missing),
          names_of_missing = paste(all_missing, collapse = ", "),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        next
      }
      row <- check_file(fpath, cell_type = ct, expected_map = expected)
      if (!is.null(row)) res_list[[ct]] <- row
    }
    
    missing_df <- if (length(res_list) > 0L) {
      do.call(rbind, res_list)
    } else {
      data.frame(
        cell_type = character(),
        object = character(),
        num_of_missing = integer(),
        names_of_missing = character(),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    if (nrow(missing_df)) {
      missing_df <- missing_df[order(missing_df$cell_type, missing_df$object), ]
    }
    
    missing_df
  }

#runing cd4_t_ramesh_31b on soley healthy_list_cd4_t_hong
{
  # --- Load lists you specified -------------------------------------------------
  cd4_t_cells_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroimmunulogocial_lists_per_cell_type/cd4_t_cells_list_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
  keep_cd4 <- c("seu_MS_Ramesh_31b")
  cd4_t_ramesh_31b <- cd4_t_cells_list[intersect(names(cd4_t_cells_list), keep_cd4)]
  
  healthy_list_cd4_t_cells <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list_cd4_t_cells.qs")
  keep_ctrl <- c("seu_hong")
  healthy_list_cd4_t_hong <- healthy_list_cd4_t_cells[intersect(names(healthy_list_cd4_t_cells), keep_ctrl)]
  
  options(future.globals.maxSize = 400 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)  # 400 GB
  
  
  # --- Helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------
  get_meta_scalar <- function(seu, fields, default = NA_character_) {
    for (fld in fields) {
      if (!is.null(seu@meta.data[[fld]])) {
        vals <- unique(as.character(seu@meta.data[[fld]]))
        vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & nzchar(vals)]
        if (length(vals) >= 1) return(vals[1])
      }
    }
    default
  }
  
  parse_name_fallback <- function(x) {
    nm <- sub("^seu_", "", x)
    parts <- strsplit(nm, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    condition <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else nm
    dataset   <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else "unknownDataset"
    sample    <- if (length(parts) >= 3) paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_") else "unknownSample"
    list(condition = condition, dataset = dataset, sample = sample)
  }
  
  safe_control_key <- function(seu_control, fallback_name) {
    key <- get_meta_scalar(seu_control, c("orig.ident", "orig_ident", "dataset"))
    if (is.na(key) || !nzchar(key)) key <- fallback_name
    as.character(key)
  }
  
  patient_labels <- function(seu_patient, patient_name) {
    condition <- get_meta_scalar(seu_patient, c("condition", "patient_type", "disease", "group"))
    dataset   <- get_meta_scalar(seu_patient, c("dataset", "orig.ident", "orig_ident", "source"))
    sample    <- get_meta_scalar(seu_patient, c("sample", "sample_id", "sample.name", "sample_name"))
    if (is.na(condition) || is.na(dataset) || is.na(sample) ||
        !nzchar(condition) || !nzchar(dataset) || !nzchar(sample)) {
      parsed <- parse_name_fallback(patient_name)
      if (is.na(condition) || !nzchar(condition)) condition <- parsed$condition
      if (is.na(dataset)   || !nzchar(dataset))   dataset   <- parsed$dataset
      if (is.na(sample)    || !nzchar(sample))    sample    <- parsed$sample
    }
    list(condition = condition, dataset = dataset, sample = sample)
  }
  
  
  # --- Runner for the (single) cell type; no tryCatch ---------------------------
  run_one_on_one_for_celltype <- function(patient_list, healthy_list, folder = "CD4_T_cells") {
    if (length(patient_list) == 0) stop("patient_list is empty.")
    if (length(healthy_list) == 0) stop("healthy_list is empty.")
    
    message("▶ Cell type: ", folder)
    
    for (patient_name in names(patient_list)) {
      seu_patient <- patient_list[[patient_name]]
      if (!inherits(seu_patient, "Seurat")) stop("Patient '", patient_name, "' is not a Seurat object.")
      
      ids <- patient_labels(seu_patient, patient_name)
      message(sprintf("  • Patient: %s (condition=%s, dataset=%s, sample=%s)",
                      patient_name, ids$condition, ids$dataset, ids$sample))
      
      output_list <- list()
      
      for (control_name in names(healthy_list)) {
        seu_control <- healthy_list[[control_name]]
        if (!inherits(seu_control, "Seurat")) stop("Control '", control_name, "' is not a Seurat object.")
        
        control_key <- safe_control_key(seu_control, control_name)
        
        # loud failure if anything goes wrong:
        output <- one_on_one(
          seu_patient, seu_control,
          patient_type       = ids$condition,
          control_type       = "Healthy",
          patient_orig_ident = ids$dataset
        )
        
        if (control_key %in% names(output_list)) {
          output_list[[control_key]] <- append(output_list[[control_key]], output[[control_key]])
        } else {
          if (!is.null(output[[control_key]])) {
            output_list[[control_key]] <- output[[control_key]]
          } else if (length(output) >= 1) {
            output_list[[control_key]] <- output[[1]]
          } else {
            stop("Unexpected output structure for control '", control_name, "'.")
          }
        }
      } # controls
      
      # *** Save flat: /bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/file_name.qs ***
      out_dir <- "/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp"
      dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
      
      out_path <- file.path(
        out_dir,
        sprintf("%s_%s_%s_outputlist.qs", ids$condition, ids$dataset, ids$sample)
      )
      
      qsave(output_list, out_path)
      message("     ✔ saved ", out_path)
      
      gc()
    }
  }
  
  
  # --- Execute ONLY your requested comparison -----------------------------------
  run_one_on_one_for_celltype(
    patient_list = cd4_t_ramesh_31b,
    healthy_list = healthy_list_cd4_t_hong,
    folder       = "CD4_T_cells"
  )
  gc()
  
  
  
}
```

```{r, "finding MS and AB samples that have active complexes", eval=FALSE}



resp_auc_cell_type_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/multi_cell_analysis/oxidative_stress/resp_auc_cell_type_list.qs")



#MS in resp
{
  
  # Find MS samples with median AUC ≥ 0.6 per cell type
  qual_by_celltype <- lapply(names(resp_auc_cell_type_list), function(ct) {
    df <- resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
    # keep MS rows (handles "MS" or "Multiple Sclerosis", case-insensitive)
    df_ms <- df[grepl("(?i)^ms|multiple sclerosis", df$condition), ]
    if (nrow(df_ms) == 0) return(data.frame())
    
    # median AUC across pathways per dataset+sample
    agg <- aggregate(
      AUC ~ dataset + sample + condition_subtype + EDSS,
      data = df_ms,
      FUN = function(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    res <- agg[agg$AUC >= 0.6, ]
    if (nrow(res) == 0) return(data.frame())
    
    # rename AUC column for clarity and order nicely
    names(res)[names(res) == "AUC"] <- "median_AUC"
    res <- res[order(res$median_AUC, decreasing = TRUE), ]
    rownames(res) <- NULL
    res
  })
  
  # keep names by cell type
  names(qual_by_celltype) <- names(resp_auc_cell_type_list)
  
  # (Optional) view results
  qual_by_celltype
  
  
  
  # Combine into one table with cell type info
  qual_all <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(names(qual_by_celltype), function(ct) {
      x <- qual_by_celltype[[ct]]
      if (nrow(x)) cbind(cell_type = ct, x) else NULL
    })
  )
  
  # Now aggregate: for each dataset+sample, collect cell types and counts
  library(dplyr)
  
  summary_samples <- qual_all %>%
    group_by(dataset, sample, condition_subtype, EDSS) %>%
    summarise(
      cell_types = paste(unique(cell_type), collapse = ", "),
      n_cell_types = n_distinct(cell_type),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  summary_samples
  

  
}

#AB mediated IDD in resp
{
  library(dplyr)
  
  # Normalize condition strings (trim, lowercase, normalize weird dashes to "-")
  .norm_condition <- function(x) {
    x <- trimws(tolower(x))
    x <- gsub("[\u2010\u2011\u2012\u2013\u2014\u2212]", "-", x)  # map various dashes to "-"
    x
  }
  
  # Per cell type: keep "Ab-mediated IDD", compute median AUC across pathways, keep median >= 0.6
  qual_by_celltype_ab <- setNames(
    lapply(names(resp_auc_cell_type_list), function(ct) {
      df <- resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
      
      # exact match (case-insensitive), after normalization
      keep <- .norm_condition(df$condition) == "ab-mediated idd"
      df_ab <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
      
      # drop rows missing core fields or with all-NA AUC
      df_ab <- df_ab %>%
        mutate(dataset = as.character(dataset), sample = as.character(sample)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(dataset), !is.na(sample), !is.na(AUC))
      
      if (!nrow(df_ab)) return(data.frame())
      
      res <- df_ab %>%
        group_by(dataset, sample, condition_subtype, EDSS) %>%
        summarise(median_AUC = median(AUC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
        filter(!is.na(median_AUC), median_AUC >= 0.55) %>%
        arrange(desc(median_AUC))
      
      if (!nrow(res)) data.frame() else res
    }),
    names(resp_auc_cell_type_list)
  )
  
  # Collapse to: which samples appear, in how many & which cell types
  qual_all_ab <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(names(qual_by_celltype_ab), function(ct) {
      x <- qual_by_celltype_ab[[ct]]
      if (nrow(x)) cbind(cell_type = ct, x, row.names = NULL) else NULL
    })
  )
  
  summary_ab <- if (!is.null(qual_all_ab) && nrow(qual_all_ab) > 0) {
    qual_all_ab %>%
      group_by(dataset, sample, condition_subtype, EDSS) %>%
      summarise(
        cell_types   = paste(sort(unique(cell_type)), collapse = ", "),
        n_cell_types = n_distinct(cell_type),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(n_cell_types), dataset, sample)
  } else {
    tibble(
      dataset = character(), sample = character(),
      condition_subtype = character(), EDSS = numeric(),
      cell_types = character(), n_cell_types = integer()
    )
  }
  
  # View results
  summary_ab
  
  
}
```

```{r, "old get_auc_boxplot function", eval=FALSE}

get_auc_boxplot <- function(
    df, title,
    point_size         = 4,
    title_size         = 24,
    axis_title_size    = 22,
    axis_text_size     = 20,
    legend_title_size  = 22,
    legend_label_size  = 20,
    point_jitter_width = 0.2,  # set to 0 for no horizontal jitter
    point_jitter_height= 0 ,    # keep at 0 so AUC stays exact
    plot_margin_left   = 130    # add a bit of left margin (pt) to avoid clipping
) {
  # --- Sanity checks ----------------------------------------------------------
  required_cols <- c("pathway", "AUC", "dataset", "condition")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Input data.frame is missing required columns: ",
         paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (!is.numeric(df$AUC)) {
    stop("Column 'AUC' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$AUC)[1])
  }
  if (!is.character(df$pathway) && !is.factor(df$pathway)) {
    stop("Column 'pathway' must be character or factor, but got: ",
         class(df$pathway)[1])
  }
  if (!is.character(df$dataset) && !is.factor(df$dataset)) {
    stop("Column 'dataset' must be character or factor, but got: ",
         class(df$dataset)[1])
  }
  if (!is.character(df$condition) && !is.factor(df$condition)) {
    stop("Column 'condition' must be character or factor, but got: ",
         class(df$condition)[1])
  }
  # Optional: warn if AUC outside [0,1]
  if (any(!is.na(df$AUC) & (df$AUC < 0 | df$AUC > 1))) {
    warning("Some 'AUC' values are outside [0, 1]; they may be clipped by y-axis limits.")
  }
  
  # Palettes: colors by CONDITION, shapes by DATASET
  condition_pal <- c(
    "Multiple Sclerosis" = "#023047",
    "Ab-mediated IDD"    = "#8ecae6",
    "CD55 Def."          = "#ffb703",
    "CD59 Def."          = "#fb8500"
  )
  shape_vals <- c(
    "Esaulova"   = 25,
    "Kang"       = 24,
    "Ramesh"     = 23,
    "Mevorach"   = 22,
    "Schafflick" = 21
  )
  
  # Palette coverage checks
  missing_cond <- setdiff(unique(as.character(df$condition)), names(condition_pal))
  if (length(missing_cond) > 0) {
    warning("Conditions missing from color palette: ", paste(missing_cond, collapse = ", "))
  }
  missing_ds <- setdiff(unique(as.character(df$dataset)), names(shape_vals))
  if (length(missing_ds) > 0) {
    warning("Datasets missing from shape palette: ", paste(missing_ds, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # --- Pathway renaming & ordering -------------------------------------------
  pathway_names <- c(
    "Kegg Medicus Reference Electron Transfer in Complex i"         = "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex I",
    "Reactome Complex i Biogenesis"                                 = "Reactome: Complex I Biogenesis",
    "Wp Mitochondrial Complex Ii Assembly"                          = "WP: Complex II Assembly",
    "Gobp Mitochondrial Electron Transport Succinate to Ubiquinone" = "GO-BP:ETC in Complex II",
    "Wp Mitochondrial Complex Iii Assembly"                         = "WP: Complex III Assembly",
    "Kegg Medicus Reference Electron Transfer in Complex Iii"       = "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex III",
    "Wp Mitochondrial Complex Iv Assembly"                          = "WP: Complex IV Assembly",
    "Kegg Medicus Reference Electron Transfer in Complex Iv"        = "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex IV",
    "Gobp Mitochondrial Proton Transporting Atp Synthase Complex Assembly" = "GO-BP: Complex V Assembly",
    "Gobp Proton Motive Force Driven Atp Synthesis"                 = "GO-BP: PMF-Driven ATP Synthesis"
  )
  row_order <- c(
    "Reactome: Complex I Biogenesis",
    "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex I",
    "WP: Complex II Assembly",
    "GO-BP:ETC in Complex II",
    "WP: Complex III Assembly",
    "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex III",
    "WP: Complex IV Assembly",
    "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex IV",
    "GO-BP: Complex V Assembly",
    "GO-BP: PMF-Driven ATP Synthesis"
  )
  
  # case-insensitive rename; keep originals if not in map
  map_lc <- stats::setNames(unname(pathway_names), tolower(names(pathway_names)))
  cur    <- as.character(df$pathway)
  renamed <- unname(map_lc[tolower(cur)])
  df$pathway <- ifelse(is.na(renamed), cur, renamed)
  
  # order: requested order first, then any extras (if present)
  level_order <- c(row_order, setdiff(unique(df$pathway), row_order))
  df$pathway  <- factor(df$pathway, levels = level_order)
  
  # Build plot
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = pathway, y = AUC)) +
    ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, color = "#444444", fill = "white") +
    ggplot2::geom_jitter(
      ggplot2::aes(fill = condition, shape = dataset),
      size   = point_size,
      width  = point_jitter_width,
      height = point_jitter_height,
      stroke = 0.4,
      color  = "black"
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      name   = "Condition",
      values = condition_pal,
      drop   = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(
      name   = "Dataset",
      values = shape_vals,
      breaks = names(shape_vals),
      drop   = FALSE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "AUC score"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_line(color = "#efefef"),
      axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = axis_text_size),
      axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_title_size),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_text(size = axis_title_size),
      plot.title   = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = title_size),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box      = "vertical",
      legend.title    = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      legend.text     = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_label_size),
      plot.margin     = ggplot2::margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = plot_margin_left, unit = "pt")
    ) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      fill  = ggplot2::guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21, size = 3, color = "black")),
      shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, fill = "grey80"))
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r, "resp heatmap for all samples (neuroimmunological and neuroinflammatory)", eval=FALSE}

# get resp_auc_cell_type_list for neuroinflam conditions
{
  # If not already loaded:
  # library(qs)
  
  resp_auc_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/multi_cell_analysis/oxidative_stress/neuroinflammatory_resp_auc_list.qs")
  
  ## Build a list of 5 data frames (one per cell type) from resp_auc_list
  ## Each row = pathway; columns = pathway, AUC (for that cell type), condition, dataset, sample
  cell_types <- c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells")
  resp_auc_cell_type_list <- setNames(vector("list", length(cell_types)), cell_types)
  
  strip_outputlist <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- trimws(x)
    # remove a trailing "_outputlist"
    sub("_outputlist$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  }
  
  for (ct in cell_types) {
    pieces <- lapply(names(resp_auc_list), function(nm) {
      mat <- resp_auc_list[[nm]]
      if (is.null(mat) || !is.data.frame(mat) || !(ct %in% colnames(mat))) return(NULL)
      
      # Parse condition / dataset / sample from the name: cond_dataset_sample(_outputlist)
      parts <- strsplit(nm, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      condition <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else NA_character_
      dataset   <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else NA_character_
      sample    <- if (length(parts) >= 3) paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_") else NA_character_
      
      # Normalize sample so it matches the lookup table
      sample <- strip_outputlist(sample)
      
      df <- data.frame(
        pathway   = rownames(mat),
        AUC       = as.numeric(mat[[ct]]),
        condition = condition,
        dataset   = dataset,
        sample    = sample,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # (Optional) keep the found_genes column—uncomment if you want it
      # if ("found_genes" %in% colnames(mat)) {
      #   df$found_genes <- as.character(mat[["found_genes"]])
      # }
      
      df
    })
    
    pieces <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pieces)
    resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- if (length(pieces)) do.call(rbind, pieces) else
      data.frame(pathway=character(), AUC=numeric(), condition=character(),
                 dataset=character(), sample=character(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
    
    rownames(resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]) <- NULL
  }
  
  # Quick glance:
  # lapply(resp_auc_cell_type_list, head)
  
  # Standardize sample names (do this AFTER stripping _outputlist above)
  {
    for (ct in names(resp_auc_cell_type_list)) {
      df <- resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
      
      # Ensure character & trimmed
      df$sample <- trimws(as.character(df$sample))
      
      # Turn "CD55-patient" into "CD55_Patient"
      df$sample[df$sample == "CD55-patient"] <- "CD55_Patient"
      
      resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- df
    }
    # Quick check:
    # lapply(resp_auc_cell_type_list, function(df) unique(df$sample))
  }
  
  # ---- Add meta data from information_df_neuroimmunulogical_samples ----
  {
    information_df_neuroimmunulogical_samples <- qread(
      "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/information_df_neuroinflammatory_samples.qs"
    )
    
    # Normalize the key on the lookup too (defensive: trim, ensure char)
    information_df_neuroimmunulogical_samples$sample <- trimws(
      as.character(information_df_neuroimmunulogical_samples$sample)
    )
    
    cols_to_add <- c("condition", "condition_subtype", "age", "sex", "EDSS")
    # If you also want number_of_cells, include it:
    # cols_to_add <- c("condition", "condition_subtype", "age", "sex", "EDSS", "number_of_cells")
    
    resp_auc_cell_type_list <- lapply(
      resp_auc_cell_type_list,
      function(df) {
        # Drop the pre-parsed condition so the authoritative one from the lookup can be merged in
        if ("condition" %in% names(df)) df$condition <- NULL
        
        # Left-join by 'sample'
        out <- merge(
          df,
          information_df_neuroimmunulogical_samples[, c("sample", cols_to_add)],
          by = "sample",
          all.x = TRUE,
          sort = FALSE
        )
        
        # Keep column classes sane
        out$sample <- as.character(out$sample)
        out
      }
    )
    
    # Optional: sanity check for unmatched samples
    # unmatched <- lapply(resp_auc_cell_type_list, function(df) df$sample[is.na(df$condition)])
    # unmatched
  }
  
  # ---- Turn "CDMS" into "RRMS" under condition_subtype ----
  {
    for (ct in names(resp_auc_cell_type_list)) {
      df <- resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
      if ("condition_subtype" %in% names(df)) {
        df$condition_subtype <- as.character(df$condition_subtype)
        df$condition_subtype[df$condition_subtype == "CDMS"] <- "RRMS"
      }
      resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- df
    }
    
    # Quick check
    # lapply(resp_auc_cell_type_list, function(df) unique(df$condition_subtype))
  }
}

#merging the two
{
  
  # Build merged list: resp_auc_cell_type_list
  {
    # Desired order of cell types
    cell_types <- c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells")
    
    # Helper: make an empty df with the same columns as a template
    make_empty_like <- function(template_df) {
      out <- template_df[0, , drop = FALSE]
      rownames(out) <- NULL
      out
    }
    
    resp_auc_cell_type_list <- setNames(vector("list", length(cell_types)), cell_types)
    
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      df_old <- resp_neuroim_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
      df_new <- resp_neuroinf_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
      
      # If one side is missing, create an empty df shaped like the other
      if (is.null(df_old) && !is.null(df_new)) df_old <- make_empty_like(df_new)
      if (is.null(df_new) && !is.null(df_old)) df_new <- make_empty_like(df_old)
      if (is.null(df_old) && is.null(df_new)) {
        # both missing → empty placeholder with standard columns
        resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- data.frame(
          sample = character(), pathway = character(), AUC = numeric(),
          dataset = character(), condition = character(), condition_subtype = character(),
          age = numeric(), sex = character(), EDSS = numeric(),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        next
      }
      
      # Sanity: ensure same columns & order (they should be; align if needed)
      common_cols <- intersect(names(df_old), names(df_new))
      df_old <- df_old[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
      df_new <- df_new[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
      
      # Row-bind: old first, then add new rows
      merged <- rbind(df_old, df_new)
      rownames(merged) <- NULL
      
      resp_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- merged
    }
    
    # Optional quick check
    # lapply(resp_auc_cell_type_list, function(x) c(nrow=nrow(x)))
  }

#modifying the heatmap function to hundle the new data

{
  get_auc_heatmap_try <- function(df, title, meta_name_fontsize = 11) {
    # --- Sanity checks ----------------------------------------------------------
    required_cols <- c("sample", "pathway", "AUC", "dataset",
                       "condition", "condition_subtype", "age", "sex", "EDSS")
    missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(df))
    if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
      stop("Input data.frame is missing required columns: ",
           paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
    }
    if (!is.numeric(df$AUC))  stop("Column 'AUC' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$AUC)[1])
    if (!is.numeric(df$age))  stop("Column 'age' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$age)[1])
    if (!is.numeric(df$EDSS)) stop("Column 'EDSS' must be numeric, but got: ", class(df$EDSS)[1])
    if (!is.character(df$sample) && !is.factor(df$sample))
      stop("Column 'sample' must be character or factor, but got: ", class(df$sample)[1])
    if (!is.character(df$pathway) && !is.factor(df$pathway))
      stop("Column 'pathway' must be character or factor, but got: ", class(df$pathway)[1])
    
    # --- 1. Prepare meta --------------------------------------------------------
    df <- df |>
      dplyr::mutate(sample  = as.character(.data$sample),
                    pathway = as.character(.data$pathway))
    
    ## ── 2. Rename pathways (shorter labels) & set desired row order ───────────
    pathway_names <- c(
      "Kegg Medicus Reference Electron Transfer in Complex i"       = "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex I",
      "Reactome Complex i Biogenesis"                               = "Reactome: Complex I Biogenesis",
      "Wp Mitochondrial Complex Ii Assembly"                        = "WP: Complex II Assembly",
      "Gobp Mitochondrial Electron Transport Succinate to Ubiquinone" = "GO-BP:ETC in Complex II",
      "Wp Mitochondrial Complex Iii Assembly"                       = "WP: Complex III Assembly",
      "Kegg Medicus Reference Electron Transfer in Complex Iii"     = "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex III",
      "Wp Mitochondrial Complex Iv Assembly"                        = "WP: Complex IV Assembly",
      "Kegg Medicus Reference Electron Transfer in Complex Iv"      = "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex IV",
      "Gobp Mitochondrial Proton Transporting Atp Synthase Complex Assembly" = "GO-BP: Complex V Assembly",
      "Gobp Proton Motive Force Driven Atp Synthesis"               = "GO-BP: PMF-Driven ATP Synthesis"
    )
    row_order <- c(
      "Reactome: Complex I Biogenesis",
      "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex I",
      "WP: Complex II Assembly",
      "GO-BP:ETC in Complex II",
      "WP: Complex III Assembly",
      "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex III",
      "WP: Complex IV Assembly",
      "KEGG-MR: ETC in Complex IV",
      "GO-BP: Complex V Assembly",
      "GO-BP: PMF-Driven ATP Synthesis"
    )
    
    # apply renaming (unmapped names stay as-is)
    df$pathway <- ifelse(df$pathway %in% names(pathway_names),
                         unname(pathway_names[df$pathway]),
                         df$pathway)
    
    # Per-sample metadata (one row per sample)
    filt_meta <- df |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$sample) |>
      dplyr::distinct(.data$sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # --- 2. Build AUC matrix: pathways (rows) × samples (cols) -----------------
    auc_wide <- df |>
      dplyr::select(.data$pathway, .data$sample, .data$AUC) |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$pathway, .data$sample) |>
      dplyr::summarise(AUC = mean(.data$AUC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from  = .data$sample,
        values_from = .data$AUC,
        values_fill = NA_real_
      ) |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$pathway)
    
    auc_mat <- as.matrix(auc_wide[ , -1, drop = FALSE])
    rownames(auc_mat) <- auc_wide$pathway
    
    # Reorder rows to desired order (keep any extras after)
    desired_rows <- intersect(row_order, rownames(auc_mat))
    other_rows   <- setdiff(rownames(auc_mat), desired_rows)
    auc_mat      <- auc_mat[c(desired_rows, other_rows), , drop = FALSE]
    
    # --- Allocate space for long left-side row labels --------------------------
    row_lab_gp <- grid::gpar(fontsize = 11)
    row_lab_w  <- ComplexHeatmap::max_text_width(rownames(auc_mat), gp = row_lab_gp) * 1.1
    
    # --- Custom column ordering -------------------------------------------------
    condition_order <- c("CD59 Def.", "CD55 Def.", "Multiple Sclerosis", "Ab-mediated IDD", "pSS", "Uveitis")
    filt_meta$condition <- factor(filt_meta$condition, levels = condition_order)
    filt_meta <- filt_meta |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$condition, .data$dataset, .data$sample)
    
    common_cols <- filt_meta$sample
    auc_mat     <- auc_mat[ , common_cols, drop = FALSE]
    filt_meta   <- filt_meta[match(common_cols, filt_meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]
    
    # --- 3. Colour palettes -----------------------------------------------------
    dataset_pal <- c(
      Esaulova = "#E9A5F1", Kang = "#FFB4B4",
      Ramesh = "#e76f51", Schafflick = "#000000",
      Mevorach ="#ff4d6d", Hong = "#780000"
    )
    subtype_pal <- c(CIS = "#bb9457", RRMS = "#432818",
                     "CD55 Def." = "#ffb703", "CD59 Def." = "#fb8500",
                     "MOGAD" = "#2C6E49", "NMOSD" = "#B2DF8A", "pSS" = "#ffa5ab", "Uveitis" = "#7678ed")
    condition_pal <- c("Multiple Sclerosis" = "#023047", "Ab-mediated IDD" = "#8ecae6",
                       "CD55 Def." = "#ffb703", "CD59 Def." = "#fb8500", "pSS" = "#ffa5ab", "Uveitis" ="#7678ed")
    sex_pal     <- c(Female = "#ff8daa", Male = "#32b7ff")
    edss_pal <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 6),  c("#70e000", "#e01e37"))
    age_pal  <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(20, 80), c("#48CAE4", "#03045e"))
    
    

    
    # --- 4. Column annotation (order + labels) ---------------------------------
    anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
      Condition       = filt_meta$condition,
      `Sub-Condition` = filt_meta$condition_subtype,
      Dataset         = filt_meta$dataset,
      Sex             = filt_meta$sex,
      Age             = filt_meta$age,
      EDSS            = filt_meta$EDSS,
      col = list(
        Condition       = condition_pal,
        `Sub-Condition` = subtype_pal,
        Dataset         = dataset_pal,
        Sex             = sex_pal,
        Age             = age_pal,
        EDSS            = edss_pal
      ),
      na_col = "grey85",
      annotation_legend_param = list(
        EDSS = list(
          title     = "EDSS",
          at        = seq(0, 6, 2),
          labels    = as.character(seq(0, 6, 2)),
          legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = edss_pal(seq(0, 6, 2)))
        )
      ),
      annotation_name_side = "left",
      annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = meta_name_fontsize)  # <— control metadata label font
    )
    
    # --- 5. Heat-map ------------------------------------------------------------
    ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
      auc_mat,
      name                        = "AUC",
      top_annotation              = anno,
      show_row_names              = TRUE,
      row_names_side              = "left",
      row_names_gp                = row_lab_gp,
      row_names_max_width         = row_lab_w,
      show_column_names           = FALSE,
      cluster_rows                = FALSE,
      row_order                   = rownames(auc_mat),
      cluster_columns             = FALSE,
      column_order                = common_cols,
      clustering_distance_rows    = "euclidean",
      clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
      na_col                      = "grey85",
      heatmap_legend_param        = list(
        at    = legend_breaks(auc_mat),
        title = "AUC",
        title_position = "leftcenter-rot"
      ),
      column_title    = title,
      column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 14)
    )
    
    return(ht)
  }
  
}


#call the heatmaps
{
  
  #heatmaps
  {
    
    # sanitize cell-type names for filenames
    sanitize <- function(x) {
      x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)
      x <- gsub("^_|_$", "", x)
      tolower(x)
    }
    
    out_dir <- "/bigdata/bgutman/BackUp/"

      dev.off()
      
      message("Saved: ", outfile)
    }
    
  }
```

```{r, "Basic pipeline for neuro-inflam samples", eval=FALSE}
#Basic pipeline for neuro-inflam samples 
{

    seu_ramesh_5 <- qread("/bigdata/barakgutman/neuroimmunulogical_project/scRNA-seq/scRNA_PBMCs/data/MS_and_other_disorders/Ramesh/seu_ramesh_5.qs")

    # seu_schafflick$orig.ident <- "Schafflick"

    seu_hong <- qread("/bigdata/barakgutman/neuroimmunulogical_project/scRNA-seq/scRNA_PBMCs/data/pSS/Hong/seu_hong.qs")
    seu_hong <- subset(seu_hong, subset = condition  == "pSS")
    
    
    
    
    neuroinflam_list <- list(seu_ramesh_5 = seu_ramesh_5,
                             seu_hong = seu_hong)
    
    rm(seu_ramesh_5, seu_hong)
    
    for (nm in names(neuroinflam_list)) {
      seu <- neuroinflam_list[[nm]]
      
      # if ("condition" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
      #   seu$condition[seu$condition == "Ab-mediated IDD"] <- "Ab.mediated.IDD"
      # }
      
      neuroinflam_list[[nm]] <- seu
    }
    
    
    
    
    
  }
  
  #run get_all_cell_types for each sample in neuroimmunulogical list
  {
    
    options(future.globals.maxSize = 320 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)  # 320 GB
    
    # assumes: neuroinflam_list, get_slim_seu, get_full_seurat, get_all_cell_types are defined
    # and library(qs) is available for qsave()
    
    base_dir <- "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory"
    dir.create(base_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    
    # helper: try get_full_seurat with decreasing nbin (23 → … → 1)
    run_full_with_retry <- function(seu_obj) {
      browser()
      bins <- c(seq(23, 3, by = -4), 1)
      last_err <- NULL
      for (nb in bins) {
        message("  • Trying get_full_seurat(nbin_for_cell_cycle = ", nb, ")")
        res <- try(get_full_seurat(seu_obj, nbin_for_cell_cycle = nb, compute_cell_cycle = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
        if (!inherits(res, "try-error")) {
          if (!is.null(last_err)) message("    ↳ Succeeded after previous error: ", last_err)
          return(res)
        } else {
          last_err <- as.character(res)
          message("    ↳ Failed: ", last_err)
        }
      }
      return(list(success = FALSE, last_error = last_err))
    }
    
    # Later:
    
    for (nm in names(neuroinflam_list)) {
      seu <- neuroinflam_list[[nm]]
      
      # 1) Slim
      seu <- get_slim_seu(seu)
      
      # 2) Sanity: need a 'sample' column
      if (!"sample" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
        message("Skipping '", nm, "' (no 'sample' column).")
        next
      }
      
      # 3) For each sample
      for (smp in sort(unique(seu$sample))) {
        message("Processing dataset '", nm, "' sample '", smp, "'")
        
        # subset one sample (avoid name collision with base::sample)
        seu_sample <- subset(seu, subset = sample == smp)
        
        # rebuild + annotate with retry for cell-cycle bins
        seu_sample_full <- run_full_with_retry(seu_sample)
        if (is.null(seu_sample_full)) {
          last_err <- attr(seu_sample_full, "last_error")
          message("  ✖ Skipping sample '", smp, "' after all retries failed.",
                  if (!is.null(last_err)) paste0(" Last error: ", last_err) else "")
          next
        }
        
        # downstream cell-type annotation (unchanged)
        seu_sample_full <- get_all_cell_types(seu_sample_full, n_cores = 8)
        
        # extract single values for naming (fallbacks if missing/ambiguous)
        cond  <- unique(seu_sample_full$condition);  cond  <- if (length(cond)  >= 1) cond[1]  else "NA"
        oid   <- unique(seu_sample_full$orig.ident); oid   <- if (length(oid)   >= 1) oid[1]   else "NA"
        smpl  <- unique(seu_sample_full$sample);     smpl  <- if (length(smpl)  >= 1) smpl[1]  else "NA"
        
        # sanitize any spaces or slashes
        sanitize <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", x)
        
        saving_address <- file.path(
          base_dir,
          paste0("seu_", sanitize(cond), "_", sanitize(oid), "_", sanitize(smpl), ".qs")
        )
        
        qsave(seu_sample_full, saving_address)
        message("  ✓ Saved: ", saving_address)
      }
    }
  }
  
  #create cell_type_lists from neuroimmunulogical list
  {
    
    
    base_dir <- "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory/"
    
    # --- 1) Initialize empty lists ---
    nk_list           <- list()
    monocytes_list    <- list()
    b_cells_list      <- list()
    cd4_t_cells_list  <- list()
    cd8_t_cells_list  <- list()
    
    # --- 2) Gather .qs files ---
    qs_files <- list.files(base_dir, pattern = "\\.qs$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(qs_files) == 0) {
      stop(sprintf("No .qs files found in: %s", base_dir))
    }
    
    # --- 3) Process each Seurat object ---
    for (f in qs_files) {
      base_name <- file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
      
      # Load the Seurat object
      seu <- tryCatch(qread(f), error = function(e) {
        message(sprintf("Skipping '%s': failed to qread(). Error: %s", base_name, e$message))
        return(NULL)
      })
      if (is.null(seu)) next
      
      # Sanity check
      if (!"final_cell_type" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data)) {
        message(sprintf("Skipping '%s': no 'final_cell_type' column in meta.data.", base_name))
        next
      }
      
      # Subsets (note: CD8 fixed; your snippet had CD4 twice)
      seu_nk          <- tryCatch(subset(seu, subset = final_cell_type == "NK cells"),        error = function(e) NULL)
      seu_monocytes   <- tryCatch(subset(seu, subset = final_cell_type == "Monocytes"),       error = function(e) NULL)
      seu_b_cells     <- tryCatch(subset(seu, subset = final_cell_type == "B cells"),         error = function(e) NULL)
      seu_cd4_t_cells <- tryCatch(subset(seu, subset = final_cell_type == "CD4+ T cells"),    error = function(e) NULL)
      seu_cd8_t_cells <- tryCatch(subset(seu, subset = final_cell_type == "CD8+ T cells"),    error = function(e) NULL)
      
      # Helper to get cell counts safely
      n_cells <- function(x) { if (is.null(x)) 0 else length(Cells(x)) }
      
      # Append if non-empty
      if (n_cells(seu_nk)          > 0) nk_list[[base_name]]          <- seu_nk
      if (n_cells(seu_monocytes)   > 0) monocytes_list[[base_name]]   <- seu_monocytes
      if (n_cells(seu_b_cells)     > 0) b_cells_list[[base_name]]     <- seu_b_cells
      if (n_cells(seu_cd4_t_cells) > 0) cd4_t_cells_list[[base_name]] <- seu_cd4_t_cells
      if (n_cells(seu_cd8_t_cells) > 0) cd8_t_cells_list[[base_name]] <- seu_cd8_t_cells
      
      # Progress message
      message(sprintf(
        "Finished: %s  (NK=%d, Monocytes=%d, B=%d, CD4=%d, CD8=%d)",
        base_name,
        n_cells(seu_nk),
        n_cells(seu_monocytes),
        n_cells(seu_b_cells),
        n_cells(seu_cd4_t_cells),
        n_cells(seu_cd8_t_cells)
      ))
    }
    
    # --- 4) Optional: quick summary ---
    message(sprintf("Summary: NK=%d | Monocytes=%d | B=%d | CD4=%d | CD8=%d",
                    length(nk_list),
                    length(monocytes_list),
                    length(b_cells_list),
                    length(cd4_t_cells_list),
                    length(cd8_t_cells_list)))
    
    
    qsave(nk_list, "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/nk_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    qsave(monocytes_list, "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/monocytes_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    qsave(b_cells_list, "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/b_cells_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    qsave(cd4_t_cells_list, "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/cd4_t_cells_list_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    qsave(cd8_t_cells_list, "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/cd8_t_cells_list_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    
    
  }
  
  #run one_one_one on each cell type
  {
    
    
    
    
    nk_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/nk_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    
    
    
    
    monocytes_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/monocytes_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    b_cells_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/b_cells_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    
    
    cd4_t_cells_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/cd4_t_cells_list_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    cd8_t_cells_list <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/other_conditions/neuroinflammatory_lists_per_cell_type/cd8_t_cells_list_neuroimmunulogocial_list.qs")
    
    
    healthy_list_nk <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list_nk.qs")
    healthy_list_monocytes <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list_monocytes.qs")
    healthy_list_b_cells <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list_b_cells.qs")
    
    
    healthy_list_cd4_t_cells <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list_cd4_t_cells.qs")
    healthy_list_cd8_t_cells <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/healthy controls/healthy_list_cd8_t_cells.qs")
    
    
    
    options(future.globals.maxSize = 400 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)  # 320 GB
    
    # --- Helpers (unchanged logic, minimal edits) ---
    get_meta_scalar <- function(seu, fields, default = NA_character_) {
      for (fld in fields) {
        if (!is.null(seu@meta.data[[fld]])) {
          vals <- unique(as.character(seu@meta.data[[fld]]))
          vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & nzchar(vals)]
          if (length(vals) >= 1) return(vals[1])
        }
      }
      default
    }
    
    parse_name_fallback <- function(x) {
      nm <- sub("^seu_", "", x)
      parts <- strsplit(nm, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      condition <- if (length(parts) >= 1) parts[1] else nm
      dataset   <- if (length(parts) >= 2) parts[2] else "unknownDataset"
      sample    <- if (length(parts) >= 3) paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = "_") else "unknownSample"
      list(condition = condition, dataset = dataset, sample = sample)
    }
    
    safe_control_key <- function(seu_control, fallback_name) {
      key <- get_meta_scalar(seu_control, c("orig.ident", "orig_ident", "dataset"))
      if (is.na(key) || !nzchar(key)) key <- fallback_name
      as.character(key)
    }
    
    patient_labels <- function(seu_patient, patient_name) {
      condition <- get_meta_scalar(seu_patient, c("condition", "patient_type", "disease", "group"))
      dataset   <- get_meta_scalar(seu_patient, c("dataset", "orig.ident", "orig_ident", "source"))
      sample    <- get_meta_scalar(seu_patient, c("sample", "sample_id", "sample.name", "sample_name"))
      if (is.na(condition) || is.na(dataset) || is.na(sample) ||
          !nzchar(condition) || !nzchar(dataset) || !nzchar(sample)) {
        parsed <- parse_name_fallback(patient_name)
        if (is.na(condition) || !nzchar(condition)) condition <- parsed$condition
        if (is.na(dataset)   || !nzchar(dataset))   dataset   <- parsed$dataset
        if (is.na(sample)    || !nzchar(sample))    sample    <- parsed$sample
      }
      list(condition = condition, dataset = dataset, sample = sample)
    }
    
    # --- Runner for a cell type (tiny tweak: don't stop() on empty lists) ---
    run_one_on_one_for_celltype <- function(patient_list, healthy_list, folder = "NK") {
      if (length(patient_list) == 0) {
        message("▶ Cell type: ", folder, " — patient_list is empty (skipping).")
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      if (length(healthy_list) == 0) {
        message("▶ Cell type: ", folder, " — healthy_list is empty (skipping).")
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      message("▶ Cell type: ", folder)
      
      for (patient_name in names(patient_list)) {
        tryCatch({
          seu_patient <- patient_list[[patient_name]]
          if (!inherits(seu_patient, "Seurat")) {
            message("Skipping '", patient_name, "': not a Seurat object.")
            next
          }
          
          ids <- patient_labels(seu_patient, patient_name)
          message(sprintf("  • Patient: %s (condition=%s, dataset=%s, sample=%s)",
                          patient_name, ids$condition, ids$dataset, ids$sample))
          
          output_list <- list()
          
          for (control_name in names(healthy_list)) {
            tryCatch({
              seu_control <- healthy_list[[control_name]]
              if (!inherits(seu_control, "Seurat")) {
                message("    - Skipping control '", control_name, "': not a Seurat object.")
                next
              }
              
              control_key <- safe_control_key(seu_control, control_name)
              
              output <- tryCatch(
                one_on_one(
                  seu_patient, seu_control,
                  patient_type       = ids$condition,
                  control_type       = "Healthy",
                  patient_orig_ident = ids$dataset
                ),
                error = function(e) {
                  message("    - one_on_one failed for control '", control_name, "': ", e$message)
                  NULL
                }
              )
              if (is.null(output)) next
              
              if (control_key %in% names(output_list)) {
                output_list[[control_key]] <- append(output_list[[control_key]], output[[control_key]])
              } else {
                if (!is.null(output[[control_key]])) {
                  output_list[[control_key]] <- output[[control_key]]
                } else if (length(output) >= 1) {
                  output_list[[control_key]] <- output[[1]]
                } else {
                  message("    - Warning: unexpected output structure for control '", control_name, "'.")
                }
              }
            }, error = function(e) {
              message("    - Comparison crashed for control '", control_name, "': ", e$message, " (continuing)")
            })
          } # controls
          
          out_dir <- sprintf(
            "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/%s/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy",
            folder
          )
          dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
          
          out_path <- sprintf(
            "%s/%s_%s_%s_outputlist.qs",
            out_dir, ids$condition, ids$dataset, ids$sample
          )
          
          tryCatch({
            qsave(output_list, out_path)
            message("     ✔ saved ", out_path)
          }, error = function(e) {
            message("     ✖ failed to save ", out_path, ": ", e$message, " (continuing)")
          })
          
          gc()
        }, error = function(e) {
          message("  ✖ Patient '", patient_name, "' crashed: ", e$message, " (continuing to next patient)")
        })
      }
    }
    
    # --- Execute for all three lists ---
      # NK
      run_one_on_one_for_celltype(
        patient_list = nk_list,
        healthy_list =  healthy_list_nk,
        folder       = "NK"
      )
    
    gc()
    
    # Monocytes
    run_one_on_one_for_celltype(
      patient_list = monocytes_list,
      healthy_list = healthy_list_monocytes,
      folder       = "Monocytes"
    )
    
    gc()
    
    
    # B cells
    run_one_on_one_for_celltype(
      patient_list = b_cells_list,
      healthy_list = healthy_list_b_cells,
      folder       = "B_cells"
    )
    
    gc()
    
    # CD4_T_CELLs
    run_one_on_one_for_celltype(
      patient_list = cd4_t_cells_list,
      healthy_list = healthy_list_cd4_t_cells,
      folder       = "CD4_T_cells"
    )
    
    gc()
    
    
    #CD8_T_cells
    run_one_on_one_for_celltype(
      patient_list = cd8_t_cells_list,
      healthy_list = healthy_list_cd8_t_cells,
      folder       = "CD8_T_cells"
    )
    
    gc()
    
    
    
    
  }
  
  #make sure we have all 12 original_tables in each output_list
  {
    
    
    # Folders per cell type
    cell_paths <- list(
      "NKs" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "Monocytes" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "B cells" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "CD4 + T cells"       = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "CD8 + T cells" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/"
    )
    
    # Expected datasets → samples (12 total)
    expected <- list(
      "Mevorach" = c("CD55-control", "CD59-control"),
      "Hong"     = paste0("HC-", 1:5),
      "Kang"     = c("JSB", "KYO"),
      "Ramesh"   = c("2", "3", "32")
    )
    
    is_valid_table <- function(x) {
      if (is.null(x)) return(FALSE)
      if (length(x) == 1L && is.na(x)) return(FALSE)
      if (is.data.frame(x)) return(nrow(x) > 0)
      FALSE
    }
    
    check_file <- function(file, cell_type, expected_map) {
      obj <- tryCatch(qread(file), error = function(e) NULL)
      
      missing <- character(0)
      for (ds in names(expected_map)) {
        for (smp in expected_map[[ds]]) {
          ot <- tryCatch({
            if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj[[ds]]) || is.null(obj[[ds]][[smp]])) {
              NA
            } else {
              obj[[ds]][[smp]][["original_table"]]
            }
          }, error = function(e) NA)
          
          if (!is_valid_table(ot)) {
            missing <- c(missing, paste(ds, smp, sep = "/"))
          }
        }
      }
      
      if (length(missing) > 0) {
        data.frame(
          cell_type        = cell_type,
          object           = sub("\\.qs$", "", basename(file)),
          num_of_missing   = length(missing),
          names_of_missing = paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    }  
    # ── Run the checks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    res_list <- list()
    
    for (ct in names(cell_paths)) {
      files <- list.files(cell_paths[[ct]], pattern = "\\.qs$", full.names = TRUE)
      if (length(files) == 0L) next
      ct_rows <- lapply(files, check_file, cell_type = ct, expected_map = expected)
      ct_rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ct_rows)
      if (length(ct_rows) > 0L) res_list[[ct]] <- do.call(rbind, ct_rows)
    }
    
    missing_df <- if (length(res_list) > 0L) {
      do.call(rbind, res_list)
    } else {
      data.frame(
        cell_type = character(),
        object = character(),
        num_of_missing = integer(),
        names_of_missing = character(),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    # Optional: sort rows
    if (nrow(missing_df)) {
      missing_df <- missing_df[order(missing_df$cell_type, missing_df$object), ]
    }
    
    # View the result
    missing_df
    
    
  }
  
  # run create_meta_table
  {
    
    cell_paths <- list(
      "NK" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "Monocytes" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "B_cells" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "CD4_T_cells"       = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/",
      "CD8_T_cells" = "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroinflammatory-healthy/"
    )
    
    
    for (ct in names(cell_paths)) {
      in_dir  <- cell_paths[[ct]]
      out_dir <- sub("output_lists", "meta_tables", in_dir)
      dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      
      files <- list.files(in_dir, pattern = "\\.qs$", full.names = TRUE)
      files <- files[!grepl("CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist\\.qs$", files)]
      
      for (f in files) {
        obj_name <- sub("\\.qs$", "", basename(f))
        
        message("▶ Starting: ", obj_name, " (", ct, ")")
        
        assign(obj_name, qread(f))
        meta_table <- create_meta_table(get(obj_name))
        
        out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(obj_name, "_meta_table.qs"))
        qsave(meta_table, out_file)
        
        message("✓ Finished: ", obj_name, " → saved to ", out_file)
      }
    }
    
    
  }
  
  
}
```

```{r, "make_metabolic_shift_scatter_plots function", eval=FALSE}




make_metabolic_shift_scatter_plots <- function(
    metabolic_shifits_cell_type_df,
    condition_pal = c(
      "Multiple Sclerosis" = "#023047",
      "Ab-mediated IDD"    = "#8ecae6",
      "CD55 Def."          = "#ffb703",
      "CD59 Def."          = "#fb8500"
    ),
    shape_vals = c(
      "Esaulova"   = 25,
      "Kang"       = 24,
      "Ramesh"     = 23,
      "Mevorach"   = 22,
      "Schafflick" = 21
    ),
    big_title  = 28,   # plot title
    big_axis   = 26,   # axis titles
    big_txt    = 22,   # axis ticks, legend text and label text
    big_legend = 22    # legend titles
) {
  # ---------- 1) Sanity checks ----------
  req_cols <- c("sample","metric","score","dataset","condition",
                "condition_subtype","age","sex","EDSS")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(req_cols, colnames(metabolic_shifits_cell_type_df))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("Input data frame is missing required columns: ",
         paste(missing_cols, collapse=", "))
  }
  if (!is.numeric(metabolic_shifits_cell_type_df$score)) {
    stop("Column 'score' must be numeric.")
  }
  
  needed_metrics <- c("CI-linked NADH:", "FAO_shift", "Succ_shift")
  present_metrics <- unique(metabolic_shifits_cell_type_df$metric)
  missing_metrics <- setdiff(needed_metrics, present_metrics)
  if (length(missing_metrics) > 0) {
    warning("These required metrics are missing and will yield NA in plots: ",
            paste(missing_metrics, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  # ---------- 2) Prepare plotting data (pivot to wide) ----------
  wide_df <- metabolic_shifits_cell_type_df %>%
    filter(metric %in% needed_metrics) %>%
    dplyr::select(sample, dataset, condition, condition_subtype, age, sex, EDSS,
           metric, score) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = score)
  
  # Ensure mapping for shape and color
  shape_full <- c(shape_vals, "Other" = 20)
  wide_df <- wide_df %>%
    mutate(
      display_dataset = ifelse(dataset %in% names(shape_vals), dataset, "Other"),
      display_dataset = factor(display_dataset, levels = names(shape_full)),
      condition = factor(condition, levels = names(condition_pal))
    )
  
  # ---------- 3) Axes range helpers ----------
  # X: CI-linked NADH: (AUC-like score)
  x_vals <- wide_df[["CI-linked NADH:"]]
  x_min  <- suppressWarnings(min(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  x_max  <- suppressWarnings(max(x_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(x_min) || !is.finite(x_max)) {
    x_min <- 0.3; x_max <- 0.7
  }
  x_pad   <- 0.02
  x_range <- c(x_min - x_pad, x_max + x_pad)
  x_breaks <- scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)(x_range)
  
  # Y range builder for shift columns
  .y_setup <- function(y) {
    y <- y[is.finite(y)]
    y_max <- ifelse(length(y), max(abs(y), na.rm = TRUE), 0.1)
    y_max <- max(y_max, 0.05)
    y_pad <- 0.02
    lim   <- c(-y_max - y_pad, y_max + y_pad)
    brks  <- scales::breaks_pretty(n = 5)(lim)
    list(lim = lim, breaks = brks)
  }
  
  # Compute the visible segment of y = x within current panel ranges
  .yx_segment <- function(xlim, ylim) {
    # y=x intersects panel where x ∈ [max(xmin, ymin), min(xmax, ymax)]
    x0 <- max(xlim[1], ylim[1])
    x1 <- min(xlim[2], ylim[2])
    if (is.finite(x0) && is.finite(x1) && x1 > x0) {
      list(has_segment = TRUE,
           x0 = x0, y0 = x0,
           x1 = x1, y1 = x1,
           xl = x0 + 0.8*(x1 - x0),  # label point near the end
           yl = x0 + 0.8*(x1 - x0))
    } else {
      list(has_segment = FALSE)
    }
  }
  
  # ---------- 4) Plot builder ----------
  .build_plot <- function(df, y_col, plot_title, y_axis_label) {
    y_vals <- df[[y_col]]
    y_ax   <- .y_setup(y_vals)
    seg    <- .yx_segment(x_range, y_ax$lim)
    
    p <- ggplot(
      df,
      aes(x = `CI-linked NADH:`, y = .data[[y_col]])
    ) +
      geom_point(
        aes(fill = condition, shape = display_dataset),
        size   = 3.5,
        colour = "black",
        stroke = 0.5,
        alpha  = 0.9,
        na.rm  = TRUE
      ) +
      # Light grid at pretty breaks
      geom_hline(yintercept = y_ax$breaks, linetype = "solid",
                 colour = "grey90", size = 0.3) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = x_breaks, linetype = "solid",
                 colour = "grey90", size = 0.3) +
      # y = x dashed segment (only when it intersects panel)
      { if (seg$has_segment)
        annotate("segment",
                 x = seg$x0, y = seg$y0, xend = seg$x1, yend = seg$y1,
                 linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black")
        else
          NULL } +
      # Label "y = x" near the segment (or in the corner if no intersection)
      { if (seg$has_segment)
        annotate("text",
                 x = seg$xl, y = seg$yl,
                 label = "y = x",
                 hjust = -0.1, vjust = -0.6,
                 size = big_txt / 3.5)
        else
          annotate("text",
                   x = x_range[1] + 0.05*diff(x_range),
                   y = y_ax$lim[2] - 0.05*diff(y_ax$lim),
                   label = "y = x",
                   hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
                   size = big_txt / 3.5, fontface = "italic") } +
      # Manual scales
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = condition_pal,
        name   = "Condition",
        drop   = FALSE,
        guide  = guide_legend(
          order = 1,
          override.aes = list(shape = 21, colour = "black", size = 4, stroke = 0.5)
        )
      ) +
      scale_shape_manual(
        values = shape_full,
        name   = "Dataset",
        drop   = FALSE,
        guide  = guide_legend(order = 2)
      ) +
      # Axes
      scale_x_continuous(
        name   = "CI-linked NADH Score",
        limits = range(x_range),
        breaks = x_breaks
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(
        name   = y_axis_label,
        limits = y_ax$lim,
        breaks = y_ax$breaks
      ) +
      # Titles & theme with true axes (not bolded guide lines)
      labs(title = plot_title) +
      theme_classic(base_size = big_txt) +
      theme(
        plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = big_title),
        axis.title   = element_text(size = big_axis),
        axis.text    = element_text(size = big_txt),
        legend.title = element_text(size = big_legend),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = big_txt),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box      = "horizontal",
        axis.line       = element_line(linewidth = 0.6, colour = "black")
      )
    
    p
  }
  
  # ---------- 5) Build both plots ----------
  Succ_shift_plot <- .build_plot(
    wide_df,
    y_col        = "Succ_shift",
    plot_title   = "Succinate shift vs CI-linked NADH",
    y_axis_label = "Succinate shift"
  )
  
  FAO_shift_plot <- .build_plot(
    wide_df,
    y_col        = "FAO_shift",
    plot_title   = "FAO shift vs CI-linked NADH",
    y_axis_label = "FAO shift"
  )
  
  # ---------- 6) Return ----------
  list(
    Succ_shift_plot = Succ_shift_plot,
    FAO_shift_plot  = FAO_shift_plot
  )
}
```

```{r, "add two metabolic pathways to our TCA", eval=FALSE}
    "CD4 + T cells"  = "meta_table_cd4_t_cells",
    "CD8 + T cells"  = "meta_table_cd8_t_cells"
  )
  
  # Helper: safe qread
  safe_qread <- function(path) {
    tryCatch(qread(path), error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  
  # ── Gather filenames per cell type ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  files_by_ct <- lapply(cell_paths, function(dir) {
    if (!dir.exists(dir)) return(character(0))
    f <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.qs$", full.names = TRUE)
    setNames(f, basename(f))  # names are basenames; values are full paths
  })
  
  # Union of sample filenames across all folders
  all_samples <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(files_by_ct, names))))
  
  # ── Build the list-of-lists ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  neuroimmunulogical_meta_table_lists <- list()
  
  for (sample_file in all_samples) {
    # Store under name without "_meta_table.qs"
    sample_key <- sub("_meta_table$", "", sub("\\.qs$", "", sample_file))
    
    meta_table_list <- list()
    for (ct in names(cell_paths)) {
      paths_vec <- files_by_ct[[ct]]
      if (length(paths_vec) && sample_file %in% names(paths_vec)) {
        df <- safe_qread(paths_vec[[sample_file]])
        if (!is.null(df)) {
          el_name <- element_name_map[[ct]]
          meta_table_list[[el_name]] <- df
        }
      }
    }
    
    if (length(meta_table_list) > 0) {
      neuroimmunulogical_meta_table_lists[[sample_key]] <- meta_table_list
    }
  }

# Append rows from tca_auc_cell_type_list_2_pathways into tca_auc_cell_type_list, per cell type
{
  # cell types to process (union to be safe)
  cts <- union(names(tca_auc_cell_type_list), names(tca_auc_cell_type_list_2_pathways))
  
  for (ct in cts) {
    df1 <- tca_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]]
    df2 <- tca_auc_cell_type_list_2_pathways[[ct]]
    
    # If one side is missing/empty, keep the other
    if (is.null(df1) || !is.data.frame(df1) || nrow(df1) == 0) {
      tca_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- df2
      next
    }
    if (is.null(df2) || !is.data.frame(df2) || nrow(df2) == 0) {
      # nothing to add
      next
    }
    
    # Make sure both have the same set of columns
    all_cols <- union(colnames(df1), colnames(df2))
    
    # Add any missing columns as NA
    miss1 <- setdiff(all_cols, colnames(df1))
    miss2 <- setdiff(all_cols, colnames(df2))
    if (length(miss1)) df1[miss1] <- NA
    if (length(miss2)) df2[miss2] <- NA
    
    # Reorder columns identically (prefer df1's order, then any extras)
    ordered_cols <- c(colnames(df1), setdiff(all_cols, colnames(df1)))
    df1 <- df1[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]
    df2 <- df2[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Bind and write back
    tca_auc_cell_type_list[[ct]] <- rbind(df1, df2)
  }
}
```

```{r, "old get_metabolic_shifit_heatmap function", eval=FALSE}

get_metabolic_shifit_heatmap <- function(metabolic_shifits_list, title, row_order = NULL, meta_name_fontsize = 11) {
  # --- Sanity: list & per-DF columns -----------------------------------------
  if (!is.list(metabolic_shifits_list) || length(metabolic_shifits_list) == 0) {
    stop("metabolic_shifits_list must be a non-empty list of data frames.")
  }
  req_cols <- c("sample","metric","score","dataset","condition","condition_subtype","age","sex","EDSS")
  lapply(names(metabolic_shifits_list), function(ct) {
    df <- metabolic_shifits_list[[ct]]
    if (!is.data.frame(df)) stop("Element '", ct, "' is not a data.frame.")
    miss <- setdiff(req_cols, colnames(df))
    if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Cell type '", ct, "' is missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse=", "))
    if (!is.numeric(df$score)) stop("Column 'score' must be numeric in '", ct, "'.")
    if (!is.numeric(df$age))  stop("Column 'age' must be numeric in '", ct, "'.")
    if (!is.numeric(df$EDSS)) stop("Column 'EDSS' must be numeric in '", ct, "'.")
    if (!is.character(df$sample) && !is.factor(df$sample)) stop("'sample' must be character/factor in '", ct, "'.")
  })
  
  # --- Map cell-type labels for row names ------------------------------------
  ct_label_map <- c(
    "NKs"          = "NK",
    "Monocytes"    = "Monocytes",
    "B Cells"      = "B_Cells",
    "CD4+ T Cells" = "CD4_T_Cells",
    "CD8+ T Cells" = "CD8_T_Cells"
  )
  
  # --- 1) Bind list → long df with 'row' names (two shifts per cell type) ----
  wanted_metrics <- c("FAO_shift","Succ_shift")
  
  long_df <- do.call(dplyr::bind_rows, lapply(names(metabolic_shifits_list), function(ct) {
    df <- metabolic_shifits_list[[ct]]
    lbl <- ifelse(ct %in% names(ct_label_map), ct_label_map[[ct]], gsub("\\s+", "_", ct))
    df |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$metric %in% wanted_metrics) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        sample = as.character(.data$sample),
        row    = paste0(.data$metric, "_", lbl)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(.data$row, dplyr::all_of(req_cols))
  }))
  
  # Per-sample metadata (one row per sample)
  filt_meta <- long_df |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$sample) |>
    dplyr::distinct(.data$sample, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- 2) Build SHIFT matrix: rows (row) × columns (sample) ------------------
  shift_wide <- long_df |>
    dplyr::select(.data$row, .data$sample, .data$score) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$row, .data$sample) |>
    dplyr::summarise(score = mean(.data$score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from  = .data$sample,
      values_from = .data$score,
      values_fill = NA_real_
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$row)
  
  shift_mat <- as.matrix(shift_wide[, -1, drop = FALSE])
  rownames(shift_mat) <- shift_wide$row
  
  # Desired row order (if not supplied, use canonical: FAO/Succ per CT in ct_label_map order)
  if (is.null(row_order)) {
    base_rows <- unname(ct_label_map[names(ct_label_map)])
    row_order <- as.vector(rbind(paste0("FAO_shift_",  base_rows),
                                 paste0("Succ_shift_", base_rows)))
  }
  desired_rows <- intersect(row_order, rownames(shift_mat))
  other_rows   <- setdiff(rownames(shift_mat), desired_rows)
  shift_mat    <- shift_mat[c(desired_rows, other_rows), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # --- Allocate space for long left-side row labels --------------------------
  row_lab_gp <- grid::gpar(fontsize = 11)
  row_lab_w  <- ComplexHeatmap::max_text_width(rownames(shift_mat), gp = row_lab_gp) * 1.1
  
  # --- 3) Custom column ordering (same logic as your AUC heatmap) ------------
  condition_order <- c("CD59 Def.", "CD55 Def.", "Multiple Sclerosis", "Ab-mediated IDD")
  filt_meta$condition <- factor(filt_meta$condition, levels = condition_order)
  filt_meta <- filt_meta |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$condition, .data$dataset, .data$sample)
  
  common_cols <- filt_meta$sample
  shift_mat   <- shift_mat[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
  filt_meta   <- filt_meta[match(common_cols, filt_meta$sample), , drop = FALSE]
  
  # --- 4) Palettes (unchanged from your function) ----------------------------
  dataset_pal <- c(
    Esaulova = "#E9A5F1", Kang = "#FFB4B4",
    Ramesh = "#e76f51", Schafflick = "#000000",
    Mevorach = "#ff4d6d"
  )
  subtype_pal <- c(
    CIS = "#bb9457", RRMS = "#432818",
    "CD55 Def." = "#ffb703", "CD59 Def." = "#fb8500",
    "MOGAD" = "#2C6E49", "NMOSD" = "#B2DF8A"
  )
  condition_pal <- c(
    "Multiple Sclerosis" = "#023047", "Ab-mediated IDD" = "#8ecae6",
    "CD55 Def." = "#ffb703", "CD59 Def." = "#fb8500"
  )
  sex_pal     <- c(Female = "#ff8daa", Male = "#32b7ff")
  edss_pal    <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(0, 6),  c("#70e000", "#e01e37"))
  age_pal     <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(20, 80), c("#48CAE4", "#03045e"))
  
  # --- 5) Column annotation ---------------------------------------------------
  anno <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
    Condition       = filt_meta$condition,
    `Sub-Condition` = filt_meta$condition_subtype,
    Dataset         = filt_meta$dataset,
    Sex             = filt_meta$sex,
    Age             = filt_meta$age,
    EDSS            = filt_meta$EDSS,
    col = list(
      Condition       = condition_pal,
      `Sub-Condition` = subtype_pal,
      Dataset         = dataset_pal,
      Sex             = sex_pal,
      Age             = age_pal,
      EDSS            = edss_pal
    ),
    na_col = "grey85",
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      EDSS = list(
        title     = "EDSS",
        at        = seq(0, 6, 2),
        labels    = as.character(seq(0, 6, 2)),
        legend_gp = grid::gpar(fill = edss_pal(seq(0, 6, 2)))
      )
    ),
    annotation_name_side = "left",
    annotation_name_gp   = grid::gpar(fontsize = meta_name_fontsize)
  )
  
  # --- 6) Heatmap -------------------------------------------------------------
  ht <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(
    shift_mat,
    name                        = "Shift",
    top_annotation              = anno,
    show_row_names              = TRUE,
    row_names_side              = "left",
    row_names_gp                = row_lab_gp,
    row_names_max_width         = row_lab_w,
    show_column_names           = FALSE,
    cluster_rows                = FALSE,
    row_order                   = rownames(shift_mat),
    cluster_columns             = FALSE,
    column_order                = common_cols,
    clustering_distance_rows    = "euclidean",
    clustering_distance_columns = "euclidean",
    na_col                      = "grey85",
    heatmap_legend_param        = list(
      at    = legend_breaks(shift_mat),   # uses your existing helper, unchanged
      title = "Shift",
      title_position = "leftcenter-rot"
    ),
    column_title    = title,
    column_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold", fontsize = 14)
  )
  
  return(ht)
}
```

```{r, "Hong dimplot", eval=FALSE}
      dpi = 600, device = "jpeg", type = "cairo",
      quality = 100
    )
    
  }
```
